name: 1900 Cup
shortDescription: One of the biggest international tournaments in Barcelona, held during Easter holidays for top football academies
description: The 1900 Cup is among the biggest international tournaments in Barcelona, held during the Easter holidays. In 2024, the competition was held for the second time and gained widespread recognition, thanks to the participation of renowned clubs such as FC Barcelona, RCD Espanyol, Atlético de Madrid, and other top academies from Spain and beyond. The event offers excellent accommodation, high-quality meals, and state-of-the-art stadiums.

name: Acropolis Cup
shortDescription: Historic international youth football competition in seaside Agropoli with famous clubs and top facilities
description: One of the most interesting competitions in Europe. Acropolis Cup invites teams to match against well-known clubs from Italy and other countries. Delegation enjoys comfortable seaside hotel, best football pitches, and warm atmosphere. Notable past participants include Andriy Shevchenko and Salomón Rondón. Tournament began in 1982, growing from small beginnings to popular competition featuring clubs from different continents. Strong academies like Dynamo Kyiv, Spartak Moscow, and Lokomotiv Trnava have participated.

name: Adria Football Cup
shortDescription: Spring Easter football tournament on the Adriatic coast in Italy
description: Football Cup of Adria is the big spring Easter football event on the Adriatic sea coast in the tourist cities of Cattolica, Riccione and Rimini. Teams from all over Europe compete and experience the region's beaches, entertainment, and attractions. The tournament features qualifying rounds in groups with playoff stages, and awards cups, diplomas, medals, and Fair Play prizes.

name: Adriatic Cooperation Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament held along the Adriatic coast in Italy
description: Youth football tournament featuring multiple age categories competing in group stage matches with playoff advancement. Held in Gabicce Mare, Riccione, Cattolica and Misano. In 2023 the tournament attracted 158 participants.

name: Trofeo Femminile dell'Adriatico
shortDescription: International girls' football tournament on Italy's Adriatic coast
description: International girls' football tournament with teams of different ages playing in sports centres across Adriatic towns: Gabicce Mare, Cattolica, Riccione and Misano. Group stage followed by play-offs, with consolation matches for eliminated teams.

name: Adriatica Football Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament for adults and veteran teams on the Adriatic coast
description: Welcome to the Adriatic, to the football tournament for adults and veteran teams!! The whole weekend will be competitions among teams from different countries in the categories 5*5, 7*7 and 11*11, at the sports complexes Gabicce Mare, Cattolica and Gradara. Feel the atmosphere of childhood and take part in the International Competition in Italy, which started to be held in the last century! Beautiful hotels and beaches of the Adriatic coast will make your trip unforgettable.

name: Find Football tournament
shortDescription: International football tournament for adult teams in 11-side or 7-side format
description: International football tournament accepting adult teams in 11-side or 7-side formats. Teams from European countries participate. All skill levels welcome. Teams divided into groups of 4-5; top two advance to finals, others play consolation games. Prizes awarded for 1st-4th place and Fair Play award. All participants receive keepsakes.

name: AF Cup Events August
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Pristina, Kosovo with teams from multiple countries
description: AF Cup Events is a series of competitions that first started in Albania in 2022 and is now held in different countries several times a year. Promising footballers from different countries will be able to prove themselves and show their abilities in demanding matches.

name: AF Cup Events Autumn
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Kamëz, Albania
description: The Albanian Football Cup – an international youth tournament bringing together talented young players from different countries for demanding matches and experience exchange, with high-level organisation and excellent infrastructure. Created in 2022, it has become one of the largest football events in Albania.

name: Al Ahly International Cup
shortDescription: Premier international youth football tournament in Cairo featuring world-class facilities and top academies
description: Discover the most strong international youth football tournament of the year, featuring the most renowned academies from around the world in the heart of Cairo. Welcome to the Al Ahly International Cup, where world-class facilities, the legendary pyramids of Giza and the strongest participants await you.

name: Alijó Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Portugal with mountain views, rivers, and waterfalls
description: Discover Portugal and its picturesque places with the Alijó Cup youth football tournament! Enjoy mountain views, rivers, waterfalls and nature in the small village of Alijó, 130 kilometres away from Porto. We guarantee you a high level of organisation, great food and strong teams from Portugal and nearby countries.

name: AllTogether Cup
shortDescription: European youth football tournament promoting respect, teamwork, and community through international competition
description: Join the AllTogether Cup, where strong football clubs from across Europe unite through their shared passion for the game. Held in Spain, this vibrant international tournament promotes respect and teamwork, fostering a strong sense of community, inclusion, and friendship. Enjoy thrilling matches, unforgettable moments, and an exciting programme of events.

name: Amares Summer Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Portugal with group stage and knockout rounds
description: The Amares Summer Cup takes place in Amares, offering a peaceful setting with natural scenery and cultural charm. Youth squads gather in this Portuguese town for a lively and memorable event. The tournament debuted in 2025, establishing a strong identity among developing academies.

name: Antalya Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament in sunny Turkey with all-inclusive luxury and top natural fields
description: International Antalya Cup tournament in sunny Turkey. Excellent living conditions, buffet meals, adults receive an all-inclusive card and excellent natural fields. The Antalya Cup has been held since 2016. Over the years, clubs from 25 countries have participated, with hundreds of squads taking home thousands of trophies.

name: Antalya Friendship Cup Anniversary Elite Edition
shortDescription: International Youth Football Tournament in Turkey with academies from around the world
description: International Youth Football Tournament in Turkey - Antalya Friendship Cup Anniversary Elite Edition with academies from all over the world represented, including the best Kazakh, Uzbek, Turkish and Azerbaijani clubs. Modern fields, first-class hotel, high level organisation.

name: Antalya Friendship Spring Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament featuring academies from around the world
description: International Friendship Cup held in Antalya with participation of football academies worldwide and Turkish clubs. Features professional organization, high-quality fields, international opponents, and recreational activities. Tournament started in 2018 as Asteria International Cup.

name: Antoine Sarrion Blue Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament in Hérault region with teams from France, Spain, Germany and beyond
description: International football tournament returning to Valras-Plage, Valras-Sérignan, Portiragnes and surrounding areas in the Hérault region. Founded in 1990, the tournament features group stages with winners advancing to finals and other participants to play-offs. All teams receive trophies, all players receive medals, with special Fair Play and Best Supporter awards.

name: Aphel Arena Lino Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament in Makarska featuring teams from across Europe
description: Football competition held at Aphel Arena in Makarska featuring group stage with at least 3-4 matches, with top teams advancing to Final Round A and remaining teams to Final Round B. Participants receive medals and souvenirs, with trophies for top three teams in each age group.

name: Aphel Arena Winter Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in multiple age groups in Makarska
description: International youth football tournament established in 2023, organised in partnership with Hajduk Split. Takes place at a modern sports base in Makarska with indoor and outdoor facilities. Welcomes clubs from Balkan nations, Italy, Czech Republic, Austria and beyond. Group stage guarantees 3-4 matches per team, with top two advancing to final round A. Remaining teams compete in final round B with at least two additional games. All players receive medals and sponsor gifts; top three squads in each age category receive trophies.

name: Arena Autumn Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament uniting youth from around the world in Tallinn, Estonia
description: Welcome to Arena Cup, an international football tournament taking place in Tallinn, Estonia. The goal is to unite youth throughout the world and raise football culture, where athletes find value in sports and team spirit, in self-improvement, development and health, regardless of age, gender and nationality. The competition combines high-level organization and comfort with a friendly ambience between all participants. First organized in 2022.

name: Arena Spring Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Tallinn on artificial turf and indoor arenas
description: Arena Spring Cup is a youth football tournament organized in Tallinn on artificial turf fields and indoor arenas. Teams are divided into groups, followed by classification matches and play-offs using a knock-out system. Top three teams in each age group receive cups and medals; all teams receive commemorative diplomas.

name: Argentina Youth Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Mar del Plata featuring clubs from Latin America, Canada, USA, Spain, and UK
description: International football tournament held in Mar del Plata as part of the city's 150th-anniversary celebrations. Top teams progress to playoff rounds, with medals awarded to all participants and trophies for semi-finalists and Integration Cup winners.

name: Argeș Elite Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament on natural grass pitches in Pitești with teams from Romania and abroad
description: Join us at the Argeș Elite Cup for an exciting youth football experience on natural grass pitches, bringing together boys from Romania and abroad. The first edition was held in 2026.

name: Trofeo Citta' di Arzachena
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Sardinia featuring invited and local clubs
description: International youth football cup in Arzachena launching in 2024, bringing together participants from different countries. Competition begins with qualifying group matches, with top two advancing to semi-finals and lower-placed teams competing in consolation matches. Winner receives trophy; all teams receive participation plaques.

name: ASTT Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament for small kids of all levels with welcoming atmosphere and natural grass fields
description: Join the ASTT Cup, a football tournament open to teams of all levels. Played on natural grass pitches, the event combines competitive football with a friendly atmosphere. A food and refreshment area will be available throughout the day for players, coaches, families, and supporters. First held in 2026, the tournament aims to become a yearly meeting point for participants from France and neighbouring European countries.

name: Asturias International Cup
shortDescription: Summer football tournament in Asturias welcoming international youth teams
description: International youth football tournament held in Asturias, Spain. Teams compete in groups of 4-5, followed by playoff and consolation stages. All participants receive medals, with trophies awarded to top three finishers in each age group. Includes accommodation, meals, water, guide, coach accommodation, and player injury insurance.

name: Athina Cup
shortDescription: Summer football tournament in Athens, Greece with teams from different countries
description: A 7-a-side and 11-a-side football tournament held in Athens during summer. Teams compete in groups with the top 2 teams advancing to Play Off A. The tournament features additional 2x5 minute periods from semi-finals onwards, decided by penalty shootout if tied. All teams receive prizes with the top team in each age category receiving a cup.

name: Athlos Costa Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament featuring top Italian clubs and academies
description: Young footballers from across Italy, including top-tier squads, will gather for this international youth football tournament marking the grand finale of an incredible season. This is the perfect opportunity for participants to put their skills to the test, forge new friendships, and compete against formidable opponents!

name: Austria Osttirol Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Alpine Austria and Italy
description: International youth football tournament taking place in Alpine cities in Austria and Italy. Features group stage and playoff games across multiple age categories. Includes accommodation, meals, guide services, and access to local attractions like climbing centers, chocolate factory, and medieval castles.

name: Ayia Napa Festival Teens Edition
shortDescription: International youth football tournament held in Cyprus for teenagers
description: International youth football tournament in Ayia Napa, Cyprus featuring "intense matches with around 400 teams around Europe." Conducted using over a dozen nearby fields creating a dynamic competitive atmosphere. Participants advancing through group stages compete in playoff rounds. All players receive medals; winners get trophies and gold/silver medals, with 3rd/4th place earning bronze. Fair Play awards, best scorer, MVP, and best goalkeeper awards also presented.

name: Ayia Napa Youth Soccer Festival
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Cyprus with multiple age categories and competitive levels
description: International Youth Festival football tournament held in Ayia Napa resort town. Tournament features 15 fields with teams divided into Eagles and Lions categories by level. All group stage participants advance to playoffs. Winners qualify for finals; lower-placed teams compete in Lions category or consolation finals. All players receive medals; winners get trophies and gold medals, runners-up silver, 3rd-4th place bronze. Individual awards for best goalkeeper, scorer, and MVP in each category.

name: Bahia de Roses Cup
shortDescription: Play football in stunning Spain, explore Empuriabrava's canals, visit Dali's museum & enjoy breathtaking beaches
description: Discover one of the most beautiful and amazing places in Spain with the Bahia de Roses Cup football tournament. Explore the cities of Roses, Empuriabrava, Palau Saverdera and Figueres. Play football, enjoy yachting through Empuriabrava's channels, race go-karts or enjoy fabulous beaches.

name: Baião Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament in the Portuguese countryside near Porto with scenic attractions
description: A football tournament in the countryside, near Porto. It is a small village about an hour's drive from Porto. You'll find scenic spots, mountains, waterfalls, suspension bridges, swimming in the pool and hot competition on the football pitch.

name: Balaton Trophy
shortDescription: Top youth football tournament at stunning Lake Balaton with elite pitches and international rivals
description: International football tournament for youth squads set at Lake Balaton. Compete on top-class pitches near the lake with participating countries from Hungary, Slovakia, Poland, Austria, Germany, Czech Republic and beyond. Launched in 2021. Tournament begins with group stage, all participants advance to either Championship or Gold category followed by knockout rounds. All players receive commemorative medals, Championship winners receive trophies, and three exceptional players per age group receive individual awards.

name: Balkan International Cup
shortDescription: International Youth Football Tournament in Thessaloniki
description: Summer youth football tournament held in suburbs of Thessaloniki featuring modern football complexes with 6 natural fields. Up to 16 teams per age group compete in pools of 4-5 teams with top finishers advancing to semifinals. Includes accommodation, meals, cultural program and visits to local attractions.

name: Baltic Sea Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament on the Baltic Sea coast in Latvia with excellent fields and affordable accommodation
description: International youth football tournament held in small sea towns on Latvia's Baltic Sea coast. The tournament began in 2000 as Roja Cup and has welcomed participants from Russia, Baltic countries, Scandinavia, Spain, Ukraine, and Belarus. Features excellent playing fields, cheap accommodation, and opportunities to relax on sandy beaches. The event includes a group round followed by playoff matches, with all participants receiving medals and tournament winners receiving cups.

name: Banas Jozsef Memorial
shortDescription: International football tournament honoring legendary Hungarian player József Bánás
description: Memorial Bánás József international football tournament featuring renowned academies from Hungary, Italy, Slovakia, Serbia, Romania, and other countries. Discover Budapest through this tournament celebrating József Bánás, a famous Hungarian player and coach who played for Vasas SC, Ferencvárosi TC and AC Milan, and led the Italian National Team and AC Milan between 1930 and 1938.

name: Banja Luka Youth Winter Cup
shortDescription: International futsal competition for youth players on the banks of the Vrbas River
description: On the banks of the Vrbas River in Banja Luka, famous for its breathtaking valley and lush greenery - will host the Banja Luka Youth Winter Cup. This prestigious futsal competition has become a cherished tradition for young football players. Clubs from Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Croatia, Hungary, Italy, Serbia, North Macedonia, and Bosnia and Herzegovina will gather for this exciting international competition.

name: Barcelona Cup International
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Barcelona with modern pitches, impressive trophies, and access to famous landmarks
description: An exciting adventure awaits at Barcelona Cup — an international youth football tournament in the capital of Catalonia using several of the most modern sports complexes in Barcelona. The tournament was first held in 2024 and has become one of the most anticipated occasions for both local clubs and guests from other countries.

name: Barcelona Promises
shortDescription: International football tournament for children held near Barcelona
description: A vibrant international competition for young players. Tournament begins with group stage, after which all participants advance to play-off rounds. Medals and trophies awarded to top three squads in each age category, with special prizes for exceptional players.

name: Barcelona Youth Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Barcelona with teams from multiple countries
description: The football tournament Barcelona Youth Cup welcomes teams and players for an experience combining competition with cultural immersion. Participants enjoy sun, international clubs, and optimal guest conditions. The tournament features qualification through preliminary group rounds with playoff advancement, consolation cup competition, medals for all players, and trophies for top three teams in each age category. Barcelona and Catalonia offer historical attractions including Gaudí creations, Royal Palaces, museums, parks, and architectural landmarks.

name: Bardonecchia Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in the Alpine resort of Bardonecchia featuring top Italian and international clubs
description: Tournament held in the Alpine resort of Bardonecchia featuring two age groups (B8 5vs5 and B10 7vs7). First group stage with advancement to finals. Participants noted the extraordinary beauty of the places and expressed desire to return. Each team receives trophy; coach and best player receive special prizes. Includes water, free coach accommodation, stadium entrance, opening ceremony and finals access, and player injury insurance.

name: Bayern Soccer Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Bavaria
description: International youth football tournament held in Unterschleißheim and Munich, Bavaria. Features group stage play followed by knockout rounds. Teams from multiple countries participate. All players receive souvenirs or medals; top 3 teams at each age receive prizes.

name: BBB Cup
shortDescription: Professional football tournament featuring top Danish and Swedish clubs
description: High-level organization tournament with leading Danish and Swedish football academies. Preliminary round with 4 pools of 6 teams, advancing to Gold or Silver finals based on placement.

name: BCN Cup
shortDescription: Large international youth football tournament with Gold & Silver finals, beach holidays, perfect prizes and iconic Catalan cities
description: BCN Cup allows you to combine excellent beach leisure, Spanish cuisine, admiration of architectural and artistic masterpieces, and participation in a football competition of truly impressive scale. The tournament will take place across several sports complexes in the Province of Barcelona, including cities such as Terrassa, Sabadell, Ripollet, and others. The Barcelona Cup was launched in 2026. It is a genuine celebration of sport, friendship, and culture, featuring an opening ceremony, high-quality prizes, and football collectives from different countries.
venueName: Terrassa FC, Club Natació Terrassa, CF Ripollet, Peña Deportiva Pajaril

name: BeKings and BeQueen Cup
shortDescription: Elite football tournament for boys & girls with top European academies in Costa Brava
description: Elite football tournament featuring clubs from Italy, France, Spain, England, and beyond. Competitors divided into groups, then advance to playoff rounds. All participants receive prizes; cups and medals awarded to every squad.

name: Benidorm Masters Cup
shortDescription: Join the Benidorm Masters Cup! Compete with teams worldwide, enjoy beautiful beaches & explore exciting tourist attractions year-round!
description: We invite your team to Benidorm - a city with beautiful beaches and clearest sea. We guarantee that you will have a great rest at any time of the year and find opponents from many countries. We are ready to offer you interesting tourist trips and a wide selection of recovery activities that become perfectly addition to the sports program of the tournament Benidorm Masters Cup! Benidorm is one of the most popular tourist destinations: roads, sea and air routes from around the world lead here. The Benidorm Masters Cup was first held in 2005.

name: Bogy Cup Lamač
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Bratislava featuring teams from across Europe
description: International youth football tournament in Bratislava. "Discover Slovakia, its capital Bratislava and the Bogy Cup international youth football tournament!" The competition features "many famous football academies from Austria, Germany, Hungary, Slovakia, the Czech Republic, Slovenia, Poland and other countries." Two-stage group format with placement-based final groups. Winners receive cups, medals, and individual player prizes.

name: Bogy Cup Potôň
shortDescription: International football tournament bringing together leading clubs from Slovakia, Hungary, Czech Republic, and other countries
description: International football tournament in Slovakia featuring teams from multiple countries. Includes group stage competitions followed by final group play-offs or play-off games depending on age category. Awards provided for 1st, 2nd, 3rd place finishers and best player from each team. Includes water, souvenir, free stadium entrance, and free opening ceremony/finals entrance.

name: Bogy Indoor Cup
shortDescription: Children's football tournament in Bratislava featuring clubs from across Eastern Europe
description: Welcome to the capital of Slovakia for the Bogy Indoor Cup children's football tournament! Modern halls and competitive matches between clubs from Austria, Hungary, Croatia, the Czech Republic and other countries await participants. Born in 2021, this event is now one of the largest in Eastern Europe, gathering professional football academies including Borussia Dortmund, Sparta Prague, Slovan Bratislava, MSK Žilina, AS Trenčín, and FK Banik Ostrava. Participants compete in group stages based on performance, with top 3 finishers receiving trophies and medals. MVP awards and a tournament best player award are also presented.

name: Bogy Winter Cup
shortDescription: Youth futsal tournament in Bratislava with teams from multiple European countries
description: A youth futsal tournament held in Bratislava featuring modern sports facilities and teams from professional academies across Czech Republic, Hungary, Slovakia, Austria, Croatia and other countries. Competition includes main group round followed by second group stage. Top three teams receive trophies and medals, with special prizes for most valuable players.

name: Bordeaux Ocean Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in southwest France near Bordeaux
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey to the Bordeaux Ocean Cup – a thrilling football celebration hosted in the southwest of France, just a few kilometres from Bordeaux. This tournament opens its doors to a new generation of rising stars from around the world, offering a unique chance to challenge top rivals and showcase true talent. The Bordeaux Ocean Cup was held for the first time in 2022.

name: Braga Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament held in Portugal since 2015 with international participants
description: Football celebration in one of Portugal's oldest cities — Braga, renowned for its rich religious heritage. Aims to bring together participants from different parts of the country and across the globe. Since 2015, welcomes clubs from France, Spain, China, Hong Kong, Brazil, USA, Chile and many other nations.

name: Budapest Football Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament for amateur adult teams in Budapest, Hungary
description: International football tournament for amateur adult teams held in Budapest. Teams compete in groups playing 3-4 games to reach finals. Finalists and semifinalists receive cups, all players receive souvenirs, and the Fair Play Cup is awarded to the most fair team.

name: Caledonia Super Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament at Scottish sports center Oriam in Edinburgh
description: An excellent tournament organized at the Scottish sports center Oriam in Edinburgh, a first-class training base for national football and rugby teams. The 2022 debut event featured more than 60 teams. Participants play 3-4 group matches, then are divided into categories based on group placement—top finishers compete for the main Cup, while others compete for the Silver Plate. Winners receive trophies and gold medals; all top three places are awarded medals.

name: Calella FEM Cup
shortDescription: A seaside football tournament for girls for an unforgettable experience and relaxation on Barcelona's coast
description: Mark a wonderful seaside women's football tournament in your calendar – the Calella FEM Cup. Calella offers well-organised competition, new friendships, and an unforgettable stay in Spain!

name: Campeones Cup
shortDescription: International youth football event with Gold & Silver play-offs, trophies, medals, beaches and family attractions
description: Have a fantastic time playing against opponents from around the world at the Campeones Cup, a youth football competition hosted across several sports venues along the Costa Brava coastline. The first Campeones Cup was organised back in 2015, and since then hundreds of international clubs have taken part in this well-established event.

name: Torneo Campeones Costa Brava
shortDescription: Join the Campeones Cup in Tordera! Play on top pitches, compete globally & explore Costa Brava's beauty.
description: We guarantee first-class conditions for football clubs at the international tournament for boys and girls – the Campeones Cup! A vast football complex with several pitches of natural grass, swimming pools, and opponents from around the globe is ready to welcome your squad. At our event, young players will enjoy unparalleled fun, intense matches, and opportunities to forge new friendships.

name: Canarias Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament on Tenerife's black beaches with competition and luxury rest
description: Enjoy yourself in the pleasure of relaxing on the black beaches of the largest of the Canary Islands. Take part in the Canarias Cup international football tournament where you will get for sure some games against strong opponents, will explore the local attraction Teide volcano and will go to one of our natural parks. Train your football skills by combining competition with a luxurious rest in one of nature's most beautiful spots.

name: Cancun Youth Cup
shortDescription: Mexican youth football tournament in Caribbean setting with culture and nature immersion
description: The Cancun Youth Cup is a Mexican youth football tournament that showcases teams from various regions in exciting matches. After competitive games, players will have the chance to immerse themselves in Cancún's vibrant culture and stunning natural beauty. Competition starts with group stage, top-ranked teams advance to playoffs. Medals awarded to all attendees, exclusive trophies to winners.

name: Capchem Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament with Gold, Silver & Bronze leagues, modern facilities, prizes for all players, and family attractions near Poznań
description: The Capchem Cup in Śrem was created for young footballers with focus on all-round player development and enjoyment of the game, emphasizing generous playing time, modern facilities, sporting values, and professional organisation. First held in 2024, driven by passion for grassroots football and ambition to establish a nationwide sporting competition for youngest age groups.

name: Capsicom Qualifying Cup Geneve
shortDescription: Youth football qualifying tournament for entry into the prestigious Capsicom Cup
description: Qualifying tournament in Vessy offering young footballers the chance to compete for a place in the Capsicom Cup, featuring top European academies. Includes group phase with top squad advancing to playoffs, with two finalists earning spots in the main event.

name: Cartagena Kids Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament at La Manga Club with fantastic pitches and coastal Mediterranean setting
description: The Cartagena Kids Cup football tournament is held at La Manga Club Sport & Leisure. The resort is located between Cartagena and the La Manga del Mar Menor peninsula and brings together accommodation, pitches and facilities in one place, making everything easy to access throughout the event. The first edition took place in 2022 with clubs from several countries, and the tournament has been held annually since then.

name: Cartaxo Summer Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Portugal's scenic Santarém district, just an hour from Lisbon
description: An exciting youth football tournament set in the charming town of Cartaxo, Portugal, surrounded by breathtaking natural landscapes. Located in the district of Santarém, just an hour from Lisbon, this competition provides a highly competitive environment, bringing together young football talents from different angles of Europe.

name: Castello Epiphany Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Florence, Italy featuring dozens of clubs competing across age categories
description: A youth football tournament held in Florence, Italy. Teams compete through group stages with top performers advancing to finals, while others participate in consolation matches. All teams receive cups, medals, and personalized commemorative plaques. The tournament showcases Florence's Renaissance heritage and cultural attractions.

name: Castelo de Vide Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament held in the charming village of Castelo de Vide, Portugal
description: An international football tournament featuring powerful Portuguese academies including Sporting CP, Estoril Praia, Benfica SL and others. The tournament began in 2014. The opening ceremony includes a parade through the town's historic streets. Teams compete in group rounds with winners advancing to Gold Final and other teams to Silver Round.

name: Cávado Verão Cup
shortDescription: Competitive summer football tournament in Braga's suburbs with vibrant atmosphere and green landscapes
description: Welcome to the Cávado Verão Cup, held in the suburbs of Braga in northern Portugal. Set among green landscapes and a vibrant football atmosphere, the tournament offers competitive matches and a memorable summer experience. The tournament was launched in 2025 to offer young players a strong summer competition.

name: Challenge Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament featuring best academies from Romania and other countries
description: It is a great honor for us to hold the Challenge Cup football tournament within the walls of the best academy in Romania! We will be glad if your team takes part in this prestigious tournament. Discover Romania with our competition. In the recent past, the children's tournament was called Summer Cup Mangalia - one of the biggest tournaments on the coast of Romania! Since 2023, the competition venue has been moved to the cities of Ovidiu and Constanta, where the greatest Romanian footballer Gheorghe Hadji created one of the largest football academies.

name: Challenge Cup Plaisir
shortDescription: Premier youth football tournament combining high-level competition with cultural discovery
description: The Challenge Cup Plaisir is a premier youth football tournament that goes beyond mere competition. It delivers an amazing experience for young footballers, combining high-level football with cultural discovery, team spirit, and the pure joy of the game. Every detail is designed to create lasting memories, both on and off the pitch. Now recognised as one of France's leading youth football events, the tournament attracts renowned clubs from across Europe. Participants can explore iconic Parisian landmarks such as the Parc des Princes and the Eiffel Tower.

name: Challenge Cup Football Tournament
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Portugal's Algarve region
description: Several hundred teams from European and international regions participate in this tournament held in coastal cities of Albuferia, Portimao, and Lagoa. Teams are divided into groups playing one round, with top teams advancing to playoff rounds. Winners receive trophies and medals; all participants receive medals. Fair Play and top scorer awards given per age category.

name: Challenge Sud Hérault Méditerranée
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in south France combining sport with recreation and beach activities
description: A multi-age tournament featuring high-quality grassy fields and seaside bungalow accommodation. First held in 1997, it has hosted renowned clubs including Montpellier, Toulouse, and Nîmes. Teams compete in group stages followed by knockout rounds. All participants receive medals and teams receive regional gift boxes. Additional activities available include beach access, cultural events, and entertainment programs.

name: Christmas Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Madrid with festive atmosphere and prizes for all participants
description: Christmas Cup youth football tournament hosted in Madrid suburbs. Teams divided into groups with top-ranked advancing to play-offs. Trophies awarded to best four squads; special prizes for top outfield player, goalkeeper, and coach. Inaugural edition celebrated in 2023.

name: Ciampino Cup
shortDescription: Children's football tournament featuring professional teams in Rome's countryside
description: Football tournament for young players on pitches in the Roman countryside, featuring top clubs like AS Roma, SS Lazio, and Frosinone Calcio. Participants compete in qualifying group rounds followed by Gold and Silver playoffs. Winners receive cups and medals, with individual prizes for outstanding players.

name: CIFE International Tournament
shortDescription: European academies and French clubs unite in a festive football event of fair play, culture, and friendship
description: The CIFE International Tournament stands out as one of the most engaging football occasions in northern France. It brings together young delegations from several nations in a warm atmosphere that blends athleticism, culture, and friendship. The competition represents a celebration of fair play, teamwork, and community spirit. With quality pitches, professional organisation, and the welcoming charm of the Hauts-de-France region, it offers lasting memories for players, coaches, and visitors alike. First held in 2026, this renowned meeting has grown into a recognised platform for European academies, French clubs, and ambitious regional sides, combining competition with a festive spirit. Closely connected to its host city, it is organised in partnership with AS Frévent, whose century-long heritage lends the occasion special meaning.

name: Čin Čin Autumn Kup
shortDescription: International football tournament in Zlatibor, Serbia with mountain resort experiences
description: International football tournament hosting over 100 teams from European countries in Zlatibor, Serbia. Features pristine natural scenery including mountains, forests, villages, waterfalls, and caves. First held in September 2023.

name: Čin Čin Spring Kup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament held in Zlatibor, Serbia
description: International tournament collecting over hundred teams from nearby countries. Held in Zlatibor, a mountain resort near Bosnia and Herzegovina border. Features preliminary group stage of 4 games, followed by knockout rounds. Top teams receive cups and medals; individual prizes for best goalkeeper, best player, and fair play team.

name: Como in Maschera Trofeo
shortDescription: Youth football tournament featuring top Italian clubs in Lombardy
description: Competition gathering famous clubs such as Juventus, Atalanta BC, Internazionale FC. Participants compete in group stages with top teams advancing to finals, followed by knockout matches. Trophies awarded to top three teams; all players receive medals.

name: Copa Andorra
shortDescription: Football tournament in Andorra la Vella featuring youth teams from across Europe
description: Discover the Copa Andorra football tournament and our country in order to enjoy an excellent climate, high-class hotels and fields. The Cup is held in Andorra la Vella - our capital will give you an indelible impression at the end of the season. We invite teams of any level to take part - just send an application and we will call you back. The tournament was founded in 2022 as the Copa UniQ Andorra in order to pay attention, first of all, to children, to their personalities, to football as a sport in itself, where the game is valued but not the desire to win at any cost.

name: Copa Cataluña
shortDescription: Join Copa Cataluna this June! Compete with 100+ teams worldwide, enjoy Costa de Maresme's beaches, parties & an unforgettable football experience!
description: The football tournament for teams from all over the world - Copa Cataluna is held in the summer at the end of June in the coastal cities from Tordera to Barcelona. These bright, noisy tourist cities will let you to plunge into the atmosphere of constant fun, parties, football and endless sandy beaches! Come to the Costa de Maresme and enjoy the incredible atmosphere of our football event! In last years, more than 100 rivals from 4 continents participated in the tournament: from Spain, the Netherlands, Algeria, Germany, Ukraine, the Faroe Islands, Bulgaria, France, Argentina, Canada, Colombia, Norway, Albania, Gabon, Egypt, India, Italy, Romania, Russia, South Africa, Switzerland, Zambia and many other countries.

name: Copa Catalunya
shortDescription: International football tournament for adult teams held in Barcelona
description: International tournament in Barcelona featuring adult teams divided into groups playing 3-4 games to reach finals. Finalists receive cups; Fair Play award given. Includes water, official t-shirt, and free stadium entrance.

name: Copa Junior Internacional
shortDescription: Elite youth football event at Uruguay's Solanas Punta del Este resort with global rivals, spa, pools, and Gold/Silver Cup awards
description: The Copa Junior Internacional is a prestigious youth football tournament held at the stunning Solanas Punta del Este resort in Uruguay. Squads from across the globe can enjoy top-tier facilities including a spa, heated pools, gyms, courts, and full-board accommodation directly on-site.

name: Copa Maresme
shortDescription: An exciting Easter football tournament from Tordera to Barcelona, featuring 150+ teams in a festive coastal atmosphere
description: Traditionally, a few dozen teams from various countries come to Copa Maresme. The tournament is held on Easter throughout the coast from Tordera to Barcelona. The competition is accompanied by a noisy holiday atmosphere, which all teams admire! Annually, more than 150 teams from several dozen countries participate in the tournament. It first began to be held in 1991.

name: Copa Melgueil
shortDescription: Junior international football tournament in Mauguio, France, 10 km from Montpellier
description: International football tournament in Mauguio, France, located 10 km from Montpellier center and near the Mediterranean coast. The tournament began in 2023 and aims to promote healthy lifestyle and cultural tolerance among young people through football, fostering friendship between nations.

name: Copa Sant Vicenç
shortDescription: Football tournament held in coastal Catalonia with teams from multiple continents
description: Copa Sant Vicenç is held at the stadiums of the cities of Calella, Santa Susana, Malgrat and Pineda de Mar, which are located on the coast from Barcelona to Tordera. This tournament has a long history with a 34th edition in 2018. Teams from different continents compete annually in this event featuring group stages and playoff rounds.

name: Copa Santa
shortDescription: Spring tournament in Catalonia with 200+ teams, exciting matches and team parties
description: Welcome to the most representative spring tournament in Catalonia! Copa Santa collects every year more than 200 teams from around the world. The coast of Maresme in spring features a huge number of teams, games, noisy parties for teams and bright prizes. For the first time the tournament started in 1993. Since then, teams from 4 continents annually come to the tournament to compete.

name: Copa UniQ Andorra Futsal
shortDescription: International youth indoor futsal tournament for boys and girls in a unique mountain setting
description: Copa UniQ Andorra Futsal is an international youth indoor tournament, bringing together boys' and girls' teams for high-level games in a unique mountain setting. It is conducted in Andorra la Vella and other beautiful cities nearby. First organised in 2026, the inaugural edition marked the launch of a new international futsal competition, created with the ambition of becoming a recognised reference point for young players.

name: Coppa Adriatica
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Lignano Sabbiadoro with sunny matches, beaches, and international rivals
description: Sun, sport, beach, and new friendships at the seaside resort of Lignano Sabbiadoro. Enjoy sunny football days, private beach access, international meetings, windsurfing, paddleboarding, and Italian lifestyle near Venice.

name: Coppa Adriatica Delle Marche
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Italy's Riviera Marchigiana region
description: International tournament for children and youth taking place in Italy's most beautiful locations, including the stunning Riviera Marchigiana, with Gabicce Mare and Pesaro. Dedicated to football and fun in charming locations known for picturesque villages, crystal-clear sea, and rolling hills. All players and teams receive commemorative plaques, cups, and medals.
organiserNames: Junior Carpine Magione Academy Terre Di Castelli

name: Carnival Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament during Viareggio Carnival with international teams
description: Amateur and professional football tournament held during Viareggio's famous carnival celebration, featuring "papier-mâché giant puppets and installations," night parties, fireworks, and local cuisine tastings. Teams compete in group stage followed by playoff rounds.

name: Costa Blanca Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament in Benidorm with 300+ teams competing across multiple age categories
description: Annual football festival held since 1994 in Benidorm, Spain. Features over 300 teams from multiple continents competing across various age categories. Includes opening ceremony, sandy beaches, old town exploration, and international competition among youth teams.

name: Costa Blanca Futsal Cup
shortDescription: One of the most popular futsal tournaments in Spain, held in Benidorm since 2004
description: Welcome to one of the most popular futsal tournaments in Spain - Costa Blanca Cup Futsal in the city of Benidorm! Enjoy the soft and clear sea all year round with your team!! You will find many pleasant events, teams from different parts of the Planet and new friends at the tournaments! You will be charmed by the warm atmosphere of Benidorm with its narrow streets, a variety of restaurants, shops of merchants and entertainment. The Costa Blanca Cup futsal has been held since 2004 and collect the strongest teams for playing in the hall from Spain, France, Japan, China, Belgium, the USA and other countries.

name: Costa Daurada Easter Cup
shortDescription: Easter football tournament in Spain for boys and girls categories
description: The 1st edition started in 2008 and is currently one of the most expected Easter tournaments in Spain. More than 300 clubs from 25 countries participate annually. The competition features a qualifying round of 4 teams in a group, followed by a final stage with placement in Cup, Silver, or Bronze series based on group results.

name: Costa Daurada Verano Cup
shortDescription: Summer football tournament in Salou & Cambrils with teams from 25+ countries
description: Costa Daurada Cup invites you to experience summer moments full of joy and fun in Salou and Cambrils with a huge sports complex featuring highest quality fields and participants from different continents. The tournament has been held since 2008 and welcomes thousands of boys and girls annually. Clubs from 25 countries have participated, including Australia, Japan, India and the USA.

name: Costa del Sol International Cup
shortDescription: Summer international football tournament in Malaga, Spain with beach culture and Spanish football clubs
description: Summer football tournament in Malaga featuring endless sandy beaches, museums, fortresses, and music. Teams compete against serious Spanish clubs and international guests from England, Korea, France, Portugal, USA and other countries. Tournament started in 2017.

name: Costa Elite Soccer Cup
shortDescription: Elite youth football tournament on Spain's Costa Brava featuring top Spanish academies
description: High level youth tournament on the Costa Brava hosting prestigious Spanish football academies including FC Barcelona, Real Sociedad, RCD Espanyol, Girona FC, CA Osasuna, and RCD Mallorca. Competition features group stage matches with qualification to Gold, Silver, Bronze and Consolation final stages. Includes accommodation, transfers, pool access, and beach activities.

name: Costa Levante Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Spain's Costa Blanca region
description: The Costa Levante Cup invites teams to discover Costa Blanca's heritage, climate, architecture and cuisine. Professional and amateur clubs from different countries participate. Preliminary group rounds form groups of 4-5 teams with top two advancing to playoffs. All participants receive medals and official journal. Top three main tournament winners and consolation trophy winner receive trophies.

name: Find Football tournament
shortDescription: International youth football tournament hosted by Le Boulou-St-Jean Pla de Corts FC
description: Youth football event featuring international clubs with group stage and knockout rounds. Top teams advance to Champions League phase, others to Europa League phase. All participants receive medals; trophies awarded to top three teams. Includes fun challenges for memorable experience.
venueName: Le Boulou-St-Jean Pla de Corts FC
organiserNames: Le Boulou-St-Jean Pla de Corts FC

name: Coupe Du Vallespir
shortDescription: Start the summer season with the Coupe Du Vallespir youth football tournament in Le Boulou town, a major event in the domestic sporting calendar with many strong teams.
description: Kick off the summer season with the Coupe Du Vallespir youth football tournament in the charming town of Le Boulou. This major event on the domestic sporting calendar attracts numerous strong squads and promises quality pitches paired with a vibrant holiday atmosphere. Le Boulou-St-Jean Pla de Corts FC, founded in 1921, proudly upholds a century-long football legacy, fostering passion, camaraderie, and a spirit of fair competition among young players.
venueName: Le Boulou-St-Jean Pla de Corts FC
organiserNames: Le Boulou-St-Jean Pla de Corts FC

name: Crikvenica Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in coastal Croatia with teams from across Europe
description: We invite your teams to visit us in Crikvenica, for the tournament of the same name, to compete against teams from Croatia, Slovakia, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Germany and other countries. This city is a place where tourism has been developing since the 19th century, where there is an excellent resort and the warm Adriatic Sea having lots of islands. Our tournament is a great opportunity to relax and enjoy the national cuisine of Croatia. Most of the beaches are sandy, and many of them annually confirm the "Blue Flag" sign for the clear sea. Crikvenica Cup as a sports and tourism project was launched in 2014.

name: Cristiano Ronaldo Campus Torneio
shortDescription: International children's football tournament held annually in Madeira at CD Nacional sports complex
description: Annual international youth football tournament held under patronage of Cristiano Ronaldo at his alma mater, CD Nacional sports complex in Funchal. Features group stage matches followed by playoff rounds for younger categories and Gold/Silver/Bronze finals for older age groups. All participants receive medals, top three finishers receive cups, and individual awards given for best field player, goalkeeper and scorer. Tournament pricing includes water, transport, guide, city tour, airport transfers, souvenirs, and free stadium/ceremony access.

name: Croatia Football Festival
shortDescription: Youth football festival in Pula-Medulin with opening ceremony in ancient amphitheater
description: Two small southern cities of Croatia - Pula and Medulin take youth football festival. The opening of the tournament is in the ancient amphitheater of Pula, which gives great importance to the football tournament for boys and girls. Enjoy Croatian cuisine, music and the exquisite coast of the Croatian tourist resorts! There are up to 70 teams from many European countries taking part in the tournament every year!

name: Croatia Trophy
shortDescription: International youth football tournament on the Adriatic coast during Easter
description: Tournament for children from different countries held in Croatian coastal towns. "We invite your team to the cozy Croatian places of Pula and Medulin! On Easter we are organizing a wonderful tournament for children from different countries!" Teams play group stage matches followed by playoff rounds with consolation games. Winners receive cups; other participants receive cups, medals and diplomas.

name: Cruyff Football Tournament
shortDescription: Johan Cruyff International Youth Tournament for strong clubs in Salou
description: The Esportiu Futbol Salou Complex invites you to a magical world of football and enjoyment at the Johan Cruyff International Youth Tournament. Dozens of top academies from around the globe will gather in an inspiring setting to honour the legendary player and coach with thrilling matches. With a mild climate, outstanding accommodations, ideal game conditions, pools, and access to the sea and beaches, the tournament is set to be the top winter event.

name: Cupa Mării Negre August
shortDescription: Youth football tournament combining competition with relaxation on the Black Sea coast
description: In August, the Marea Neagră complex will host the Cupa Mării Negre, a youth football competition bringing together opponents from across the Balkan Peninsula. Young footballers will have the opportunity to test their abilities against international rivals while also enjoying the seaside atmosphere and exploring nearby attractions.

name: Cupa Mării Negre Iulie
shortDescription: Children's football tournament at Black Sea seaside with mud therapy at Lake Techirghiol
description: Football tournament at the Marea Neagră complex where several dozen academies from across the Balkan Peninsula compete. Features seaside recreation and local attractions including Black Sea beaches and therapeutic mud treatments.

name: Dana Cup Hjørring
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in northern Denmark with thousands of teams competing annually
description: Hjörring is a small town in the north of Denmark, with about 25 thousand people. The number of city dwellers is doubled once a year during one of the largest youth tournaments on the planet. Today, Dana Cup Hjørring is the most international tournament in the world, where 90% of foreign teams from all over the world participate. The Dana Cup Hjørring Festival first edition was in 1982. The first tournament was attended by 222 teams from 12 countries. Nowadays, more than 1000 teams from more than 40 countries of the world participate in the event annually.

name: Dana Cup Mini
shortDescription: International children's football tournament in spring with same organization as Dana Cup summer event
description: A spring version of the Dana Cup summer tournament offering the same fields, conditions, and organization. The tournament features international children's football with bright colors and strong participant attention. Teams are divided into groups with winners advancing to final competition for places 1-4, runners-up competing for 5-8th places, and so on. First 4 teams receive trophies and medals, plus special prizes for best players in final matches.

name: Dolomiti Junior Cup
shortDescription: International youth football event in the Dolomites combining competition with mountain atmosphere
description: An international youth football event held at Piani di Luzza in Forni Avoltri, Italy, surrounded by dramatic Dolomite peaks. First organised in 2025, it offers well-organised competition with professional organisation and mountain charm as a summer meeting point in Northern Italy.

name: Donosti Cup
shortDescription: Well-known football tournament in the Basque Country near the border with France in San Sebastian
description: Welcome to the Basque Country in Spain to the well-known football tournament Donosti Cup, which takes place near the border with France in the resort town of San Sebastian! The attractive landscape of the mountains, beautiful beaches on the shores of the Bay of Biscay, beautiful promenades and cosy restaurants with amazing cuisine will make the trip to the tournament unforgettable! Several hundred teams from many countries from all over the world take part in Donosti Cup annually.

name: Donosti Masters Cup
shortDescription: Soccer tournament for adult and veteran teams in San Sebastián, Spain
description: A soccer tournament for adult and veteran teams. The competition features teams including Real Sociedad, Real Union, and Castilla, with many former players from Spain's 2nd and 3rd divisions. Amateur clubs from Spain, France, England, Italy, the Netherlands, Colombia and Argentina participate. Founded in 2013 with initial 16 teams in the 35+ category, the tournament has expanded to include 45+, 50+, and 30+ female categories, with 56 teams participating.

name: Dortmund Cup June
shortDescription: An exciting adult football event with trophies, festive activities, and sightseeing at Signal Iduna Park
description: A football competition for adult participants featuring the tournament itself, a festive dinner, a quiz evening, and a guided tour of Signal Iduna Park, the iconic home arena of Borussia Dortmund. Participants explore the city's vivid character, parks, cathedrals, cafés, traditional breweries, and lively nightlife.

name: Dortmund Cup May
shortDescription: A vibrant youth football event with diverse cultural program, prizes for all participants, and city attractions
description: Welcome to the large youth football tournament Dortmund Cup, where we have prepared a rich programme that brings together football, enjoyment, and team-building! Young participants will be able to take part in a PlayStation competition, explore the city's landmarks, and even attend a Borussia Dortmund match. We organised the Dortmund Cup for the first time during the Pentecost holiday in 2025. Come and enjoy a wonderful time filled with football.

name: Dragan Mance Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament for children held in Belgrade at FC Partizan's sports center
description: International football tournament dedicated to the memory of tragically deceased young player of Serbian Partizan. Held at magnificent playing fields of the club's football base with all matches in one place. Several games broadcast live on Partizan's TV. Hosts approximately 200 clubs from European countries annually.

name: Dufour International Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament in Belgium featuring strong clubs from across Europe
description: A football tournament held in Molenbaix, Belgium, attracting top Belgian academies and clubs from France, the Netherlands, and Germany. Participants compete in group stages followed by semi-finals or quarter-finals, with medals awarded to all players and coaches, cups to the top 4 teams, and individual prizes for best field player and goalkeeper.

name: Duinrell Easter Youth Cup
shortDescription: Multi-day youth football tournament with accommodation at Duinrell Amusement Park
description: Enjoy a multi-day youth football tournament with accommodation at Duinrell Amusement Park! Play exciting matches and discover endless fun: thrilling rides, a subtropical swimming paradise, arcades, bowling, mini golf, bubble football, live music, karaoke, and a beach within walking distance. The perfect mix of football, adventure, and relaxation – all in one place!

name: Dunamenti Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament part of Hungary's largest competition series
description: Welcome to the international football tournament Dunamenti Kupa, part of one of Hungary's largest competition series. The event brings together top academies from many countries. In 2019, on Hungary's national holiday, October 23rd, the inaugural edition was successfully organized. Participants included squads from Poland, Serbia, Slovakia, Romania, and most Hungarian professional clubs, showcasing thrilling matches, high-quality tactics, and impressive technique.

name: Dunamenti Kupa Autumn
shortDescription: Top youth football tournament in Budapest with international participants and awards
description: The biggest youth football event in Hungary, where talent, passion, and competition come together. Strong clubs from different countries deliver exciting matches, showcasing top-level tactics and skills.

name: Dunamenti Gála
shortDescription: One of Hungary's most prestigious football competitions
description: Prestigious football tournament inviting Hungary's strongest clubs and academies from neighbouring countries. Only winners of qualifying tournaments and strong teams from other nations participate. After group stage, all teams continue competing until final positions determined. Top three receive trophies, medals, and certificates; other squads receive diplomas. Special prizes awarded to best players and coaches in each age category.

name: Dunamenti Kupa Summer
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Budapest bringing together elite academies and strong national clubs
description: The Dunamenti Kupa is a major youth football event hosted in Budapest, bringing together elite academies, strong national clubs, and rising talents from nearby countries. It is designed as a high-intensity competition where technical skill, discipline, and teamwork are tested in equal measure. First held in 2019, the Dunamenti Kupa quickly established itself as a respected fixture in the youth calendar.

name: Dupnitsa Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament for children in Dupnitsa, Bulgaria
description: International children's football tournament offering accommodation, transfers, and prizes. Features age groups from B7 to B12 with group stage followed by elimination finals. Awards cups, medals, and statues to top performers and coaches.

name: Dutch Super Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Ommen with access to Slagharen amusement park
description: International tournament held in Ommen where teams are placed on Slagharen amusement park territory with free attraction access. Teams play qualifying games in groups, followed by playoff and consolation stages. Prize-winners receive cups; all participants get cups, medals, and diplomas. Fair Play prize, best scorer, and best goalkeeper awards given per category.

name: E-22 Youth League
shortDescription: Professional international football tournament in Bari with top academies from Italy, Spain, UK and beyond
description: Professional international football tournament in Puglia's Bari featuring top football academies. E-22 Youth League has existed since 2023, with participation from strongest clubs across Italy, Spain, UK and other countries. Tournament offers vibrant atmosphere and competitive environment.

name: East Venice Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament on the Italian coast in Bibione and Caorle
description: A colorful international youth football tournament for teams of all levels held in the small resort towns of Bibione and Caorle on the Italian coast. The tournament features excellent playing conditions, various opponents, and access to a campsite with a water park. Participants can enjoy activities like horseback riding, cycling, visits to amusement parks and aquariums, with organized tours to Venice available.

name: Eindhoven Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament at huge stadium with prizes, souvenirs, lakeside camping fun, and top European clubs
description: Eindhoven Cup invites you to an international youth football tournament where participants will compete for two days on a real football stadium! For accommodation, we have selected a cosy lakeside camping site with cottages, children's activities, a mini-zoo, and a swimming pool. A major football weekend awaits you here, featuring clubs from the Premier League!

name: Elite Neon Cup
shortDescription: Prestigious youth international football competition held in Greece with top European teams
description: Elite Neon Cup is a prestigious youth international football Greek competition held at Ranch sports base with Wild West-style architecture. Top teams like BVB Dortmund, Liverpool, Galatasaray, Partizan, and Dinamo Moscow have participated. Tournament features preliminary group matches followed by finals. Top three teams receive cups, all participants get medals, with awards for MVP, top scorer, and best goalkeeper.

name: Elite Neon Cup Autumn
shortDescription: One of the strongest youth football tournaments in Greece and Europe
description: Representatives of famous clubs from the Balkan Peninsula, Italy, Georgia, the Netherlands, Great Britain, Turkey, Serbia, Germany and others meet in Athens. The 10th edition tournament features group stage competition followed by playoffs for top teams. All players receive medals and top three teams receive trophies.

name: Elite Neon Cup Spring
shortDescription: A top international youth football tournament in Athens. Compete against elite clubs from Europe & beyond.
description: The most famous clubs from Europe and beyond will gather at the Elite Neon Cup, a prestigious international youth football tournament held this spring in Athens. Expect high-profile opponents from the UK, Greece, Brazil, Serbia, Spain, Italy, and other countries. The Elite Neon Cup has been running since 2015 and has established itself as one of the most well-organised and competitive tournaments, boasting an impressive roster of participants and a high level of play.

name: Elite Talent League Tbilisi
shortDescription: International youth football tournament welcoming clubs from different countries to Tbilisi
description: The Elite Talent League is an international youth football tournament, welcoming clubs from different countries to Tbilisi. Combining competitive action with Georgian hospitality, the event offers young footballers an outstanding sporting experience supported by modern facilities and professional organisation. Launched in 2026, the competition welcomed clubs from Armenia, Georgia, and Russia in its inaugural edition.

name: Elsass Spring Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Kehl, Germany across multiple age categories
description: Tournament taking place in Kehl, Germany near Strasbourg, France. Teams play qualifying games in groups, followed by playoffs and consolation matches. Awards include main cups for top 3 teams, small cups and medals for others, Fair Play prize, and individual awards for best scorer and goalkeeper per age category.

name: Emirates Youth International Winter Cup
shortDescription: Exciting football tournament in Dubai with professional organisation at a state-of-the-art complex
description: The Emirates Youth International Winter Cup brings together leading academies from different parts of the world. The debut edition took place in 2025. The competition begins with a group stage, from which the two best teams progress to the final phase. Trophies and medals are awarded to Champions and Finalists in each age category, plus individual prizes for Golden Boot, Most Valuable Player, and Most Reliable Goalkeeper.

name: Esei Madrid Elite Cup
shortDescription: Special football tournament for strong youth players in Madrid and surroundings
description: Play against the best players in the Esei Elite Madrid Cup. This is the deepest immersion in football! The competition will take place in the suburb of Madrid - Mostoles city and will host many professional academies of La Liga, Ligue 1, Eredivisie and Serie A.

name: Euro Kup
shortDescription: International football tournament for young players to compete against famous clubs
description: International football tournament designed to give youth players opportunity to trial their strengths against professional academies. Group stage format with 2 teams qualifying to finals, remaining teams in consolation games. All teams receive trophies regardless of placement.

name: Eurosport Autumn Cup
shortDescription: International autumn football tournament in Macedonia with strong European clubs and modern stadiums
description: Don't miss your chance to take part in the Eurosport Autumn Cup! We promise a broad lineup of strong football academies from various European countries. Participants will enjoy very good facilities and state-of-the-art stadiums in the cities of Kumanovo and Skopje. The tournament was first held in 2019, featuring local squads and opponents from neighbouring countries. Over the years, we have transformed this competition into a prestigious international event, welcoming clubs from Spain, Portugal, Turkey, Croatia, Serbia, Slovenia, and many more.

name: Eurosport Spring Cup
shortDescription: Spring football tournament with top-tier academies competing in Kumanovo, Macedonia
description: Registration for the spring football tournament Eurosport Cup is underway. Since its first edition in 2019, the tournament has evolved from hosting local and Serbian clubs to attracting renowned squads from Portugal, Spain, Turkey, Serbia, Croatia, Bulgaria, and beyond. Over the past five years, it has grown into one of the most prominent youth football competitions in the region, featuring outstanding sports complexes in Kumanovo and Skopje.

name: Evima Cup Bansko
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Bansko with natural grass pitches, famous rivals, and mountain views
description: Head to Evima Cup in Bansko, a mountain resort with the purest air and wonderful views. At this celebration of football and friendship, magnificent grass pitches, strong and famous opponents, and an incredible atmosphere await. Winners meet football legends like Hristo Stoichkov and Dimitar Berbatov. The tournament has run since 2010, hosting clubs from over 20 countries across multiple continents.

name: Tournoi Fébus
shortDescription: Annual football competition for young players in Ariège, southwestern France
description: Exciting annual football competition held in the scenic Ariège department near Foix. Brings together local clubs and international competitors. The 19th edition was held in 2024, attracting renowned national teams and international powerhouses. Competition features group stage, Champions League and Europa League rounds, followed by knockout phase with penalty shootouts for draws. Winners receive trophies; all players receive medals or commemorative prizes.

name: Festival Scuole Calcio Mirabilandia
shortDescription: Football Schools Festival supported by Mirabilandia amusement park in Cesenatico
description: An exciting sporting weekend in Cesenatico with the Football Schools Festival, supported by the Mirabilandia amusement park. The opening ceremony features a colorful show and ceremonial parade of all participating teams at Mirabilandia, where every guest receives free two-day admission to attractions.

name: Finest Pihlis Elite Cup
shortDescription: International elite football tournament for children in Helsinki
description: International tournament for children held in Helsinki, Finland. Featuring preliminary stages and playoffs for all places in the group. Winner receives cups; top three receive medals. Includes free accommodation for 1 coach, free stadium entrance, and free opening ceremony/finals access.

name: FIT Promises Edition
shortDescription: Footvia International Football Tournament near Lloret de Mar and Santa Susanna on the Costa del Maresme
description: Football tournament featuring strong opponents, famous European academies including PSV Eindhoven, Olympique de Marseille, Benfica SL, FC Barcelona, RCD Espanyol and similar clubs. Located near resort towns with sunny beaches, warm weather, hotels with swimming pools and beach parties.

name: FIT Summer Edition
shortDescription: Join the FIT Cup on the Costa del Maresme! Compete with top academies, enjoy sunny beaches & explore Barcelona's famous sights.
description: Footvia International Tournament (FIT Cup) has been organised for many years on the Costa del Maresme in the vicinity of Barcelona. The tournament gathers leading football academies from Spain, Portugal, Great Britain, France and other countries. Maresme is a tourist destination with sunny weather, cozy hotels and clean beaches.

name: Florence Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Florence with games at modern Italian complexes
description: Welcome to the youth football tournament Florence Cup! Millions of tourists annually contemplate the beauty of this stunning city, shrouded in secrets, beliefs, mysteries and traditions. The Florence Cup has a great success every year, first of all thanks to the amazing city and the fact that the games are played in the most modern football complexes in Italy, such as Coverciano, the base of the national team! For the first time, the Florence Cup was held in 2016. Participants will appreciate the level of organization of the competition, enjoy games and walks around the city and its sights. Florence is waiting for you to enjoy ancient history and play in a prestigious football tournament.

name: Football Cup Hercegovina
shortDescription: International youth football tournament uniting top squads from the region with exciting matches and cultural experiences
description: International youth football tournament held across several towns in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Aims to provide serious challenge for footballers and coaches, attracting strongest football academies from Croatia, Bosnia, Montenegro and other countries. First edition in 2023 featured 12 squads; 2024 hosted over 100 participants from various nations.

name: FootballMind Tournament
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Katerini, Greece with elite teams and beach experiences
description: We suggest traveling to Katerini, Greece, for the FootballMind Youth Tournament! Here, you can experience thrilling matches on exceptional football pitches, alongside the city's famous sandy beaches and scenic attractions. This year, we're pulling out all the stops to bring renowned rivals to the event. The first FootballMind Tournament took place in 2024 and attracted clubs such as FC Leeds United, Deportivo La Coruña, PAOK, Red Star Belgrade, Panatinaikos FC and other star academies.

name: FootballMind Tournament May
shortDescription: International youth football event with strong opponents, natural grass pitches, and seaside setting
description: The FootballMind tournament is an international youth football event that brings together well-known clubs from different countries. Come to us if you want to gain experience against strong opponents, play on natural grass pitches and spend an excellent time by the sea. The first edition took place in 2024. Participating academies include SC Braga, AS Roma, SS Lazio, FC Steaua Bucharest, FK Crvena zvezda, PAOK FC, K Beerschot VA, Panathinaikos FC and others.

name: FootF'est
shortDescription: International children's football tournament in Marly bringing together around 1000 young players annually
description: In the small town of Marly, on the outskirts of Metz, the FootF'est children's international football tournament brings together around 1000 players from local, regional, foreign and professional clubs competing for the prestigious trophy. Countries participating include France, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Serbia, USA, Belgium, and Germany.

name: FootF'est Girls
shortDescription: Wrap up your summer with an unforgettable football adventure at the FootF'Est Girls international tournament
description: International tournament for young female players held annually in Montigny-lès-Metz, attracting rivals from across Europe. Features high-energy matches, exceptional talents, and cultural exchange opportunities. Consists of 2 group stages with Champions, Challenge, and Hopefuls groups, followed by elimination matches.

name: Footmania Tournament
shortDescription: Popular youth football event in Caldas da Rainha, Portugal uniting talented squads
description: Footmania Tournament is one of the most celebrated youth football events in Portugal, uniting talented players from across the country and beyond. Hosted in Caldas da Rainha—a town renowned for its historical charm and scenic surroundings—the competition promises a memorable experience for both participants and spectators. Founded in 2014 as FootMania Oeste, the tournament has grown rapidly into a great football competition, welcoming thousands of footballers and hundreds of clubs. Prestigious opponents such as Atlético Madrid, SL Benfica, and Sporting CP have all participated.

name: Sud France Junior Tournament
shortDescription: Regional football tournament in Pignan featuring youth competitions and entertainment
description: Fantastic weekend tournament in Pignan with regional football clubs competing. Features live match broadcasts, fan zones with entertainment, interactive games, food stalls serving local cuisine, and community events. The 19th edition continues a tradition celebrating sport and culture in Occitanie region.

name: Freixo Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament for boys in Portugal near the Spanish border
description: Welcome to the Freixo Cup international football tournament for boys in Portugal! It will take place in the village of Freixo de Espada à Cinta, a couple of kilometres from the Spanish border, surrounded by mountains and wonderful nature! We will do our best to make your holidays and sporting events at a high level. Your team will enjoy the views from observation decks, swimming in the pool or river.

name: Freixo Femenino Summer Cup
shortDescription: International women's football tournament blending top competition with culture and nature
description: An exhilarating women's football tournament set in the picturesque town of Freixo, Portugal. Surrounded by breathtaking landscapes and rich cultural heritage, this competition unites talent and passion for the game. Beyond the intense matches, players and visitors can immerse themselves in local history, explore scenic nature trails, and savour delicious regional cuisine.

name: Frem Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament for U14/U15 age groups in Copenhagen, Denmark
description: The Frem Cup is an international football tournament held in Copenhagen, Denmark. Created to become one of the strongest youth events in Scandinavia, it brings together elite European academies alongside top Danish and international opposition. The inaugural Frem Cup was held in 2026.

name: Friendship Cup Barcelona
shortDescription: International football tournament for youth in Barcelona, Spain
