description: Tournament where children can experience their abilities and compare themselves with peers from other continents. Features group stage followed by playoff rounds. Winners receive cups, medals, and diplomas.

name: Friendship Summer Cup
shortDescription: One of Turkey's largest international children's football festivals
description: International children's festival combining sports and recreation. Teams from different countries compete across age groups. Includes accommodation, meals, airport transfers, and awards ceremony with medals and trophies for top 4 finishers in each age group.

name: Funchal Futsal Cup
shortDescription: International futsal tournament on the island of Madeira offering cultural exchange and top competition
description: The international futsal tournament Funchal Futsal Cup has for many years offered athletes experience, enjoyment, and the chance to connect with other nations through cultural exchange. Held on the island of Madeira, the event also promises a beautiful and varied stay, complemented by a distinctive local cuisine. Since 2016, the Funchal Futsal Cup has delighted its guests with intense rivalry among opponents from across the globe.

name: Future Stars Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament for children in Carmagnola, Italy
description: International football tournament combining football with cultural heritage of Carmagnola, a medieval town in Piedmont near Turin. Competition features qualifying group matches followed by Gold/Silver finals. Awards cups to top three teams and medals to all players.

name: Futuri Campioni
shortDescription: Elite football tournament featuring teams from Italy and around the globe
description: Exciting football tournament with elite teams competing for victory. Features group stage format followed by knockout rounds. All participating teams receive trophies. The tournament offers a welcoming atmosphere and memorable experience both on and off the field.

name: Gallini Cup
shortDescription: Prestigious international Italian football competition hosting teams from different continents
description: The Gallini Cup is described as "the most prestigious international Italian football competition." Since 1999, it has hosted hundreds of teams from different continents. Teams are divided into groups of 4-5 teams playing round-robin, with top two advancing to playoff A and remaining teams to playoff B. All participants receive trophies, with medals for tournament winners and individual awards for young talents.

name: Gallini Cup Budapest
shortDescription: Famous football tournament in Budapest with youth teams from across Europe
description: One of the most famous football tournaments in Hungary, held at Ujpest FC sports complex with 8 fields. Features preliminary group stages followed by quarterfinals. All teams receive trophies, with individual awards for best players. Tournament winners receive medals and free accommodation at Gallini World Cup in Italy.

name: Gallipoli Elite Top Cup
shortDescription: Youth football near Lecce with competitive matches, seaside atmosphere, and cultural highlights in a unique setting.
description: Experience football on the southern coast of Italy with Gallipoli Elite Top Cup, held close to Lecce and Baia Verde Beach. Games are played in a well-organised setting, combining the competition with high level academies and time by the sea in a relaxed and enjoyable environment.

name: Garda Girls Festival
shortDescription: International girls' football tournament held on the coast of Lake Garda, Italy
description: International football tournament for girls' teams from European countries, including representatives of well-known football academies. Tournament features group rounds followed by playoff stages. Participants receive medals, and top three winners in each age category are awarded trophies. Includes welcome drink, free accommodation for one coach, guide services, and stadium access.

name: Gardaland Cup
shortDescription: International children's football tournament supported by Gardaland amusement park
description: Experience the Gardaland Cup, a children's football tournament supported by the amusement park of the same name. The fantastic atmosphere of an international competition, the amazing beauty of Lake Garda and the huge Gardaland Park are waiting for you! All the matches and accommodation of the guests will be organized in several municipalities near the lake.

name: Gerês Minis
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in northern Portugal with mountain views, strong teams and Peneda-Gerês National Park nearby
description: A youth football tournament held in northern Portugal known for Peneda-Gerês National Park, mountain views and green landscapes. Strong teams and a lively football atmosphere make it a memorable summer experience for young players. The tournament was introduced in 2025 to create a well-organised summer competition for young players.

name: Geres Summer Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Peneda-Gerês National Park combining high-level football with nature and outdoor adventure
description: The Gerês Summer Cup is an exciting international youth football tournament for boys, hosted in the picturesque village of Gerês, Portugal. Surrounded by the breathtaking landscapes of Peneda-Gerês National Park, this event combines high-level football with the beauty of nature and outdoor adventure. Beyond the matches, players can take part in river activities, unwind in thermal baths, and indulge in traditional Portuguese dishes like bacalhau à lagareiro and Vinho Verde. Gerês Summer Cup has been running since 2023 and has grown into a very popular football event in Portugal.

name: Germany Arendsee Ascension Cup
shortDescription: Junior football tournament in Arendsee, Germany
description: Junior football tournament taking place in Arendsee, nestled between Berlin and Hamburg near a stunning lake. Features professionally maintained football pitches, picturesque landscapes, parks, and forests with opponents from across Europe. Participants divided into groups with top two advancing to finals. First three places awarded cups; all players receive medals and diplomas.

name: Germany Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Arendsee next Easter
description: International youth football tournament featuring teams from Germany, Austria, Poland, the Netherlands, and other countries. Teams compete in groups with top finishers progressing to finals. Activities include bouncy castle, football playground, speed shooting challenge, and tennis ball games.

name: Germany Arendsee Summer Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Arendsee with beach and water activities
description: Youth football tournament hosted in Arendsee on the shores of its namesake lake. Participants compete against clubs from Germany and other countries while enjoying sandy beach, water slides, pedal boats, and rowboats. The Germany Cup series has welcomed squads from Europe, Asia, Africa, and Australia since 2017.

name: Germany Cup Alfsee
shortDescription: Join the German Cup in Alfhausen with top teams, stay at Alfsee adventure park, quality grass fields
description: Invitation to German Cup tournament in Alfhausen, Lower Saxony with accommodation at Alfsee adventure park. Compete against serious opponents from Germany and other countries on highest quality grass fields. Includes excellent living conditions, interesting cultural program for children and adults during football breaks.

name: Germany Cup Arendsee
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Arendsee with natural fields on the lake, foreign academies and entertainment
description: In the charming town of Arendsee, located between Germany's two largest cities, Berlin and Hamburg, and close to the picturesque lake bearing the same name, the youth football competition Germany Arendsee Cup will take place. The sports venue is situated directly on the shores of Lake Arendsee, opposite a leisure complex featuring an outdoor swimming pool with a sandy beach and a water slide. The Germany Arendsee Cup has been organised since 2018, and over the years it has welcomed numerous football collectives from Germany, the Netherlands, France and the United Kingdom.

name: Germany Cup Brahmsee
shortDescription: International tournament on the shores of Lake Brahmsee with strong teams, excellent prizes and entertainment
description: Exciting youth football tournament in the picturesque Lake Brahmsee region offering quality opposition from different countries and an entertainment programme. Brahmsee is surrounded by forests and meadows with nearby villages featuring cafés and rural charm.
availability: Registrations for next season not yet open

name: Germany Cup Frankfurt
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Frankfurt am Main with age groups B9-B15
description: Visit this football tournament in Frankfurt am Main, birthplace of Goethe and financial center. Participants from Germany, Europe, and Africa compete. Features hospitable atmosphere, multiple matches, contests and fun games between matches. All teams advance to semi-finals from groups. Three final stages: Gold Final (top 2), Silver Final (next 2), Bronze Final (rest). Winners receive trophy, diploma, and cash voucher. Second place teams receive trophy, certificate, and medal.

name: Germany Cup Kehl
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in southwestern Germany near the French border
description: The international youth football tournament Germany Cup Kehl invites participants to southwestern Germany, near the French border. This prestigious competition unites local football academies and international participants, offering an intense and exciting sporting experience. Teams compete in group stages with top finishers advancing to play-offs. All players receive medals and diplomas, with trophies for the top three places in each age group.

name: Germany Cup Magdeburg
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Magdeburg with teams from across Europe
description: International youth football tournament held in Magdeburg, Saxany-Anhalt. Features multiple age categories playing on natural grass fields with entertainment programs. Teams compete in group stages advancing to gold, silver, and bronze finals. Winners receive cups, diplomas, and cash vouchers. Tournament organized by company running events since 2012 across 9 German locations annually.

name: Germany Cup Munich
shortDescription: Thrilling Germany Cup youth football tournament in Munich with fierce matches and Bavarian cultural exploration
description: The spectacular Germany Cup youth football tournament in Munich offers thrilling battles on the pitch and the opportunity to explore the Bavarian capital, with its vibrant squares, grand castles, renowned breweries, and fascinating museums. Established in 2017, the Germany Cup has expanded into a series of international competitions across different cities in Germany and neighbouring countries, inspiring young boys and girls to participate in the beautiful game.

name: Germany Cup Nürnberg
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Nuremberg with 8 age groups on natural grass pitches
description: Do not miss the opportunity to visit Nuremberg – the birthplace of the artist Albrecht Dürer – and take part in the international football tournament Germany Cup. The competition will be held across eight age categories at several sports venues in the city and its surroundings, offering excellent natural grass pitches, opponents from different countries and an entertaining programme at the stadiums.

name: Germany Cup Ortenau
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in the Ortenau region offering serious matches and a relaxing break
description: International football tournament across Schutterwald, Lahr, and Offenburg with participation from Germany, Austria, France and other countries. The tournament was first held in 2026 with German, Austrian and French clubs.

name: Germany Cup Regensburg
shortDescription: Prestigious youth football tournament in UNESCO World Heritage City
description: International youth football competition held in Regensburg, Bavaria. The tournament brings together young footballers from across the world to compete in a medieval UNESCO World Heritage setting. Since 2017, the Germany Cup series has been a landmark event on Germany's football calendar, with clubs from various continents participating.

name: Germany Cup Trier
shortDescription: International football tournament in Trier, Germany near Luxembourg border
description: We invite amateur and professional clubs to participate in the international Germany Cup, held near the border with Luxembourg in the ancient city of Trier, a place steeped in history dating back to the Roman era! We expect numerous squads from neighboring countries as well as from across Germany.

name: Germany Cup Venlo
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Venlo, Netherlands featuring teams from across Europe
description: Football tournament taking place in Venlo, Netherlands near the German border. Offers natural grass fields and competition between teams from various European countries. Features group stages advancing to semi-finals with Gold, Silver, and Bronze final divisions. Winners receive cups, certificates, and cash vouchers.

name: Germany Cup Verden
shortDescription: Annual youth football tournament in Verden, Germany with multiple age categories
description: A large-scale youth football tournament held in Verden, Lower Saxony featuring 7 football fields (mostly natural grass). Organized since 2012, attracting over 100 teams annually from Germany and neighboring European countries across multiple age groups.

name: Germany Dortmund Summer Cup
shortDescription: An international youth football tournament in Dortmund featuring professional and amateur clubs
description: Visit Dortmund in summer – the city and its suburbs offer a blend of rich football culture, industrial heritage and green park areas – and join us at the international football tournament Germany Cup Dortmund. The competition will take place across several sports complexes, where alongside matches for opponents from different countries, an entertainment programme will also be provided.

name: Germany Frankfurt Summer Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament in Frankfurt featuring multiple age groups and nations
description: Visit Frankfurt in summer – the birthplace of writer Goethe and Germany's financial hub – for this international football tournament held at several sports complexes in the city and suburbs, offering top-quality pitches, opponents from various countries, and entertainment at stadiums.

name: Germany Pfingsten Cup Berlin
shortDescription: International youth football tournament on Whitsun in Berlin with multiple age groups and competitive divisions
description: International youth football tournament featuring talented young footballers from local and regional clubs. All participants progress from group stage to playoffs: top two squads compete in Gold Final, next two in Silver Final, remaining teams in Bronze playoffs. Winners receive trophies; all players receive medals and diplomas.

name: Girls Football Festival
shortDescription: International football tournament for girls held on Croatia's Istrian Peninsula
description: International football tournament for girls held on Croatia's Istrian Peninsula. Charming resort towns including Pula, Rovinj, Medulin, and Poreč welcome participants, offering breathtaking sea views, delicious Croatian cuisine, and lively discos. The tournament first began in 2021.

name: Girl's Game Tournament
shortDescription: An exclusively female football cup in France, in the Beauce region, located near Fougères, 45 km from Rennes
description: Welcome to the Girl's Game Tournament, an exclusively female football cup in France, in the Beauce region, which is located near the city of Fougères, 45 kilometres from Rennes and 45 kilometres from the famous island-fortress of Le Mon-Saint-Michel on the shores of the English Channel. We offer you the chance to fight for the tournament's main trophy on delightful natural fields. Girl's Game was launched in 2023.

name: Giżycko Mazury Cup
shortDescription: A top youth football tournament in Poland's stunning lake district, mixing elite matches with nature & adventure
description: An international children's football tournament held in the unique Polish resort town of Giżycko, surrounded by a stunning landscape of lakes and forests. Young footballers battle for trophies and awards while experiencing the beauty of nature in an unforgettable setting.

name: Golden Cup
shortDescription: Professional youth football tournament in Lisbon featuring top European academies
description: Test your strength in the Golden Cup professional football tournament with the best youth teams competing in Lisbon for academy supremacy. Founded in 2022, this international event features qualifying teams from across Europe competing in group rounds with advancement to Gold or Silver League finals. All participants receive medals, with cups awarded to top three Gold finalists and Silver League winner. Additional prizes for fair play, best scorer, field player and goalkeeper.

name: Golden Cup Autumn
shortDescription: Elite youth football tournament in Lisbon fostering learning and international competition
description: The Golden Cup was held for the first time in 2022. This tournament was created to foster learning, bring together diverse nations and cultures, promote various methods of teaching football, and most importantly, to play, discover, and enjoy the game.

name: Golden Sand's Summer Cup
shortDescription: A seaside youth football tournament with top pitches, great hospitality, and exciting matches for all levels
description: The Golden Sand's Cup aims to promote the game among children and youth, offering excellent accommodation and high-quality pitches located near the sea. Over several days of competition, participants from professional and grassroots clubs experience warm hospitality and intense football action. The tournament has been held since 2023 and connects football squads from Moldova, Romania, Ukraine, Bulgaria, Poland, Croatia, Azerbaijan, Uzbekistan, Georgia, and beyond.

name: Golden Trophy
shortDescription: International football tournament near Barcelona in Premià de Dalt
description: The international Golden Trophy takes place in Premià de Dalt, a quiet hillside town on the Catalan coast, north of Barcelona. In 2025, the event reached its 4th edition, where clubs from three countries competed. The format begins with a group qualifying round, followed by a play-off stage in which all participants continue their path. Awards are presented to the Champion and the Finalist, as well as individual prizes for the best goalkeeper and the outfield player.

name: Torneo Campeones Granada
shortDescription: Join Torneo Campeones in Granada! Compete with top teams, win trophies & explore the stunning Alhambra.
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey to Granada for the prestigious Torneo Campeones! Featuring leading clubs from the city and whole Spain, and international participants, this tournament promises to leave a lasting impression on your heart. Torneo Campeones was held for the first time in 2015! Since then, we have already organised several tournaments in different cities and gathered hundreds of teams from Spain, Portugal, France and neighbouring countries.

name: Grand Prix Čatež Summer Trophy
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Slovenia with qualification pathway to Budapest finals
description: Football youth tournament hosted at an entertainment park featuring slides, swimming pools, and high-quality pitches. Part of a multi-stage Grand Prix Trophy competition where the 4 strongest Slovenian teams advance to the final tournament in Budapest. Teams compete in single group round with top 2 advancing to autumn finals.

name: Grand Prix Dolomites Summer Trophy
shortDescription: Football tournament in the Dolomite Alps with two trips to Budapest final
description: Youth football tournament held in Forni Avoltri featuring four teams competing on natural pitches. Top two teams qualify for final round in Budapest. All participants receive memorable albums and gifts; all teams receive cups and prizes.

name: Grand Prix Poreč Summer Trophy
shortDescription: Junior football tournament on Croatia's Adriatic coast with qualifying spots for Budapest finals
description: Junior football tournament held in Croatia on the Adriatic coast in Tar and Poreč. Features group round competition with top two teams from each age category advancing to final tournament in Budapest. Participants receive commemorative album, gifts, and awards. Beautiful beaches, grass pitches, and local attractions available.

name: Grand Prix Veronello Summer Trophy
shortDescription: Youth football tournament at Veronello Sports Complex in Italy
description: A football tournament for youth players at the Veronello Sports Complex featuring group round competition. Winners and runners-up qualify for final tournament in Budapest. Includes accommodation, meals, transfers, and access to facilities including pool and nearby attractions.

name: Grassroots Summer Cup Georgia
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Tbilisi promoting participation, skill development, and fair play
description: The Grassroots Cup Georgia is an international youth football tournament held in summer in Tbilisi, gathering leading football clubs from different countries and dedicated to promoting participation, skill development, and fair play among young footballers. The inaugural edition took place in 2023, and has since grown to include academies such as SC Braga, Dynamo Kiev, and Saburtalo.

name: Gulf Winter Cup Dubai
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Dubai with international competition and memorable Middle Eastern experience
description: The Gulf Winter Cup will give young footballers unforgettable memories of competition, Dubai's festive atmosphere and exciting leisure activities. Take part in one of the most thrilling youth football events in the Middle East. Since 2017, the Gulf Winter Cup has attracted ambitious academies from different countries, giving young players the chance to test themselves against international opponents in a highly competitive environment.

name: Hageland Cup
shortDescription: Strong and prestigious football tournament held in Belgium with teams from across Europe
description: The Hageland Cup has been held for several decades, hosting more than a hundred teams from almost all European countries. The tournament is held in several sports complexes located next to each other and within walking distance of team residences. On day one, each team plays 3 matches in their group. On day two, top teams compete for additional matches while others play for final placement. The first four places in each age category receive trophies and all participants receive medals.

name: Halloween Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Salou, Spain this autumn with games against foreign opponents
description: Halloween Cup invites young football teams to Salou, Spain, for an exciting international event by the Mediterranean Sea. This is a great opportunity for boys and girls to play against new opponents, feel a strong sporting atmosphere and share a memorable trip with teammates. The competition was first held in 2025. From its first edition, the event was created for international youth teams that want a competitive but friendly experience.

name: Halloween Pro Cup
shortDescription: A strong autumn youth football tournament in Turin, Italy featuring academies such as AC Milan, Juventus, Inter, Partizan and others
description: Welcome to one of Italy's exciting youth football tournaments — the Halloween Pro Cup, held in Turin! We offer intense matches against very well-known Italian, Serbian, German, French and Croatian clubs. The Halloween Pro Cup was first held in 2026, welcoming academies such as AC Milan, Juventus FC, Internazionale FC, Torino FC, FK Partizan from Serbia and others.

name: Helsinki Cup
shortDescription: One of Europe's largest and most traditional international youth football tournaments
description: The Helsinki Cup is one of the most traditional and international football tournaments in Finland and the third largest event of its kind in Europe. Held annually in the second week of July, this six-day tournament involves both girls and boys across multiple age categories. The tournament starts with group games, then continues with Play-Off elimination rounds. All participants receive diplomas, with awards for best players and teams in each age group.

name: Herbert Jacobi Turnier
shortDescription: Competitive youth football tournament in Maintal, Germany with leading European academies
description: High-level football tournament where participants compete with strong team spirit. Many German clubs require qualification. Hosted by academies including Borussia Dortmund, Eintracht Frankfurt, and FC Augsburg. Founded in 2015 to honor Herbert Jacobi's commitment to youth football development.

name: IberCup Christmas
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Portugal where clubs from across the globe compete by the Atlantic coast
description: IberCup is one of the world's most renowned football tournaments for children and youth. The IberCup Christmas Edition in Portugal features clubs competing in a vibrant international setting with pleasant winter climate, Atlantic coast views, and experience facing leading academies from Europe and beyond. In 2024, the tournament celebrated its third edition with high-level clubs from Portugal, Spain, Australia, Brazil, and other countries.

name: Ibiza Football Fun
shortDescription: International amateur football tournament for adults in Ibiza
description: International amateur football tournament held in Sant Antoni de Portmany, Ibiza. Teams compete in 7vs7 format on artificial fields. Tournament includes group stage and playoff rounds with minimum 3 games per team. Awards given to top 4 teams plus Fair Play prize. Established in 2012.

name: IDA Easter Cup
shortDescription: Children's football tournament in sunny Valencia this spring where teams can relax and meet top-tier teams
description: Join the IDA Valencia Easter Cup, an international youth football festival in sunny Valencia! Clubs from multiple countries compete in a professional yet friendly environment, gaining invaluable experience and making new friends. Launched at Easter 2025, the tournament quickly became a must-play event for youth teams, welcoming top academies from across Europe and offering a vibrant spring football celebration.

name: Idanha Cup
shortDescription: A premier youth football tournament in Idanha-a-Nova with top-tier organisation and official recognition
description: Step into the world of tomorrow's football stars at the Idanha Cup! Set in the picturesque village of Idanha-a-Nova, this dynamic youth football tournament brings together aspiring talents eager to make their mark on the game. With top-tier organisation, official recognition, and an electrifying atmosphere, this event is a must for anyone passionate about this sport. The 13th edition of the tournament took place in 2024! Over the years, the Idanha Cup has become one of the most anticipated events on the youth football calendar, drawing renowned clubs from across the footballing world.

name: Ilinden Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament for children held in Ilinden municipality near Skopje
description: Ilinden Cup is an international football tournament for children to be held in the municipality of Ilinden near the Macedonian capital Skopje, organised by the Grozdanoski football school. The tournament offers excellent conditions including natural grass pitches, modern hotels, warm weather and beautiful nature. First conducted in 2023, it has featured strong foreign clubs including RSC Anderlecht, VA Beerschot, FK Partizan, FK Vojvodina, and FK Vardar Skopje.

name: Imperium Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament in Rojales, Alicante with top football academies
description: Prestigious youth football event established in 2010. Brings together aspiring young players from elite clubs. Features group stage matches, tier divisions (Gold, Silver, Bronze), and culminates with semi-finals and finals. Top three teams receive trophies; all players awarded medals.

name: International Cringleford Cup
shortDescription: Kids football tournament near Norwich with high standards of competition organisation, well-maintained pitches and qualified referees
description: The International Cringleford Cup, a kids football tournament near Norwich, is starting this summer. Teams are welcome to take part. We are distinguished by our high standards of competition organisation, well-maintained pitches and qualified referees. Discover our hospitable region! The Cringleford Cup has been organised as an international football tournament since 2023.

name: International Esei Holiday Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament on the Mediterranean coast near Barcelona with quality venues and cultural attractions
description: Discover Barcelona and its surrounding areas together with the International Esei Holiday Cup, which will take place across several locations along the Mediterranean coast. Matches are played at quality sports facilities, providing an inspiring environment that combines football and leisure.

name: International Ladies' Challenge
shortDescription: Series of one-day female football tournaments in coastal south France
description: International Ladies' Challenge - a series of one-day female tournaments in picturesque coastal areas in south France. Features magnificent natural fields and proximity to the sea. Established in 2013, hosting over 1600 participants on tournament weekend, one of France's biggest women's tournaments. Preliminary round uses 4 groups of 4 teams (5 groups for youngest category), with top teams advancing to League 1 quarter-finals and others to League 2. All participants receive medals and teams receive trophies plus regional culinary gift boxes.

name: International Senior WinterCup Holland
shortDescription: The biggest winter football tournament in the Netherlands for adults
description: Get ready for the biggest and most thrilling football weekend of the winter in the Netherlands! With previous editions selling out in just several weeks, this is an event you won't want to miss. The International Senior WinterCup Holland made its debut in 2018 and has since become a highlight of the winter football calendar.

name: International Whitsuntide Tournament
shortDescription: Traditional Trinity Whitsuntide Tournament held annually in coastal Spain with over 100 teams from many countries
description: The traditional Trinity Whitsuntide Tournament has been held for many years in the coastal tourist cities of Spain - Santa Susanna, Malgrat and Pineda de Mar. For the first time the tournament began in 1983. Now every year more than a hundred teams from many countries of the world participate in the tournament.

name: Invincibili Kup
shortDescription: Kids' football tournament with leading international academies
description: A competition featuring teams from Italy, Spain, Czech Republic, England, Portugal, France and other countries. Preliminary group stage of 12 groups with winners qualifying for next stage. All teams receive trophies; best players awarded in goalkeeper, field player and scorer categories.

name: ÍscarCup Easter
shortDescription: International football tournament for children with teams from over 20 countries
description: Join us for the prestigious ÍscarCup Easter, an international football tournament for children, where teams from more than 20 countries meet. Celebrated for its meticulous organisation and inclusive tiered format, the event ensures every team remains actively engaged throughout. Both the competition and the vibrant city of Madrid promise unforgettable moments and an invaluable opportunity to foster the development of young talent.

name: ÍscarCup Torrejón
shortDescription: International children's football tournament among strong and famous clubs
description: International children's football tournament featuring elite clubs from Madrid, Barcelona, and foreign academies. Known for fine-tuned organisation and tiered system (Gold, Silver, Bronze phases) ensuring all teams participate. Tournament started in 2010 in Íscar, relocated to Torrejón de Ardoz.

name: ÍscarCup Vilanova
shortDescription: Youth international football tournament for elite academies in Vilanova i la Geltrú
description: International youth football tournament featuring strong and famous clubs from Spain, France, Portugal, Italy, Germany and other countries. The competition includes group rounds, divisional play (Gold, Silver, Bronze), and finals with cup awards and medals for all players.

name: Ischia Cup Memorial Carmine Silvitelli
shortDescription: Youth football tournament on Ischia Island with elite European academies
description: An extraordinary children's football tournament set against Ischia Island's natural wonders, featuring football academies from elite pro clubs across Spain, France, Italy, Finland and beyond. The event offers mesmerizing landscapes, architectural heritage, and top-level competition.

name: Ischia Cup Memorial Giovanni Oranio
shortDescription: Play on a stunning island, compete with top academies & enjoy breathtaking nature, architecture & local sights
description: Children's football tournament held on the picturesque island of Ischia. The cup has been running since 2009 and attracts European giants including AS Roma, AS Specia, Manchester City FC, Torino FC, and Juventus FC. Features group stage followed by play-off phase with trophies for winners, medals for all participants, and special prizes for best player, goalkeeper, fairest team, and best supporters.

name: Ischia Cup Memorial Mario Bottiglieri
shortDescription: Football tournament on stunning island of Ischia with top clubs, volcanic landscapes and Italian nature
description: Welcome to where unrealistically stunning views, amazing nature, volcanic landscapes and the smell of fruit trees - all this is the Italian island of Ischia and our coolest football Isola D'Ischia Cup featuring the best football clubs from Italy, Austria, France, Sweden, Spain and other countries. The first tournament took place in 2009. Then, every year, more and more well-known Italian clubs and leaders from other countries began to join us.

name: Ischia Cup Memorial Nunzia Mattera
shortDescription: Compete with top academies on a stunning island near Naples, enjoy thermal springs, volcanic views & gourmet cuisine!
description: Annual tournament on the island of Ischia near Naples featuring unrealistically cool views, amazing nature, thermal springs, volcanic rocks, and gourmet cuisine. The best football academies from Italy, France, Greece, Spain and other countries compete for the main trophy. History began with first small tournament in 2009.

name: Ischia Winter Cup
shortDescription: Youth football cup on Ischia Island with intense matches and Mediterranean scenery
description: An exciting youth football tournament on Ischia Island featuring group stage and playoff phases. The top three teams receive trophies, and all participants receive medals with special awards for best player and goalkeeper. The island offers stunning views including Aragonese Castle, thermal spas, and crystal-clear waters of the Tyrrhenian Sea.

name: iSport December Cup
shortDescription: Indoor football tournament in Tartu bringing together teams from the Baltics, Scandinavia and Europe
description: Tournament held in an indoor hall featuring teams from across the Baltics, Scandinavia and Europe. After group stage matches, all participants advance to knockout finals. Winners receive diplomas, medals and cups, with individual awards for best field player and goalkeeper.

name: iSport February Cup
shortDescription: Winter football competition in Tartu, Estonia for youth teams from Baltic States, Scandinavia and Europe
description: Cool winter football competition in the Estonian city of Tartu held in a modern indoor arena. Brings together about a hundred teams from the Baltic States, Scandinavia and other European countries. Offers professional organization, quality accommodation at low prices and educational tours. Teams divided into groups of 4-6, playing one round before advancing to knockout playoffs. Medals, trophies and diplomas awarded to top three finishers plus individual awards.

name: iSport January Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Tartu combining competitive play with Estonian winter leisure activities
description: The January iSport Cup is conducted in Tartu, Southern Estonia and combines convenient conditions for games, high professionalism of organization and leisure activities. Organized by FC Santos football club. Two rounds: subgroups and playoffs. All teams advance to playoffs. Winners of first three places receive medals, trophies and diplomas. Best field player and goalkeeper in each age group receive special personal prizes.

name: Istria Cup
shortDescription: Spring football tournament in Medulin, Croatia with teams from across Europe
description: The Croatian town of Medulin is located in the south of the country and together with the cities of Pula, Porec and Rovinj is a tourist resort center of the Istrian peninsula. There are from 70 to 100 teams from Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Italy, Romania, Germany, Slovenia and other countries who take part in the tournament every year.

name: Italia Super Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament held on Italy's Adriatic coast with multiple age categories
description: Annual tournament in coastal Italian cities from Cattolica to Rimini. "The tournament started for the first time since 1995 and annually gathers over than hundred teams." Features preliminary group rounds, playoff stages, and consolation games. Winners receive cups; all participants get medals and diplomas. Fair Play prize awarded to most correct team.

name: ITE International Tournament
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Terres de l'Ebre, Spain, set in a UNESCO Biosphere with strong clubs and unique natural surroundings
description: ITE is an international youth football tournament held in Terres de l'Ebre, Spain, a UNESCO Biosphere region known for its natural landscapes and Mediterranean atmosphere. The first edition took place in 2009. Over the years, the competition has developed into a well-established international youth event, welcoming clubs from La Liga, the Premier League, the Primeira Liga, and many other leagues.

name: ITT Kup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament held in Turin featuring top clubs and European academies
description: The ITT Kup football tournament is held in Turin, inviting teams from abroad to participate. This prestigious event regularly includes the city's top clubs, Juventus and Torino. It stands as the largest youth event in the Piedmont region, attracting numerous professional football academies from across Europe every year. A minimum of sixteen squads will compete in each age group. The first stage will see all participants playing three matches. Following this, a second group round will take place with three competitors, determining entry into the Play Offs for the main trophy or a consolation prize.

name: Ixina Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Charleroi, Belgium organized by Royal Gosselies Sports
description: Quality football tournament organized by Royal Gosselies Sports, founded in 1908. Features qualifying matches on day one and final round on day two. All participants guaranteed equal match play. Awards for best scorer, field player, goalkeeper, brightest fan, and Fair Play team.

name: JCup
shortDescription: Exceptional international football tournament for children in Salou with professional and amateur participants
description: Join an exceptional international football tournament for children - JCup in Salou. There are both professional and amateur participants from different continents! This competition has united professional and amateur clubs from different countries over the long time. The hallmark is high level of games and unrivalled organisation. In 2012, the first Joinville Cup was hosted in the U13 age category. After 8 years, the U11 boys category was added, and from 2024 one tournament is organised on the Spanish coast.

name: JetGen Junior Cup
shortDescription: A thrilling youth football tournament in Yalova, Turkey with famous clubs and scenic views on the Marmara Sea
description: The JetGen Junior Cup is one of the most interesting football tournaments in Turkey for children. Several age groups will compete for main prizes, and talented players will be watched by professional scouts from well-known clubs. The first edition took place in summer 2025 with top-level football academies from Turkey and abroad participating.

name: JetGen Junior Summer Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament on natural grass with strong academies, good awards and the warm sea
description: Youth football competition bringing together clubs from Turkey and abroad to play on natural grass pitches. Test your squad against top academies such as Fenerbahçe and Beşiktaş in a professional environment with scout attendance, qualified referees and full media coverage.

name: Junior European Cup
shortDescription: Join the Junior European Cup 2025 in Seville! Play at Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán, compete like pros & explore Andalusia's iconic sights.
description: Get ready for an unforgettable football experience at the Junior European Cup in Seville, the heart of Andalusia, hosted at the breathtaking Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán Stadium, with a capacity of 42,000 spectators. This tournament will bring together young footballers from across Europe, showcasing their skills just like professional adult squads. The Junior European Cup debuted in 2025 and will take place at Sevilla FC's main arena right after the conclusion of the La Liga season.

name: Junior Ravenna Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Ravenna, Italy with leading academies from Italy and abroad
description: Tournament in Ravenna hosting leading football academies of Italy and other countries. First edition was in 2019 as Ravenna Top Junior Cup. Teams divided into groups with circle play in second stage. All participants receive cups. Ravenna is the former capital of Western Roman Empire and Byzantine Empire with architectural monuments and museums.

name: Junior World Cup Antalya
shortDescription: Large-scale international youth football cup emulating World Cup format
description: Junior World Cup Antalya is a large-scale international youth football cup in Turkey. The tournament emulates the World Cup format with matches held in sports complexes that have hosted national team matches and Junior World Cup finals. Preliminary round participants are divided into groups with a minimum of 4 teams. The top 2 places advance to quarter-finals, semi-finals and finals. All players receive medals, and awards are given for best goalkeeper, player of tournament, goal scorer and fair play in each age category.

name: Junior XCup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Kemer, Turkey with top Turkish academies
description: International football tournament held in Kemer, Turkey featuring the strongest Turkish academies including Galatasaray, Fenerbahçe, Antalyaspor, and others. The tournament celebrated its 14th anniversary in 2024. Every player receives a medal, each squad is awarded a trophy, and team coaches receive a plaque.

name: Junior's Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Bulgaria's premier resort destination
description: Annual football tournament held in Albena, Bulgaria, featuring youth teams from European countries. Ranked as the 1st international tournament in Bulgaria, it offers natural grass fields, group stage with playoff progression, and awards for top performers across multiple categories.

name: Kemer Youth Football Tournament
shortDescription: Football competitions on natural grass pitches with Mediterranean beaches and mountain views
description: Welcome to the Kemer Youth Football Tournament in Turkey, staged this autumn on the Mediterranean coast. Set between the sea and the Taurus Mountains, the competition brings together strong youth academies for matches on excellent natural grass pitches.

name: Kempense Meren Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Mol, Belgium with international clubs and nature resort accommodation
description: The Kempense Meren Youth Football Cup takes place with clubs from the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany and other countries in a modern sports complex. Players and parents stay at Sunparks Kempense Meren village in a nature reserve with lakes, forest, birds and animals. The tournament features a productive weekend combining clean air, swimming, forest walks with high quality football.

name: KHS Autumn Cup
shortDescription: Pro level football tournament for youth teams in Malta
description: The KHS Cup, hosted in Malta, is a PRO football tournament for youth teams from around the globe. Malta's unique charm and love for football create an ideal setting for this competition. Compete in Mġarr against very successful teams from Italy, Germany, England, Denmark, Poland and other. The KHS Cup made its debut in 2021 and has since hosted renowned teams such as Juventus FC, Liverpool FC, Sporting Lisbon, Manchester United FC, Torino FC, etc.

name: KHS Christmas Cup
shortDescription: Competitive youth football tournament for U14 age category with strong international academies
description: KHS Christmas Cup in Mġarr, Malta, is a competitive edition attracting strong academies from different countries. Participants engage in strong matches against different opponents to test their team's level. First held in 2021, the tournament has grown steadily. Places are limited, so early registration is encouraged for this well-organised youth football event held in a mild winter climate.

name: U10 KHS Cup
shortDescription: International youth tournament in St Paul's Bay with top academies, medals for all, and excursions
description: Welcome to the island of Malta for the KHS Cup - International football tournament for children. This amazing island is ideal for football competitions, bringing diverse cultures together. St Paul's Bay awaits you, with games held in nearby Burmarrad, where you can compete against some of the most famous clubs. The KHS Cup tournament was held for the first time in 2021. Since then, we have welcomed top academies including Sporting, Liverpool, Inter, Barcelona and others.

name: U11 KHS Cup
shortDescription: Youth international football tournament organised in Malta
description: The KHS Cup is a youth international football tournament organised in Malta. Malta is a great place for football competitions, where football unites different cultures. Matches held in Burmarrad, St Paul's Bay. The first KHS Cup started in 2021 and hosts prestigious academies such as Manchester United, Liverpool, Juventus, Inter, Sporting and many others.

name: U13 KHS Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament for U13 age category in Malta
description: The KHS Cup is an international football tournament hosted in Malta. First launched in 2021, it welcomes academies and clubs from around Europe including Juventus, Aston Villa, Benfica, Barcelona, and top clubs from Malta, Poland, and Germany. The tournament features 11vs11 format matches on artificial fields with a minimum of 6 games guaranteed per team.

name: U14 KHS Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Malta featuring elite European teams
description: Boys' football tournament in Marsa, Malta featuring U14 age group (11vs11). Group stage followed by playoffs. Participating teams include Bayern Leverkusen, Liverpool FC, Balzan FC, FC Pisa, Swieqi United FC, Słodka Polska, Hamrun Spartans FC, and Lugano FC. Package includes accommodation, meals, transfers, city tour, and access to opening ceremony and finals.

name: KHS Cup
shortDescription: Malta junior football tournament for European teams
description: Experience your team at a Malta junior football tournament! The Maltese islands are located in the middle of the Mediterranean Sea and will enchant you with their beauty. We invite your club, children, coaches, players' families and supporters to compete against the leaders of European football! Since 2021 we are counting down the KHS Cup. Every year we have more and more big-name participants! Some of the strongest football academies from Italy, England, Germany, France and other countries took part in the tournament! Firstly, there will be group games! Next, all participants will qualify for the Play-offs, where they will define the final position. In the final round, in case of a draw in the main time of the match, a penalty shootout will be appointed. We will award the winners with trophies and all participating children will receive medals!

name: KHS Winter Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Malta attracting elite clubs from across Europe
description: Welcome to the beautiful island of Malta in winter! Inaugurated in 2021, KHS Cup has quickly become a prestigious event, attracting elite clubs. Each year, the competition is packed with thrilling matches and unexpected turns in the final standings.

name: Kings Cup
shortDescription: Top youth football tournament in Neu-Isenburg with elite clubs and natural grass pitches
description: International youth football tournament held in Neu-Isenburg, near Frankfurt. Features strong lineup of clubs, high-level matches, and top-quality natural grass pitches in one venue. Pays tribute to Helmut Stamer, legendary player of SpVgg 03.

name: Kings Cup Autumn
shortDescription: Kings Cup Spain in Puçol brings strong European squads together for thrilling matches and Mediterranean fun
description: International football tournament held in Puçol, Valencia region. Leading European squads participate in intense matches. Founded in 2010 in Estonia as Levadia Pirita Cup, organized in Spain since 2019.

name: Kings Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament held in Tallinn featuring professional clubs from across Europe
description: International tournament offering professional level competition where the strongest and most talented squads face off. The tournament has been held since 2024 every spring featuring professional clubs from Latvia, Poland, Lithuania, Finland, Sweden, the Netherlands, Spain, and Estonia. The preliminary stage consists of group matches with 4 to 6 participants, where all teams play against each other. The top one or two teams from each group advance to the playoffs. Every squad is ranked at the end of the tournament.

name: Kołobrzeg Anchor Cup
shortDescription: Top youth football tournament on the Baltic coast in Poland
description: Discover the Baltic Sea coastline with the Kołobrzeg Anchor Cup, one of the most prestigious international football tournaments for children held in Poland. Kołobrzeg, a charming city, is famous for its sandy beaches and historical significance. Young footballers test their skills competing against opponents from all over Poland and leading European countries. The tournament was first held in 2022.

name: Kraków City Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Krakow with teams from across Europe competing in a top sports park
description: Youth football tournament first started in 2011. Clubs play in a sports park with six fields on the edge of Krakow. Participants can explore Krakow's historic sites, markets and stunning old town. The tournament features a group stage followed by elimination rounds, with all teams guaranteed minimum 5 matches.

name: Kronos Aqualife Cup
shortDescription: Kids football tournament in Bulgarian Black Sea resort town combining quality football and entertainment
description: A children's football tournament held in Kranevo, Bulgaria, offering participants access to pool, beach, sea and stadium facilities. Teams play in groups of 4, with top teams advancing to elimination rounds. Includes daily entertainment programs with 24 animators, optional excursions to Balchik botanical garden and Varna dolphin performances.

name: DFA Nika Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament for children in a Ukrainian Black Sea resort
description: Tournament held in the Ukrainian resort of Lazurnoe on the Black Sea featuring many Ukrainian teams and international guests. The event includes group stage matches with top teams advancing to quarterfinals, awards for tournament winners and individual player achievements.

name: La Tordera Cup
shortDescription: Girls' football tournament in Spain with sun, sea, and fantastic sports complex
description: A girls' football tournament in Spain featuring matches and activities. Compete against strong clubs from Spain and other countries. The event includes accommodation, meals, and opportunities to explore Tordera's medieval charm, nearby beaches, and natural parks.

name: Lady's Pink Cup
shortDescription: Women's football tournament celebrating female athletes across multiple age categories
description: The Lady's Pink Cup football tournament promises to be an exciting journey, adding vibrancy to women's football. Held in Villeneuve-lès-Béziers and Cers, picturesque villages in the Hérault region with charming canals and quaint streets. The competition aims to advance women's football and empower female athletes globally. Teams compete in group stages with highest-ranked teams progressing to upper final phases. Trophies awarded for rankings plus special awards for Fair Play and Supporters.

name: Laola Cup
shortDescription: Premier football competition in Germany featuring top-quality pitches and international competitors
description: One of the brightest and grandest football competitions in Germany held at the Hamburger SV football center with 11 fields. Over 200 participants gather annually from over 20 countries. Features group stage with knockout playoffs, awards ceremony with trophies and medals, and nearby attractions including swimming pool and stadium tours.

name: LAR Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament bringing together teams from multiple nations
description: The LAR Cup is an annual youth football tournament held at the Corazza Sports Complex in Meaux, France. It features 64 teams from 15 countries competing across age groups B10 and B12 in 8v8 format. Teams are initially divided into groups, with top finishers competing in the Galactic Cup, followed by other cups based on placement. All participants receive medals and teams receive trophies. The tournament emphasizes friendship, respect, and sporting values among young players from amateur and professional clubs.

name: Trofeo dell'Autunno Lariano
shortDescription: International football cup for children in Lombardy near Lake Como
description: International football tournament bringing together strongest clubs from Italy and other countries. Features qualifying matches in groups followed by elimination finals. Trophies awarded to top three teams, medals for all players, special souvenirs for outstanding footballers.

name: Lazio Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament held in the Lazio region
description: Prestigious international football tournament featuring high-class clubs from Italian and foreign leagues. Group stage with at least 16 teams, medals for all participants, trophies for top three, and individual prizes for best player, goalkeeper, and scorer.

name: Lazio Cup Junior
shortDescription: Junior football festival in Frosinone with teams from across Europe competing in multiple age categories
description: Discover the Lazio Cup Junior football festival and explore Frosinone and Lazio region, rich in forests, mountains and rivers. Dozens of clubs from European countries compete for the cup. All listed junior players required to play minimum 1 of 3 halves. Eliminated teams offered friendly matches.

name: Lazio Women Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament for women's categories held in spring across the Lazio region
description: A youth football tournament held in spring in several towns across the Lazio region bringing together top academies from Italy, Canada, the USA, Denmark, Germany, and other countries. The tournament features group stage matches with top two teams qualifying for finals, participation medals for all, trophies for winners, Fair-Play prize, and individual awards for top scorer, best player, and best goalkeeper.

name: Lazio Cup Women Tournament
shortDescription: Global youth women's football tournament in the Lazio region
description: Step into the global spotlight of youth football at the Lazio Cup Women Tournament, hosted across several locations in the Lazio region, including Ferentino, Veroli, Rome and others. Compete with high-calibre squads from Italy and beyond. The women's category debuted in 2024. Minimum 16 teams in group stage, top two from each group progress to finals. All participants receive medals, top three teams receive trophies, and awards for fair-play squad, best player, goalkeeper, and top scorer.

name: Leclerc Hesdin Cup
shortDescription: Annual football tournament for children in Hesdin Marconne, Hauts-de-France
description: Register to the annual exciting football tournament for children - the Leclerc Hesdin Cup in the small town of Hesdin Marconne, Hauts-de-France region! Various European and French clubs participate and get the chance to play their favourite sport in a warm and friendly atmosphere over the weekend! Our club Olympique Hesdin Marconne Football has existed since 1929 and organises competitions for children. To this day, the OHMF management takes care that all players keep the memories and traditions of the club alive by hosting a great sporting and friendly event!

name: Leipzig Indoor Trophy
shortDescription: Annual winter indoor football tournament in Leipzig featuring youth age groups
description: Indoor Leipzig Trophy is held every winter in Leipzig. Competitions are held in the indoor arena with artificial grass 'Egidius Braun'. The tournament begins with qualifying games in groups, followed by playoff and consolation stages. Awards include cups, medals, diplomas, Fair Play prize, and best scorer/goalkeeper recognition.

name: LGSP Intercontinental Youth Cup
shortDescription: Elite youth football tournament in Porto featuring top European and Asian academies
description: Since 2022, the LGSP Intercontinental Youth Cup has brought together strong and dynamic clubs from Europe and Asia in Porto. Renowned clubs such as Wolverhampton Wanderers, Juventus, and Paris Saint-Germain have participated. The competition features group stage play followed by knockout rounds, with all players receiving participation medals and individual awards for Best Player, Best Goalkeeper, Top Scorer, and Tournament's Ideal Seven.

name: Liberec Trophy
shortDescription: Top youth football tournament in Czech Republic with elite pitches and stunning scenery
description: International football tournament for children in Liberec, Czech Republic, at the foot of the Jizera Mountains. Features top-class pitches and the chance to enjoy historical architecture, natural scenery, and welcoming atmosphere. First held in 2023, attracting competitors from Germany, Poland, Croatia, Bosnia, Austria and other countries.

name: Limburgse Peel Cup
shortDescription: A festive football tournament for high level clubs with visit to Toverland amusement park
description: The Limburgse Peel Cup football tournament will take place in the same name sports park. Participation in a festive tournament for high level clubs and a visit to the Toverland amusement park on a free day of the weekend. All events feature a rich programme of games and entertainment for children, including opening ceremony, fun raffles and award ceremony.

name: Lisbon Football Youth Cup
shortDescription: Welcome to the Lisbon Youth Football Cup, taking place at the University of Lisbon's large sports complex.
description: The tournament Lisbon Football Youth Cup is held in the sports complex of the University of Lisbon. The complex has 6 fields designed for football and rugby. The temperature in October in Lisbon can reach 30 degrees Celsius. For the first time, the tournament began to be held in 2017. It was attended by clubs from the UK, Portugal, Ireland, France, Sweden, both professional and amateur.

name: Lloret Cup
shortDescription: Children's football tournament in Lloret de Mar, Spain
description: Football tournament for children held in sports centers across Lloret de Mar, Tordera, Palafolls and Blanes. Clubs compete in groups with winners advancing to final round. Winners receive championship cup, finalist cup, and medals; all participants receive commemorative trophies.

name: Loriol's Cup International
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Provence with international teams and cultural experiences
description: The Loriol's Cup International is a youth football tournament held in southern France, in the Provence region. It brings together boys' squads and junior line-ups for thrilling matches on high-quality pitches, providing a football experience blended with the cultural charm of the area.

name: Loutraki Easter Soccer Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament held in Loutraki, Greece during Easter
description: The Greek region and Sport Camp football base invite teams to participate in the Loutraki Easter Soccer Cup, featuring games with opponents from different countries and relaxation on the coast of the Gulf of Corinth. Loutraki is located in the Argolis region, famous for ancient monuments and the Corinth Canal. The tournament has been held since 2012, attracting professional and amateur clubs from Greece, Russia, Estonia, the Netherlands, Turkey, and Ukraine. Competition begins with group stages where teams are divided into groups of 4, with the two best teams advancing to semifinals. All participants receive tournament gifts and diplomas, while winners receive trophies and medals. The price includes water, free accommodation for one coach, airport/railway station transfers, souvenir, free stadium entrance, and free access to opening ceremony and finals.

name: Maastricht Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament for juniors at MVV Maastricht stadium
description: High-level football weekend for juniors hosted at MVV Maastricht stadium. The tournament welcomes teams from Netherlands, Belgium, France, Great Britain, Germany and other countries. Group stage matches on day one, finals on day two. All teams advance through stages with consolation games. Teams stay at Landal GreenParks holiday parks with sports facilities and swimming pools.

name: Macedo de Cavaleiros Verão Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament in northern Portugal featuring strong opponents and mountainous natural beauty
description: Teams from different countries compete in a high-level football programme with strong organisation. The event takes place close to Albufeira do Azibo and Serra de Bornes, featuring lakes and green landscapes. Visitors can explore the area, follow walking routes, and experience regional cuisine.

name: MADCUP Football
shortDescription: International youth football tournament on Gran Canaria island
description: MADCUP Football is hosted in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, featuring one of the largest international youth football events in the world. Since 2021, it has brought together more than 2,500 participants from 49 countries. Participants compete in group rounds, with top squads advancing to MADCUP GOLD knockout stages and others continuing in MADCUP SILVER.

name: MADCUP
shortDescription: International football tournament featuring academies from elite clubs worldwide
description: International football tournament born in 2021 with Atletico Madrid support. Features representatives from Juventus, Real Madrid, Atletico Madrid, Lyon, Fenerbahce, PSG, Porto, Benfica and others. Competition includes group stage, play-offs and finals with Gold, Silver and Bronze rounds.

name: Madrid Easter Cup
shortDescription: Easter football tournament for children featuring elite clubs from Spain, USA, Portugal, and Japan
description: An Easter football tournament welcoming famous clubs such as Barcelona, Atlético Madrid, Porto, representatives from the USA, and other countries. Competition starts with group games, proceeding to Gold or Silver rounds in knockout format. All participants receive medals; trophies awarded to Gold and Silver round winners.

name: Madrid FEM Cup
shortDescription: Girls' football tournament uniting passion and energy in Madrid with top Spanish clubs
description: Immerse yourself in the thrilling atmosphere of this magnificent city with the Madrid FEM Cup, a girls' football tournament uniting passion and energy. Challenge formidable opponents representing leading academies of Madrid, while discovering the city's lively spirit and captivating charm. The Madrid FEM Cup made its debut in 2026, bringing together young footballers from Spain and across neighbouring nations.

shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Madrid for children and parents during holidays
description: Tournament in Madrid designed for children and parents to enjoy football with friends. Invites youth teams from Spain, Europe, America and Asia. Includes qualification and final rounds with trophies and medals for finalists. All participants covered by private injuries insurance.

name: Madrid International Christmas Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament during Christmas holidays in Madrid with strongest academies from around the world
description: Discover impressions with the Madrid International Christmas Cup in Spain's capital. Experience atmosphere with events day and evening. Best clubs from Madrid and other countries participate. Teams enjoy Spanish culture, history and cuisine. Tournament held since 2021.

name: Madrid International Cup
shortDescription: Compete with teams worldwide, experience Spain's rich culture & enjoy an unforgettable football tournament!
description: We invite you to the capital of Spain for the next Madrid International Cup! We promise you will feel the indescribable atmosphere of our city, become participants in an excellent competition between players from different countries and several continents. Enjoy Spanish culture, cuisine, centuries-old history and leave such a trip in your memory for a long time!! The Madrid International Cup tournament has been held since 2021 at different times of the year.

name: Madrid Koben Christmas Cup
shortDescription: Top-class youth football tournament during Christmas holidays in Madrid
description: Youth football tournament offering comfortable accommodation and modern sports facilities. Participants divided into groups with Stars, Golden, and Platinum play-offs. Winners receive cups; individual awards for most valuable player, top scorer, and goalkeeper.

name: Madrid Youth Cup Easter
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Madrid featuring teams from Europe, America and Asia
description: Easter youth football tournament in the prestigious Moratalaz area of south-east Madrid. Teams compete in age categories from B8 to B19. Tournament includes water for participants, guide services, and opportunities for stadium tours and training with Madrid academy coaches.

name: Madrid Youth Cup Summer
shortDescription: Annual international summer youth football tournament in Madrid
description: International tournament for children featuring strong youth football teams from Europe, Latin America, North America, and Asia competing at the Moratalaz sports complex. Teams are divided into groups playing round-robin matches, with winners advancing to playoffs. Awards include cups, medals, and special recognitions for best field player and goalkeeper.

name: Mallorca International Football Cup
shortDescription: The Vicente del Bosque Football Academy presents the Mallorca International Football Cup!
description: Since 2011, the Academia del Bosque has held the reputation of being one of the best player training and development projects in Spain, with over 13,000 players from 26 countries participating. The tournament will be held on the largest of the Balearic Islands - the sunny island of Mallorca. From 2015 to 2019, the tournament was played with only local Spanish clubs. The first Mallorca Football Cup with foreign participants took place in June 2022.

name: Mallorca International Women's Cup
shortDescription: Premier women's football tournament on the island of Mallorca featuring international clubs
description: Tournament organized by Vicente del Bosque Academy since 2011, attracting thousands of participants from over 25 countries. Features league and knockout-system final phases with medal awards for all participants and trophies for champions.

name: Mare Nostrum Cup Easter
shortDescription: One of Spain's largest international football tournaments in Salou
description: Annual Easter football tournament gathering over 10,000 boys and girls from different countries. Features preliminary group rounds with winners advancing to Final Stage, runners-up to Silver Stage, and other squads in consolation matches. Top four places awarded Cups; other teams receive commemorative plaques. Every player receives a medal.

name: Mare Nostrum Summer Cup
shortDescription: International summer football tournament in Salou at Mediterranean Sports Hub, 100 km from Barcelona
description: Celebration of football bringing together over 200 squads and 2,500 players annually from Europe, Asia, and Americas, uniting them with local Spanish academies in a global sporting event

name: Mare Pineta Summer Cup
shortDescription: Italian football competition for children with beach accommodation and facilities
description: A football competition for children held in Casalborsetti, Italy. The tournament features comfortable beach accommodation with swimming pools, tennis courts, beach volleyball, paddle courts, and nearby football fields. Groups are formed by ranking, with first-place teams advancing to the next group stage. All participating teams receive cups.

name: Marina Baixa Cup
shortDescription: Annual youth football tournament in Alicante province with La Liga academy participation
description: Held annually across several towns of Alicante province including Benidorm, L'Alfàs del Pi, Finestrat, and Teulada. Since 2009, the Marina Baixa Cup has become a benchmark for quality youth competitions in Spain, welcoming several hundred boys' and girls' collectives from different countries.

name: Maurepas Yvelines Cup
shortDescription: Quality youth football tournament with top facilities in Maurepas, France
description: The Maurepas Yvelines Cup gathers youth collectives in a lively football setting that promotes development, teamwork and positive sporting values. The football complex has several fields of premium quality. The tournament began in 1996, gradually expanding its geography and reputation, attracting numerous youth academies across France.

name: Maurepas Yvelines Coupe de Pâques
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in suburban Paris for ages B14 and B16
description: An exciting youth football tournament bringing together young talents from around the world. The tournament has been running for many years, celebrating its 18th edition in 2013. It features matches in two groups with eight strongest teams advancing to knockout stage. Every participating team receives a trophy and each player receives a medal.

name: Maurepas Yvelines Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament gathering talents from France and other European countries
description: An exciting youth football tournament near Paris featuring top European clubs in fierce competition. Competition starts with group stage, advancing top two teams to quarter-finals and knockout rounds. All participating teams receive cups and each player receives a medal.

name: Mediterranean Esei Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament in Gandia with group stage and playoff competition
description: Discover the Mediterranean Esei Cup in Gandia, close to Valencia. The tournament features a group stage followed by Gold or Silver playoff draws on a knock-out basis. "Gandia is famous for its wide beach of very fine and soft sand, picturesque nature, rocks, caves and orange groves." All players receive medals, cups, and figurines.

name: Mediterranean Football Cup
shortDescription: High quality football tournament with competition and celebration on and off the field
description: Discover a high quality football tournament that is sure to give you an unforgettable time of competition and celebration on and off the football field. The Mediterranean Football Cup will bring together clubs from around the world, you will have a great time in the circle of a noisy company, take a break from everyday hustle and bustle in comfortable rooms on the sea, and the best French chefs will pamper you with traditional dishes. The tournament has been running since 2021.

name: Mediterranean Girls Cup
shortDescription: Excellent football tournament for girls on the Mediterranean coast in France
description: Football competition attracting teams from different countries. Offers accommodation in high-level campsites and bungalows on the seashore. Includes water, entertainment discounts, stadium access, and full board. Tournament running since 2021 with previous participants from Ireland, England, Spain, Scotland, France and other countries.

name: Memorial Bruno Monti
shortDescription: Youth football tournament bringing together Italian and European academies
description: Welcome to the Memorial Bruno Monti in Turin, Italy. This youth football tournament is dedicated to the memory of the legendary goalkeeper of the 1940s who played for clubs such as Modena, Bari, and others. The competition brings together famous Italian squads and visiting participants from abroad.

name: Memorial Lombardi
shortDescription: Autumn youth football tournament in honour of Adriano Lombardi
description: International tournament held in Milan, Italy bringing together top academies and ambitious young players in a competitive environment focused on development and sporting values. Created in honour of Adriano Lombardi, the competition was established with the ambition of becoming a traditional event for youth teams and an important date in the Italian autumn football calendar.

name: Memorial Pavanello
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Caselle Torinese gathering top Italian and international academies
description: Youth football tournament held in honour of Rossano Pavanello, former president of Caselle Calcio. Gathers powerful Italian and international academies such as Juventus, Torino, Monza, Dinamo Zagreb and others to provide strong, meaningful matches for participants. First held in winter 2024, bringing together clubs from Italy, Croatia, Serbia, and Switzerland.

name: MFT Cup
shortDescription: International professional youth football tournament in Madrid featuring leading clubs from Spain and Europe
description: Memorial Manuel Fernández Trigo has been held since 2016 as a tribute to the legendary director of Real Madrid. The competition brings together well-known European academies and is played at a high level of difficulty. During the tournament, footballers will have chances to meet professional players from Los Blancos, visit Santiago Bernabéu Stadium and explore the club's Legends Museum.

name: MIC Football Tournament
shortDescription: Prestigious football competition on Costa Brava with top academies from 5 continents
description: MICFootball is a prestigious football competition held on the Costa Brava coast from Lloret Del Mar to Rosas. The tournament aims to give young talented players from around the world the opportunity to play with top foreign players and teams. Many major clubs and junior national teams participate, with notable alumni including Messi, Neymar, Piqué, Marcelo, and Coutinho.

name: MIC FootFem
shortDescription: Top girls' football tournament in Vic with elite clubs like Barcelona and Espanyol
description: MIC FootFem is an exclusively women's football tournament held annually in the comarca of Osona, within the charming Catalan city of Vic. The goal is to give aspiring female footballers the opportunity to gain professional experience surrounded by the game's strongest players. This girls' football competition was launched in 2024, with AE Santa Susanna, CD Fontsanta Fatjo and CE Llerona becoming the first champions. Recent editions have also included opponents such as FC Barcelona, Espanyol RCD and Girona FC.

name: MICFootball 7
shortDescription: Premier football tournament on Costa Dorada for young competitive players
description: MICFootball7 is the coolest football tournament on the Costa Dorada for young footballers ready for serious competition. Founded in 2005, it brings together coaches, players, families and fans at the end of the football season. Participants compete in group stages with league format, with top teams advancing to finals and others to consolation rounds. All teams receive prizes with trophies for finalists in each age category.

name: MICFootball Punta Cana
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in tropical Punta Cana with top academies
description: Join the international tournament for youth - MICFootball in the tropical paradise of Punta Cana, known for its white sandy beaches and emerald ocean waters. The strongest teams from all over the world will gather to showcase their strengths across several age categories. Academies such as Barcelona, Liverpool, Manchester United, Real Madrid and Inter Miami have participated in this competition.

name: Milano Soccer Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament held in Easter in Milan with modern facilities and youth teams from across Europe
description: The International tournament Milano Soccer Cup is held in Easter with football competitions on modern fields with artificial and natural grass. Youth teams from all over Europe compete against different opponents. The tournament begins with group games, followed by Play Off stage for the best teams from each group. All players must play at least one half per game. Team and individual prizes awarded at each age; first 4 teams receive prizes, remaining teams receive memorial plates.

name: Milano Winter Cup
shortDescription: Kids football tournament in Milan during Christmas holidays with group play and knockout stages
description: A youth football tournament held in Milan featuring multiple age categories. "The tournament takes place at the sports centers of the football academies Cimiano Calcio and Club Milano Barona." It begins with group matches followed by playoff rounds.
