All players must participate in at least one match. "First four teams at each age category receive prizes." Participants visit attractions including the Duomo, Santa Maria Church with Leonardo da Vinci's Last Supper, and Sforzesco castle. A visit to San Siro stadium for an AC Milan match is included.
venueName: Cimiano Calcio and Club Milano Barona

name: Mira Summer Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament by the coast with well-made competition system, good awards, long beaches, lagoon nature and nearby Aveiro
description: The Mira Summer Cup invites young football teams to a coastal Portuguese setting for energetic moments during the summer period. Its friendly environment and sun mood create a lively meeting point where participants enjoy a vibrant sports event. The tournament was first organised in 2025 to offer newbies a warm-season gathering. Over time, it became a recognised youth competition that encourages confidence and hard work.

name: Mirabilandia Adriatic Cup
shortDescription: International boys' football tournament with amusement park entertainment in Cesenatico
description: International boys' football tournament organized in cooperation with Mirabilandia Amusement Park. Features comfortable hotel accommodations, matches against strong opponents, and visits to Mirabilandia. In 2023, over 2000 participants took part. Teams advance through group stage with playoffs, all teams receive commemorative plaques, and top finishers awarded cups and medals. Players receive two-day admission tickets to attractions.

name: Mirabilandia Kick Off Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Cesenatico with entertainment and amusement park access
description: Three-day youth football tournament offering matches across multiple age groups at ASD Nuova Virtus Cesena's five state-of-the-art fields. Features opening ceremony and show at Mirabilandia Park with two-day park entrance ticket included. Participants receive water, entertainment discounts, free stadium and ceremony access, plus player injury insurance.

name: Mirabilandia Kids Festival
shortDescription: Annual international children's football festival on the Romagnola Coast
description: International children's football festival in Cesenatico featuring clubs from Italy, Switzerland, France, and Belgium. Competition includes group stage followed by playoff phase. Opening ceremony with parade and exclusive show at Mirabilandia amusement park. All participants receive medals; trophies awarded to top 4 in older age groups, participation cups for B12 and younger.
venueName: Mirabilandia amusement park and Romagnola Riviera football stadiums

name: Mirabilandia Youth Festival
shortDescription: Youth football tournament with free park access and entertainment in Cesenatico, Italy
description: Join the Mirabilandia Youth Festival, a great and unforgettable tournament for children. All football matches will be played on modern pitches. Thanks to a unique partnership with Mirabilandia Park, all participants receive free entrance tickets. A parade of participating teams, an exclusive thrilling show, slides and rides, nature and sea journeys await you.

name: Miranda Cup Autumn
shortDescription: Competitive youth football tournament in Portugal with elite foreign and local clubs
description: An intensely competitive youth football tournament located in Miranda do Corvo, Portugal, featuring renowned foreign and local clubs including Sporting CP, FC Porto, SL Benfica, Glasgow Rangers, Fulham FC, and others. The tournament consists of group matches followed by Golden and Silver final rounds, with opportunities for players to enhance skills while experiencing Portuguese nature.

name: Miranda Cup Summer
shortDescription: Football tournament in a Portuguese village surrounded by mountains and forests
description: A football tournament held in Miranda do Corvo, a small Portuguese village surrounded by mountains, forests and natural landscapes. The competition features famous local and foreign clubs and allows teams to improve their training level while discovering Portugal's nature. Previous editions have included clubs such as Sporting CP, SL Benfica, Glasgow Rangers, and Fulham FC.

name: Misano International Cup
shortDescription: Demanding fixtures against well-known rivals in Misano Adriatico, where leading football academies compete
description: The Misano International Cup is set in the Italian seaside resort of Misano Adriatico, not far from Rimini, bringing together prominent Italian academies and foreign guests. Be ready for uncompromising matches combined with a memorable Adriatic break. The competition structure includes two group stages. Teams finishing first in each group continue pursuit of the main trophy, while remaining squads compete for final ranking. All participating teams receive cups, with the overall winner receiving a special trophy.

name: Mundialito
shortDescription: Indoor youth football tournament held in Polish mountain villages
description: Indoor tournament held in Milowka and Węgierska Górka in the Beskid mountains. Features group stage competitions with semifinals and placement matches. All participants receive medals; top 4 teams receive cups and gifts. Best goalkeeper, scorer, and player receive statuettes.
venueName: Sport halls in Milowka and Węgierska Górka

name: Mundialito Futbol Base
shortDescription: International football tournament for boys, girls, and players with disabilities held in Spain and Portugal
description: An international football event for boys, girls, and people with disabilities, held simultaneously in Spain and Portugal. The historic cities of Badajoz and Elvas welcome hundreds of teams from across Europe. The mission is to inspire young people towards physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. In 2024, it celebrated its 13th edition.

name: Munich Summer Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament held in Munich, Bavaria
description: Young international tournament in Munich featuring grass and artificial fields. First round consists of qualifying games in groups, followed by playoff and consolation stages. Awards include main cups for top 3 teams, small cups, medals, diplomas, Fair Play prize, and best scorer/goalkeeper awards per age category.
venueName: Munich sports complex with grass and artificial fields

name: Netherlands Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Ommen with accommodation at Slagharen amusement park
description: We offer to take part in the Netherlands Cup tournament and visit the small Dutch city of Ommen and the amusement theme park Slagharen where will live all participants. The city is famous for its mills on the river Vecht, there is a zoo and ancient stone buildings that have survived till these days. In 2023, the tournament celebrated its 10th edition!

name: Nordic Open
shortDescription: Youth football tournament featuring teams from Denmark and neighboring countries
description: A youth football tournament platform where teams meet to showcase skills and engage in competitive play. Participants are divided into pools with group stage matches followed by reorganization into World Cup and European Cup competitions. Top three teams in each final group receive trophies and individual gifts for players.

name: Number One Cup Autumn
shortDescription: Top youth football academies from Europe compete in Wroclaw's prestigious tournament
description: One of Poland's most prestigious youth tournaments where football academies from renowned clubs in England, Germany, Italy, Portugal, Poland, France, and other countries compete. First edition took place in 2017. Careful participant selection and professional organisation attract top European academies including PSV Eindhoven, PSG, FC Porto, Juventus, and RB Leipzig.

name: KHS Cup
shortDescription: Youth international football tournament in Malta for young players
description: An exciting youth international football event for young players taking place in Malta. The tournament features a group stage followed by a final round with penalty shoot-outs to determine winners in case of ties. All participants receive medals, and winners are awarded cups.

name: Olimpik Football Fest
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Belgrade with group stage and play-offs
description: The Olimpik Football Festival started in 2007 as an indoor cup. In 2022, it was relaunched as an international youth competition, expanding its scope and attracting clubs from different countries. Clubs are invited to the tournament, a location known for its strong sporting culture and atmosphere. The event brings together international opponents for bright and hard-fought matches.

name: Olomouc Winter Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament in historic Olomouc featuring European clubs across multiple age categories
description: Discover the Czech Republic and the picturesque city of Olomouc with this football tournament. The event takes place in a city with rich historical heritage and charming architecture. Teams face clubs from various European countries on high-quality pitches. Participants compete in group stages, then split into Championship Round (top finishers) and Gold Round (other teams). All footballers receive commemorative medals; Championship winners receive trophies; top three players per category receive statuettes.

name: Olympia Easter Cup
shortDescription: Annual European youth football tournament featuring girls', women's and boys' teams
description: Youth football competition organized under the Bulgarian Football Federation auspices. Creates unforgettable memories through competition, camaraderie, and friendship. Albena offers modern indoor multifunctional sports hall, six natural turf fields, and swimming pools.

name: Olympia Football Cup
shortDescription: Olympia Football Cup more than a tournament
description: Youth football tournament combining vacation at Bulgarian seaside resorts with competitive matches. Participants divided into groups of 4 teams with elimination rounds. Medals, trophies, souvenirs and diplomas awarded to winners.

name: On Sport Easter Cup
shortDescription: Annual football tournament in Benalmadena featuring elite clubs competing across multiple age categories
description: Real Madrid, Valencia, Barcelona, Inter and other eminent clubs annually take part in the On Sport Easter Cup tournament, held in Benalmadena province near Malaga. Teams compete in preliminary group stages of 4 teams playing 3 matches, with advancement to GOLD (1st-2nd place) or SILVER (3rd-4th place) competitions. Final competitions are elimination-based. Awards include cups, medals, top scorer and player of tournament prizes, plus Fair Play Cup.

name: On Sports Winter Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Tarragona featuring top European clubs
description: Tournament held at Futbol Salou complex in Cambrils featuring twelve high-level football fields. Teams compete in preliminary groups of 4, with winners advancing to GOLD and others to SILVER competitions. Includes accommodation, meals, official merchandise, and access to opening ceremony and finals.

name: Oostduinkerke Cup
shortDescription: Junior football tournament to end the season at a holiday park by the sea
description: The Oostduinkerke Cup in Belgium is a junior football tournament featuring group matches followed by a final stage. All teams qualify for the next round from their respective places. Additional activities and a festive award ceremony with cups and individual prizes are included. Accommodation at Sunparks Oostduinkerke is suggested.

name: Oporto Esei Cup
shortDescription: A top-tier football tournament featuring leading national and international clubs competing for victory
description: International football tournament in Porto featuring group stage competition where teams progress to Gold Cup or Silver Cup brackets. Players receive trophies or medals regardless of final result. Includes accommodation, meals, and cultural activities.

name: Oranje Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament in Ommen with access to Slagharen amusement park
description: The international Oranje Cup is held in the small Dutch city of Ommen. All teams are accommodated on the territory of one of Europe's largest amusement parks - Slagharen Park. Participating teams have access to all attractions during the tournament dates. The tournament celebrated its 20th edition in 2022.

name: Panda SCB Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Braga featuring academies from Spain, Portugal, Italy and beyond
description: Welcome to the Panda SCB Cup in Braga, staged on the impressive pitches of the SC Braga sports complex, where you will face professional youth squads representing Portugal, Spain, Italy and beyond. We promise unforgettable experiences and remarkable moments throughout the event. The Panda SCB Cup first kicked off in 2026, featuring participants such as FC Barcelona, Benfica, FC Porto, AS Roma and many other respected academies.

name: Panda Winter Cup
shortDescription: Christmas football tournament in Alicante Province with professional youth clubs
description: High-level football event organized by Panda Events featuring youth clubs from Spain, Portugal and beyond. Tournament includes group rounds progressing to quarter-finals with elimination games. All players receive medals; trophies awarded to top three teams per age category. Individual prizes for best goalkeeper and outfield player in each age group.

name: Parijs Cup
shortDescription: A youth football event in Paris with European clubs, modern facilities, and access to iconic sights
description: A fantastic journey to the capital of France for a large-scale youth football event featuring clubs from France, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, and several other countries. Modern sporting complexes and comfortable accommodation located near central Paris.

name: Paris International Cup
shortDescription: Youth football competition at PSG training campus with strong rivals and top facilities
description: The Paris International Cup takes place at the new training complex of Paris Saint-Germain Football Club. Participants experience one of the most technologically advanced academies in France. Squads compete against strong representatives of the Paris region and visiting guests from other countries. The inaugural edition was held in 2026.

shortDescription: Football tournament in Val d'Europe near Disneyland Paris
description: Tournament hosted by FC Val d'Europe featuring group stage matches on day one and finals on day two. All participants will play more than 12 games. Trophies and medals awarded to all participants.

name: Paris World Games
shortDescription: One of the largest youth sports competitions held in France with thousands of players from around the world
description: The Paris World Games is a major youth tournament in Paris featuring football competitions across multiple age groups. The tournament begins with a classification stage where top teams advance to knockout play-offs. All players receive prizes, with winners awarded cups and medals. The event was created by Paris Pitray-Olier football club volunteers and has expanded to include multiple sports.

name: Pedrógão Grande Femenino Cup
shortDescription: International women's football tournament in picturesque Portuguese landscapes
description: An international women's football tournament set amidst picturesque landscapes, forests, rivers, and dams. The region offers peaceful settings with highlights including the Cabril Dam, river beaches, stone bridges, and panoramic viewpoints. Participants can enjoy nature trails and clear waters.

name: Pent'Cup Vermelloise
shortDescription: International football tournament organized by Union Sportive de Vermelles
description: International football tournament featuring group stage competition where top two teams advance to finals. All participating teams receive cups and gifts; finalists receive jersey sets. Tournament includes entertainment activities like juggling and prize quizzes.

name: Pesaro Youth Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament by the sea with top academies, play-offs for all teams, and iconic cultural sights.
description: Football tournament combining matches against top rivals with leisure time by the sea, surrounded by Italy's rich historical heritage. Features renowned academies such as Ajax Amsterdam, Juventus FC, Paris Saint-Germain, HNK Hajduk Split, and Calcio Como 1907.

name: Pisa World Cup
shortDescription: Annual football tournament in Italy's 19th edition
description: Famous tournament in Pisa and Versilia bringing together clubs from different countries. Competition features group stage with top 2 advancing to finals. Participants receive medals, trophies for top finishers in older categories, cups for B11 and younger clubs, and commemorative plaques.

name: Platres Football Festival
shortDescription: International youth football festival in Cyprus's Troodos Mountains
description: European clubs compete in this international youth football festival held in Platres village at 1100m altitude. Teams can compete in Eagles, Lions, or Tigers levels across multiple age categories. All participants receive medals, with top teams receiving cups and special prizes for semi-finalists.

name: Platres Football Festival July
shortDescription: Youth football festival in Cyprus with teams from across Europe competing at altitude
description: Discover the Platres Youth Football Festival and the opportunity to play against opponents from all over Europe at the Platres Village Sports Centre, located at an altitude of 1100 m in the Troodos Mountains in Cyprus. In summer, the temperature is comfortable and the mountain air is fresh, which is ideal for football competitions for children. Platres Cup has been organised since 2013.

name: Platres Children's Football Festival
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Cyprus's mountain village of Platres
description: Welcome to the picturesque mountain village of Platres for a children's football festival. Competitors face teams from Cyprus, Greece, Italy, Bulgaria and beyond. Choose divisions based on team level: Eagles, Lions or Tigers. All participants advance to finals based on group stage results and receive commemorative medals. Facilities have been recently renovated.

name: Platres Summer Football Festival
shortDescription: Summer football festival for children in the Troodos Mountains of Cyprus
description: International youth football tournament held at the renovated Platres Village Sports Centre in the mountains of Cyprus. Teams from across Europe compete in age-specific categories with multiple competition levels (Eagles, Lions, Tigers). Features comfortable temperature, mineral springs, and access to local attractions including monasteries, waterfalls, and the nearby Limassol resort.

name: Podhale Autumn Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Nowy Targ, Poland
description: Welcome to Nowy Targ for the Podhale Cup international youth football tournament! This ancient Polish town, founded in the 13th century, is located at the foot of the Tatra Mountains and captivates with its green landscapes and rich historical heritage. Your team will be part of a colourful competition and will be able to compete against top clubs from Poland and nearby countries.

name: Podhale Winter Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament for teenagers in Nowy Targ, Poland
description: The Podhale Cup is an international football tournament held in the historic Polish town of Nowy Targ. The tournament features group stage matches followed by knockout rounds in Golden and Silver leagues. Top three teams receive cups and medals, with special awards for best outfield player and goalkeeper. The event has hosted recognized teams including Śląsk Wrocław, Stal Mielec, and Cracovia Kraków since its inaugural edition in 2019.

name: Portimão International Cup Autumn
shortDescription: Youth football tournament on Portugal's Praia da Rocha coast featuring top academies competing for prizes
description: An excellent football event for young players held on the stunning Praia da Rocha coast in Portugal. Many well-known and strong academies from Spain, Italy, Portugal, Great Britain, the Netherlands, Germany, and other countries compete for valuable prizes. The tournament kicked off in 2021, featuring renowned clubs like PSV Eindhoven, Sporting CP, Juventus FC, and PSG.

name: Porto International Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Porto featuring boys and girls age groups
description: International youth football tournament based on strong organisation, famous football academies, modern infrastructure and hospitable atmosphere. Group stage on day one, playoff stage on day two, finals on day three. Winners receive cup, medals for 1st and 2nd place, best player awards.

name: Portugal Summer Football Cup
shortDescription: Amateur football tournament in Lisbon for boys, girls and adults with excellent games open to any teams
description: Portugal Summer Football Cup is back again and will delight boys, girls and adults with some excellent games. The football tournament is open to amateur teams, university teams and semi-professional clubs. The competition is also open to mate groups wanting a cool holiday together. The Football Cup was held for the 3rd time in 2024. Clubs from Germany, Portugal, UK, Austria, USA, Italy and others have participated.

name: Prague Football Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament for amateur adult teams in Prague
description: The Prague Football Cup invites amateur adult teams to an international football tournament. Teams are divided into groups playing 3-4 matches followed by final stages. The first two teams advance to playoffs. In final matches, ties are decided by penalty shootout (5 per team). Awards include a cup for the winner and Fair Play Cup for the most fair team. All participants receive a memory souvenir.

name: Preseason Trophy
shortDescription: International boys' football tournament in the Alps
description: An international boys' football tournament held in the picturesque Aosta Valley. The competition combines football with mountain scenery. Participants compete in group rounds, with top teams advancing to Gold play-offs and others to Silver play-offs. Cups awarded to top three teams plus medals for all players.

name: Pura Vida Cup
shortDescription: Annual football tournament in Jaco, Costa Rica with teams from North and Central America
description: Annual tournament held in the resort of Jaco, Costa Rica. The first two days feature preliminary group rounds, with the top two teams advancing to semi-finals and finals on the last day. Unqualified teams play consolation matches. Prize-winning teams receive cups and medals, with MVP prizes for exceptional players.

name: Pyrenees Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament with professional teams from around the world
description: High-level competition featuring professional teams from several countries. Located at the junction of Spain and France borders in Cerdanya. First edition in 2000, founded by Manuel Romero (Scout Manager for Real Madrid CF). Notable alumni include Marco Asensio, Marc Bartra, David López, and Aleix Vidal.

name: Quattro Mori Futsal Cup
shortDescription: International futsal tournament in Cagliari, Sardinia with multiple age categories
description: International futsal tournament held in Cagliari, Italy. Features multiple age categories for boys and girls, plus open categories. Includes group stage play with top teams advancing to playoffs. The tournament was first held in 2021 as the Sardinia Futsal Cup. Participants receive water, transfers, city tour, guide, souvenir, stadium access, and player injury insurance.

name: RaiaCup July
shortDescription: Join the RaiaCup football tournament in Portugal on summer! Compete against top clubs, showcase your talent, and experience a world-class, well-organised event.
description: On summer, prepare for an unforgettable experience at the RaiaCup football tournament, held in the heart of Portugal. Whether you're a player, coach, manager, or parent, this event offers much more than just football. Participants will compete against top-level clubs in a thrilling and highly competitive atmosphere, while coaches can scout emerging talent and enjoy the exceptional level of play. We are committed to delivering a well-organised event, uniting football enthusiasts from across the globe. Since its launch in 2023, the RaiaCup has become a must-attend fixture, creating lasting memories for all involved.

name: RaiaCup June
shortDescription: International youth football festival in Penamacor, Portugal welcoming rising talents and fans
description: The Great Youth Football Festival is back and better than ever! This year, the RaiaCup will take place in the charming town of Penamacor, Portugal. The city is ready to welcome some of the most promising young football talents, along with their families and supporters. Spend your weekend immersed in the competitive spirit—there's something for everyone! The tournament has gained a reputation as one of the most thrilling events in youth football, attracting amateur and elite squads from various regions. Since its first edition in 2023, it has continued to expand, providing young footballers with a platform to showcase their talent and compete at the highest level.

name: Ravenna European Cup
shortDescription: Grand spring football tournament in Italy welcoming international teams
description: A prestigious European football competition held annually in spring in Ravenna, Italy. The tournament features academies and clubs from Europe and other continents, organized in group stages followed by knockout rounds. All participants receive awards.

name: Ravenna Top Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Ravenna with strong Italian and international opponents
description: A tournament with very strong opponents held in Ravenna, Italy, near the Adriatic coast. Almost all Italian Serie A and B teams participate. In 2019, 78 teams attended including Juventus, Roma, Inter, Fiorentina, and international clubs like PSG and Borussia Dortmund.

name: Real Sitio Cup
shortDescription: Children's football tournament for local and international clubs in Spain
description: The Real Sitio Cup is a children football event for local and clubs from abroad, opening to all sport football clubs or academies. Held in San Ildefonso, Segovia province, it attracts high-level international teams. The tournament consists of qualifying rounds, final rounds, and consolation matches. Winners receive cups and medals; individual prizes awarded for best field player and goalkeeper per age category. All participants receive injury insurance. A giant paella celebration concludes the tournament. The event began in 2009.

name: Realix Cup
shortDescription: Young football tournament for children in the suburbs of Brussels
description: The Realix Cup is a youth football tournament hosted by Royale Entente Acren Lessines. Teams are divided into groups of 6, with top finishers advancing to Champions League, Europa League, and Intertoto Cup stages. The tournament includes 12-player squads (8 on field, 4 substitutes) competing in B12 and B13 age groups. Winners receive trophies, all participants receive medals and souvenirs. Originally scheduled for May 2020, it was postponed due to the pandemic.

name: Regins Pasqua Football Cup
shortDescription: Easter holiday football tournament for youth teams across multiple age categories
description: Multi-day youth football tournament held during Easter holiday in Italy's Adriatic coastal areas. Welcomes teams from across Europe. Features group stage with top two teams advancing to finals, plus consolation matches. All participants receive medals, plaques, and trophies.

name: Revolution Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament in Arcos de Valdevez with prestigious club participants
description: The international football tournament Revolution Cup takes place in the charming village of Arcos de Valdevez. Regular participants include prestigious clubs such as Benfica, Porto, Sporting, Braga, and Vitoria, along with renowned international academies like Celta de Vigo, Deportivo La Coruña, Servette, and Roma. The first Revolution Cup was held in 2017 and has been held annually, with a brief pause during COVID.

name: Ria Cup Futsal
shortDescription: Youth futsal tournament featuring fast-paced indoor matches
description: An exciting youth futsal tournament in Erdeven, Brittany. Teams compete in groups with round-robin format, progressing to knockout stages. All participants receive medals and trophies, with players gifted outfits. Created to promote futsal at grassroots level.

name: Riccione Aquafan Trophy
shortDescription: Young talents compete by the Adriatic with top fields, great hotels & fun at Aquafan
description: Discover one of the most popular Adriatic resorts with the Riccione Aquafan Trophy, which brings together young footballers from nearby countries for intense competition. Beautiful fields, comfortable hotels, and a warm atmosphere await you!

name: Riccione Football Cup
shortDescription: Compete with European teams, enjoy beaches, entertainment & vibrant nightlife in Riccione, Rimini & Cattolica
description: Welcome to the Adriatic Coast and the Riccione Football Cup! It is held in the bright tourist cities of Riccione, Rimini and Cattolica, which young people like so much. There is a variety of parks, beaches, entertainment, discos where children will go fun and "crazy"! Meet the European teams and get a huge positive impressions! The tournament started for the first time since 1992 and annually gathers several dozen teams at each age.

name: Riga City Cup Autumn
shortDescription: Autumn football tournament in Riga for youth age groups
description: Welcome to one of the most beautiful cities in the Baltic States and Europe for the autumn football tournament Riga City Cup, held at the Riga Olympic Center "Electrum". The tournament features excellent accommodation conditions, low prices, a comfortable arena with artificial field and participants from different countries such as England, Germany, Russia, Denmark, Sweden, Finland, Georgia, Ukraine and others.

name: Riga City Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament held in winter at Riga Olympic Center Elektrum
description: International youth football tournament featuring teams from Baltic countries, England, Poland, Georgia, Russia, Ukraine, Sweden, Denmark and Finland. Teams compete in group stages with 5 teams per group playing round-robin format. Winners and top finishers advance to medal playoffs.

name: Risò International Cup
shortDescription: A top youth football tournament with elite squads in Trino, Italy
description: The Risò International Cup brings together the strongest clubs from Italy, Switzerland, Germany and other countries. The competition takes place in Trino (Vercelli), located 50 km from Turin. The tournament features two group stages, after which first-place squads compete for the cup while others compete for final rankings. All participants receive trophies, with the champion receiving a special prize.

name: Riviera Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Cattolica, Italy
description: An international youth football tournament set in the vibrant town of Cattolica. The tournament commences with group games, with top teams advancing to play-offs. Every player must participate in at least one match. Organizers award medals/gadgets to all athletes and cups for 1st-4th places.

name: Riviera Easter Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament held at Easter on the Adriatic Riviera
description: International youth tournament taking place at Easter on the Adriatic Riviera in coastal cities of Cattolica, Gabicce Mare, and surrounding areas. Tournament held on excellent sports complexes including stadiums Cattolica, Gabicce, Vallefolia, and sports centers Gradara and Tavullia. Starts with group games, then best teams advance to Play Off stage. All players must play at least once. Teams and individual prizes awarded in each age category; first four teams receive prizes, remaining teams receive commemorative plaques.

name: Riviera Summer Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament on the Adriatic coast with sandy beaches and top service
description: A youth football tournament taking place in summer on the Adriatic coast. The event offers sun, safe cities, sandy beaches and entertainment across Cattolica, Gabicce Mare and Riccione.

name: Riviera Trophy SC
shortDescription: Youth football tournament on Italy's Adriatic coast with sandy beaches and entertainment
description: Riviera Trophy Spring Cup is a youth football tournament that takes place on the Adriatic coast of Italy. Participants enjoy sunny, cozy small cities, sandy beaches and entertainment. Teams are located in Cattolica, Gabicce Mare and Riccione, near Rimini's historical center. The tournament features group games followed by Play Off stages. All players must play at least 1 half. Organizers award team and individual prizes, with first four teams receiving prizes and remaining teams receiving commemorative plaques.

name: Rivulus Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Baia Mare combining sport with mountain scenery and cultural attractions
description: Rivulus Cup welcomes clubs to Baia Mare, in the heart of Maramureș. Located in a striking part of northern Romania, the event combines youth football with history and mountain scenery. The setting gives players, coaches and families an experience that goes beyond the pitch. First launched in 2026, the event takes its name from Rivulus Dominarum, the former name of Baia Mare. Beyond the tournament, visitors can enjoy the old centre, the Mineralogy Museum, Firiza Lake, Mogoșa and Șuior.

name: Roma International Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Rome with Easter celebration
description: An international tournament in Rome featuring youth football teams from around the world. Matches held at a sports center with eight fields (natural and synthetic turf). Includes opening ceremony, qualifying matches, and awards ceremony. All participants receive medals; trophies awarded to top finishers. One day off for Easter Mass at San Pietro.

name: RurCup Jülich
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Jülich, Germany with modern sports complex near Brückenkopf Park
description: A youth football tournament held in the city of Jülich at a modern sports complex located near the hotel and Brückenkopf Park, which offers attractions and leisure for children. Perfect place to enjoy football and celebrate the end of the season.

name: Rush Open Spain
shortDescription: International football tournament in Salou featuring top teams from around the world
description: The Rush Open Spain is an international football tournament offering academies a high-quality competition where elite squads compete. Founded in 2023, it provides opportunities to learn and elevate skills. Rivals from around the world gather in Salou for vibrant football action.

name: Sabbiadoro Easter Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament on the coast in Lignano Sabbiadoro, Italy
description: Football competition organised on the coast in Lignano Sabbiadoro, a sports resort in northern Italy featuring multiple playing fields, swimming pools, recreation areas, fitness centre and beach. All participants compete in qualifying group rounds followed by cup system play-offs. Every player receives a participation medal; cups and plaques awarded to teams.

name: Sabugal Verão Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Sabugal, Portugal with group stage and playoffs
description: The Sabugal Verão Cup brings together youth teams in a landmark football tournament focused on gaining valuable experience in competitive matches. In the tournament, you will face collectives from Portugal, Spain, France and other countries. The tournament began in 2026 as a summer football event created to provide a well-organised and competitive environment with an emphasis on long-term development.

name: Salou Esei Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament combining exciting games with leisure options on Spain's Costa Dorada
description: Join the Salou Esei Cup international football tournament, which combines exciting games with a variety of leisure options. The enormous football complex and participants from many countries of Europe, North and Latin America will not leave you indifferent. You will be surrounded by beautiful beaches, an unbeatable sports atmosphere, and an unforgettable experience with your team!

name: Salou Youth Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament in Salou combining competition with beach relaxation
description: Great chance to spend time in summer with benefits. The tournament takes place in modern stadiums with international club participation. Created for children from different countries to test football skills combined with relaxation on the Balearic coast. Held for the 7th time in 2021 with clubs from Japan, England, Korea, Italy, France, Portugal, USA and other countries.

name: Santa Ponsa Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Mallorca featuring top European clubs
description: Top clubs from across Europe and Latin America competing in Santa Ponsa. Tournament features preliminary round-robin groups with 16 best performers advancing to elimination matches. Champions receive trophies, runners-up receive medals, all participants receive cups, plus Fair Play and individual awards.

name: Sardinia Futbol Sala Cup
shortDescription: Indoor football sporting event in Cagliari promoting futsal across Europe
description: An indoor football tournament taking place in Cagliari designed to promote futsal among players from different countries. Teams compete in group stages with top teams advancing to playoffs. The event expects participation from leading sports clubs and athletes across Italy and Europe.

name: Saronno Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament featuring top Italian clubs in a historic town near Milan
description: Welcome to the Saronno Cup youth football tournament! In a small town just a few kilometres from Milan, we offer teams the chance to test themselves against big names from Italy and abroad! For travellers, we have many interesting places to visit and we guarantee an authentic Italian atmosphere.

name: Scimemi Cup
shortDescription: Junior football tournament in Charleroi organized by Royal Gosselies Sports
description: Welcome to Charleroi, to our junior football tournament Scimemi Cup, organised by the oldest Belgian club in Charleroi - Royal Gosselies Sports, located in the Gosselies district in the north. We have an excellent infrastructure, stadiums, transport, many fascinating museums and parks. We guarantee you high class football, quality organised competition and a variety of clubs from different countries. The tournament will start with preliminary games on the first day and conclude with the final round on the second day. Each team will have the opportunity to participate in the final stage and play an equal number of matches. Awards will be given to the best forward, field player and goalkeeper. A special gift will be awarded to the most active fan, and the team that shows the most fair and correct play will earn the Fair Play award.

name: Season Cup
shortDescription: Summer youth football tournament in Tirana with professional academies and city experiences
description: The ultimate summer football tournament bringing together leading youth academies and elite teams for high-level competition, valuable exposure, and unforgettable experience in the heart of the Balkans.

name: Senior WinterCup Holland
shortDescription: International football tournament for adults held at a sports park close to the North Sea coast
description: Discover one of the most delicious football tournaments for adults - Senior WinterCup Holland, that will take place at the RKSV Blauw-Zwart sports park close to the North Sea coast. The competition is open to teams of all levels for men, women, and veterans aged 18+. You will be delighted with the attractions of Duinrell park, great cuisine, parties and friendly atmosphere this weekend! The International Senior WinterCup first edition took place in 2018! And since that time it has gathered together adult teams from different countries for colourful matches and amusement.

name: Serdika Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Sofia with strong academies, quality pitches, and great awards
description: International football tournament held in Sofia featuring strong academies from different countries and high-quality pitches. Previous participants include FC Panionios, Panathinaikos, Dinamo Zagreb, FK Radnički, FC Brașov, and CSKA Sofia. Tournament includes group stages followed by finals and classification matches. Awards include cups, medals, and diplomas for all participants, with special prizes for top scorers, goalkeepers, and most valuable players.

name: Sertã Cup
shortDescription: Community-driven youth football tournament with social programme featuring DJ sessions, pool access, and Portuguese hospitality
description: Register for the Sertã Cup, a community-driven tournament where the entire village comes alive for football. Beyond the games, the schedule features a lively social programme with DJ sunset sessions, pool access and water games, offering a great opportunity to enjoy an energetic atmosphere and genuine Portuguese hospitality. Since 2021, the tournament has grown into an annual tradition that the local community looks forward to every year.

name: Sertã Verão Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in central Portugal with exciting matches, perfect trophies, River Zêzere views and its beaches
description: The Sertã Verão Cup gives clubs the chance to compete in one of the most attractive parts of central Portugal. With the River Zêzere and river beaches close by, the tournament combines good football with a location that makes the trip even more special. From its inaugural edition, the aim has been to unite sporting ambition with enjoyment, building a project that promotes discipline, improving, and steady progression.

name: Seven Herbst Cup
shortDescription: International children's football tournament in Leverkusen featuring top European clubs
description: The international Seven Herbst Cup opens its doors in Leverkusen for football teams ready to compete against top clubs from Germany, Belgium, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands and other countries. The tournament was first held in 2014 as the Hebbel Cup and renamed Seven Herbst Cup in 2017. Rivals pass through two qualifying group stages, with the strongest 16 squads moving to the final stage. The eight quarter-finalists receive cups and all participants receive medals.

name: Sheriff August Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament in Tiraspol, Moldova at FC Sheriff academy fields
description: Register now to secure your spot in the excellent youth football tournament — the Sheriff August Cup, held in Tiraspol at the ultra-modern sports complex of Moldova's renowned club, FC Sheriff. This competition welcomes a wide range of European squads, including top-level academies from Moldova, Lithuania, Latvia, Romania, Uzbekistan, Ukraine, and beyond. In 2019, more than 100 clubs from Romania, Moldova, and Ukraine accepted invitations to the inaugural edition.

name: Sheriff Autumn Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament with top pitches, great facilities, and rivals from across Europe
description: Book your place at the international football tournament – Sheriff Autumn Cup – conducted in the excellent complex of FC Sheriff in Tiraspol. You'll take part in a sporting event alongside squads from various nations, and the quality of both pitches and accommodation will truly impress you. The Sheriff Autumn Cup was launched in 2023. Since then, we have welcomed amateur and professional clubs from Romania, Ukraine, Georgia, Uzbekistan, Moldova, Bulgaria, and other countries.

name: Sheriff Winter Cup
shortDescription: Strong international football tournament held indoors for children in Tiraspol, Moldova
description: International football tournament featuring the strongest teams from different European and Asian countries. First held in 2023, it is a celebration of football with serious opponents competing across multiple age categories.

name: Shkodra Summer Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament with competitive matches, prizes, Lake Skadar views, and cultural tours
description: International youth football competition across multiple age categories in Shkodër on Lake Skadar shores. First edition organized in 2018. Clubs from Italy, Albania, Bulgaria, Greece, Montenegro, Croatia and Africa have participated. Features strong competition, entertainment and thrilling matches with minimum 5 games guaranteed per team.

name: Simon Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament for U14 and U15 age categories in Yerevan, Armenia
description: Simon Cup brings young footballers together in a lively and inspiring environment. The tournament aims to identify the strongest squads, foster friendships, and provide opportunities for coaches and players to exchange ideas and experiences. Looking ahead, Simon Cup aspires to reach an international level, uniting clubs from different countries and creating unforgettable moments of competition, teamwork, and adventure. The tournament was first held in 2022 in memory of Simon Israelyan, a long-time employee of Urartu FC.

name: Slagharen Easter Cup
shortDescription: Popular spring tournament in the Netherlands with free amusement park access
description: Tournament organized in Ommen, Netherlands featuring qualifying games in groups followed by playoff rounds. All teams receive trophies, with top three receiving cups. Players receive medals and diplomas. Special awards for fair play, best goalkeeper, and top scorer. Located near Slagharen amusement park with free entrance for participants.

name: Slagharen Trophy
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Ommen, Netherlands with accommodation at Slagharen amusement park
description: Football tournament in Ommen, 20 kilometers from Zwolle. Participants accommodated at Slagharen amusement park with most attractions included. Competing teams from Netherlands, Germany, Finland, France and other countries. Tournament format: qualifying games in groups of 4-5 teams, top 2 advance to playoffs. All teams receive trophies, medals and diplomas. Fair Play trophy awarded. Individual prizes for best goalkeeper and top scorer.

name: SOCCACUP Girls Edition
shortDescription: Exclusive football tournament for girls' teams focusing on fun, sporting excellence, and personal development
description: An exclusive football tournament for girls' teams where the focus is on fun, sporting excellence, and personal development for all participants. Competitors from various countries, well-maintained grass pitches, and an excellent holiday programme in one of Italy's most beautiful resorts await participants. The Women's SOCCACUP was launched for the first time in 2023. Trophies awarded to the three winners of all age categories, and all female players receive medals.

name: SOCCACUP Lago Di Garda
shortDescription: International junior tournament during Easter holidays in Lake Garda, Italy
description: International junior tournament held during Easter holidays in Calmasino, Italy. Features group phase and play-offs with additional entertainment including bubble football, speed shooting, and football billiards. All players receive medals; top three in each category get trophies.

name: SOCCACUP Rosenheim
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in the Alpine region near Rosenheim with play-offs and scenic nature access
description: The SOCCACUP Rosenheim tournament is held in a scenic Alpine region near Rosenheim, close to the Austrian border. Accommodation offered in hotels and mountain lodges at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser range, allowing guests to enjoy untouched natural surroundings. The tournament has been running since 2026.

name: SOCCACUP Rovinj
shortDescription: International youth football tournament with guaranteed playing time on Croatia's Adriatic coast
description: Discover football in Croatia and SOCCACUP Rovinj, an international youth tournament where all teams are guaranteed plenty of playing time and a rich programme of events. Athletes will spend a few days on the coast, struggling for prizes on the excellent fields of several sports centres in the city. This tournament was first launched in 2021. You will meet strong opponents from Austria, Germany, Italy, Croatia and other countries.

name: Soccer Challenge
shortDescription: Largest amateur soccer tournament for adults in Greece in 5x5 game format
description: The Soccer Challenge is the largest amateur soccer tournament for adults in Greece in 5x5 game format. Teams compete in groups of 6 using round robin system, then winners advance to Main Prize competition and second places to Second Prize competition. Professional football players are not allowed. Each team must have at least 8 players. Winners receive cups, medals, and a certificate for participation in a European football tournament with hotel accommodation and flights.

name: Soccer Stars Youth Festival
shortDescription: International youth soccer tournament in Loutraki, Greece with multiple age groups
description: Tournament held at Sport Camp football base in Loutraki, Greece. Features group stage format with teams divided into groups of 4, followed by semifinals, finals, and consolation games. All participants receive souvenirs and diplomas; winners receive trophies and medals. Includes water, free coach accommodation, city tour, airport transfers, stadium access, and opening ceremony/finals entrance.

name: Soccerpassion Bravo Cup
shortDescription: Elite football tournament in Waiblingen featuring Europe's strongest squads
description: Welcome to Waiblingen for an Elite Football Tournament. Europe's strongest football squads compete in this prestigious international event with renowned academies participating, including VfB Stuttgart, FC Bayern München, Eintracht Frankfurt, and RB Leipzig. Tournament held annually since 2014.

name: Sofia Summer Cup
shortDescription: International children's football tournament in Bulgaria featuring boys, girls, and women's categories
description: One of Bulgaria's most renowned youth football tournaments, hosting European and international teams across multiple age groups and gender categories. The tournament features group stages followed by playoff rounds, with top teams receiving cups and distinguished players receiving individual awards.

name: South Black Sea Cup
shortDescription: Youth international football event in Obzor, Bulgaria
description: Youth international football tournament held in Obzor Area between Varna and Burgas. Features modern sports facilities and infrastructure. Teams compete in group stage with top finishers entering knockout finals. Medals and trophies awarded to 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place; all teams receive memory trophies.

name: South Sea Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament on Bulgaria's Black Sea coast
description: Tournament held in Obzor between Varna and Burgas featuring modern sports facilities. The competition uses a group stage format where first-place teams advance to knockout finals. Prize winners receive cups, medals, and personal gifts.

name: Spain Esei Cup
shortDescription: Kids' football tournament on the Costa del Sol with clubs from Spain, France and Portugal
description: Welcome to the Costa del Sol, to the kids' football tournament Spain Esei Cup! We invite your team to compete with clubs from Spain, France and Portugal! Most of the games are played in Mijas, but you can also enjoy cities such as Alhaurin de la Torre and Fuengirola. We guarantee you first-class service, comfortable hotels on the seashore, gentle sand and exciting adventures.

name: Spain Trophy
shortDescription: Traditional tournament held on the coast of Maresme with teams from around the world
description: Spain Trophy is a traditional tournament held on the coast of Maresme in small cities of Santa Susanna, Malgrat and Pineda de Mar. The tournament started in 2005. Teams play in groups during qualifying stage, with top two advancing to playoffs. Winners receive cups, medals and diplomas.

name: Spanish Champions Cup
shortDescription: Prestigious autumn tournament in Salou gathering thousands of footballers from multiple countries
description: International football celebration held in Salou with teams from Spain, Sweden, Poland, Austria, Czech Republic and beyond. Tournament features opportunities to swim in the Mediterranean sea and enjoy local sights and entertainment.

name: Sparna Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament featuring top clubs from across Europe
description: French football tournament held in Épernay, Champagne region. Representatives of top international clubs such as Juventus, Bayer Leverkusen, Benfica, Paris Saint-Germain compete. Tournament features group stage rounds followed by elimination playoffs. Winners receive trophy; all players receive medals.

name: Sport Event Trophy
shortDescription: Football cup tournament for youth across multiple age categories in Adriatic coastal resorts
description: International football tournament held across stadiums in Gabicce Mare, Cattolica, Riccione, and Misano. Features group phase followed by knockout playoffs and consolation rounds. Includes accommodation, meals, stadium access, and opening/closing ceremonies. All participants receive trophies, commemorative plaques, and medals.

name: Sport&Joy Autumn Cup
shortDescription: A strong youth football tournament featuring leading football academies from different countries
description: A professional youth football tournament held in Milan, Italy. The event brings together respected academies from across Europe, including Juventus, Inter, Lugano, Como, Pergolettese and Alcione. The first edition was organised in 2025 in Ivrea, Italy. Following a successful debut, the tournament moved to Milan, one of Europe's most recognised football cities.

name: Summer Esei Cup
shortDescription: Top-tier football tournament on the Mediterranean coast featuring teams from around the world
description: The Summer Esei Cup is held on the Mediterranean Coast in La Nucia, Alicante. It features group-stage matches where top-performing teams advance to Gold or Silver playoff rounds with elimination-style competition. All players receive medals and prizes.

name: Summer Finest League
shortDescription: Top-level football tournament featuring dozens of clubs competing across multiple age groups in Pärnu
description: Summer tournament in Pärnu hosting strong clubs from multiple countries. Teams compete in group stages, then placed into gold, silver and bronze groups. Top three in each age group receive cups, medals and diplomas. Best player and goalkeeper in each category awarded special prizes. Winners receive exclusive personalized trophy.

name: Summer Village Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament on the Adriatic coast near Venice
description: Football tournament bringing together clubs from different countries in Caorle and Jesolo, Italy. Features group stage qualifying rounds followed by knockout playoffs. Participants stay at a 5-star campsite with sports activities and pools.

name: Sun Esei Cup
shortDescription: Prestigious international youth football tournament featuring top clubs in Costa del Sol, Spain
description: Annual prestigious event showcasing top clubs such as SL Benfica, Málaga CF, FC Porto, Cádiz CF and RB Leipzig. Competition starts with group matches, leading teams to next round based on results. Final stage features Gold or Silver playoffs with knockout matches. Includes friendly matches against local opponents, coaching clinic, stadium visits, and water park excursion.

name: Super Écureuil's Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Plogonnec, France with strong opponents and high-quality pitches
description: International youth football tournament bringing together dozens of strong rivals to offer footballers high-quality matches and excellent conditions in a picturesque Breton setting.

name: Supercup Costa Ballena
shortDescription: Premier youth football tournament showcasing talent across multiple age groups in coastal Spain
description: Annual youth football competition held in spring where teams from Spain and other countries compete. Scouts from top clubs attend to identify talent. First tournament was 2022, with clubs like Benfica, Sevilla, Real Betis, Barcelona, Girona, and Sporting Braga participating. Group stage followed by knockout finals. All players receive medals and keepsakes; winners receive cups. Fair play award also given.

name: Supercup Madrid
shortDescription: International football tournament for junior age groups in Spain's historic region
description: The junior's international football tournament Supercup Madrid invites everyone in the cosy town of Navas del Rey, 30 kilometres away from the Spanish capital. Each age category plays for one day. A huge party, loads of clubs, lots of tasty treats and gifts! Supercup Madrid celebrated its 25th anniversary in 2024.

name: Supercup Roquetas de Mar
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Andalusia featuring clubs from Spain, Portugal and beyond
description: Summer youth football tournament in Roquetas de Mar hosting numerous clubs from Spain, Portugal and other countries. Features top-level football, Andalusian cuisine, and various attractions. Round-robin group stage followed by knockout finals. Medals and souvenirs awarded to all players.

name: SuperCupNI Girls
shortDescription: Women's youth football tournament held annually in Northern Ireland since 2022
description: SuperCupNI Girls is the women's category of the renowned youth football tournament. Teams compete in group matches leading to playoffs: group winners advance to the main Cup final, second-place teams to the Globe final, third-place teams to the Vase, and remaining teams to the Bowl final. The tournament features semi-finals, third-place matches, and finals with trophies, medals, and individual awards for top scorers and goalkeepers.

name: Surf Cup International
shortDescription: International youth football tournament featuring top European and South American clubs
description: Surf Cup International is your chance to meet and play against top clubs as FC Barcelona, PSG, Benfica, Atlético de Madrid, etc. The tournament takes place in Salou, Spain, known for resorts, nature and activities for the whole family. The tournament's squad is divided into 4 groups of 4 teams per age group, where all participants play against each other. Top 2 in each group qualify for quarterfinals while bottom two play the consolation round.

name: Surf Cup International Morocco
shortDescription: Elite youth academies compete in thrilling football event blending top competition with culture and hospitality
description: Immerse yourself in the Surf Cup International Morocco - an exclusive event where elite youth academies from across the globe come together to compete. Beyond the game, discover a vibrant culture, enjoy impeccable organisation, and experience unmatched hospitality. A competition like no other, filled with passion, energy, and lasting memories.

name: Surf Cup International Rome
shortDescription: Feel the atmosphere of medieval Rome competing in the heart of the world famous city
description: Surf Cup International is back again! Feel the atmosphere of medieval Rome competing in the heart of the world famous city! Next season we will definitely delight you with an abundance of foreign participants and the strongest clubs of Italy at our football tournament! The first Surf Cup Rome received rave reviews and was a huge success in 2023.

name: SVL Cup
shortDescription: Professional youth football tournament near Karlsruhe with leading European academies
description: The SVL Cup is a professional youth football tournament held in Karlsbad, Germany. The first edition took place in 2019. Previous participants have included clubs from France, Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, Finland, Hungary, Lithuania, Germany, Italy, Croatia and other countries. The competition features a group stage followed by a Championship stage, with Gold, Silver, and Bronze play-offs. Teams are guaranteed a minimum of 9 matches.

name: SWC Pro Cup
shortDescription: Youth top football tournament in Milan with international matches against strong academies
description: Join the SWC Pro Cup, if you are seeking an unforgettable football competition in one of Italy's most iconic cities. Compete against top academies in a high-level international environment designed for ambitious young players. First held in 2025, the event attracted strong interest from leading Italian clubs such as AC Milan, Inter Milan and Juventus FC, alongside international participants from across Europe.

name: Sedriano World Cup
shortDescription: International football competition for boys and girls held in Sedriano, Italy
description: International youth football tournament featuring professional and amateur teams from Western and Eastern Europe, Scandinavia and CIS. Over 150 clubs participate with more than 1000 players competing in approximately 400 matches over three days.

name: Tabor Open Autumn
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Maribor, Slovenia with excellent grass fields and opponents from different countries
description: Discover Maribor and its beautiful surroundings together with Tabor Open Autumn, an international youth football tournament held in Slovenia. The event takes place in an attractive sporting area near the city centre, offering a great setting that combines competition, local culture and nature. The tournament began in 2025 as a new international event for young players.

name: Tallinn Cup
shortDescription: International youth football festival in Estonia with global clubs and modern venues
description: International Festival Tallinn Cup held since 2007 in July in Tallinn. Tournament features multiple sports complexes with A. Le Coq Arena as the main venue with five artificial and natural fields. Among participants were teams from England, Finland, Poland, Mexico, USA, India, Germany, Sweden, Lithuania, Latvia, Slovakia, Spain, Norway, Denmark, France, and Czech Republic.

name: TAR U11 Promises
shortDescription: International children's football tournament in Vic, Spain
description: An international children's football tournament held in Vic, Spain, approximately 70 kilometres from Barcelona's centre. The tournament features strong teams from multiple countries with organized competition and participant care. Since 2016, previous champions have included FC Barcelona academy, Real Betis, Espanyol, and Barcelona. Teams compete in group stage round robin format, with winners and selected runners-up advancing to knockout rounds.

name: Tarraco Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Tarragona with top academies, elite pitches, and seaside stays
description: The Tarraco Cup international youth football tournament brings together the best academies to determine the strongest squad. Participants compete on top-quality pitches while enjoying seaside accommodation. The tournament has become one of Spain's premier sporting events for young footballer development.

name: Tartu Culture Cup
shortDescription: A football festival in Estonia bringing together international participants for summer competitions
description: A new football festival taking place in Estonia's second largest city during summer. The tournament is designed to bring together participants from different countries, introduce everyone to Estonian culture and foster good sports emotions on the football fields. Competitions are divided into group and play-off rounds with awards for top finishers.

name: Tempocasa Kup
shortDescription: Elite football tournament in the Italian Alps featuring top European academies
description: Set amidst the breathtaking mountains of the Aosta Valley, several football complexes host top academies from Italy and beyond. Many European clubs such as Juventus, Lugano, Liverpool, Olympique de Marseille, Parma, Bayer, and Nice have attended for many years. Teams compete in group stages followed by Gold or Silver final rounds, with semi-finals for winners.
venueName: Multiple football complexes in Aosta Valley

name: TFA Elite Esei Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Limerick, Ireland featuring top academies
description: TFA Elite Esei Cup – an international tournament in Limerick, Ireland – is an exceptional choice for football clubs seeking the intensity of hottest competition. In addition to thrilling matches against renowned academies, you'll enjoy an immersive journey into Irish history and culture, creating memories to last a lifetime.

name: The Edinburgh International Cup
shortDescription: Largest children's football tournament in the UK attracting thousands of players annually
description: International youth football tournament held in Edinburgh featuring multiple age categories from B7 (4vs4) through B15/G16 (11vs11). Played at Scotland's finest venues including the national team home stadium, Oriam. All participants receive commemorative medals; finalists compete for the Edinburgh Cup trophy. Tournament includes round-robin group play followed by playoffs and consolation rounds.

name: The Elite Top Cup Milano
shortDescription: Youth football competition in Italy offering hard struggle and easy access to Milan's main attractions
description: Join The Elite Top Cup Milano, a youth football event held in Italy, where participants gather in a well-organised environment in the suburbs of Milan. The event stands out for its strong organisation and convenient location, offering a balanced experience for both players and accompanying families. The competition begins with a group stage using a round-robin system. On the following day, all teams continue with additional matches against new opponents, ensuring a full programme and a final ranking without knockout rounds. All teams receive awards at the end of the event, while an MVP prize is presented to the most outstanding player.

name: The Newcastle Summer Cup
shortDescription: Top-tier youth football tournament at Newcastle University's Cochrane Park
description: The Newcastle International Summer Cup provides aspiring footballers with the opportunity to test their abilities in a high-level competition at the top-tier sports facilities of Newcastle University's Cochrane Park. This international football event attracts clubs from the United Kingdom, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, and beyond. Situated in one of England's most football-driven cities, Newcastle University's playing grounds feature three cutting-edge artificial pitches alongside three impeccably maintained natural grass fields.

name: Torneig de Nadal
shortDescription: International Christmas football tournament in Dénia, Spain uniting top European academies
description: Welcome to the Torneig de Nadal, an international Christmas football tournament in Spain. Enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of Alicante, with its green landscapes and timeless traditions. Feel the excitement of the matches on the road to the final alongside professional football academies from Spain, France, Portugal, and other countries. In 2025, the tournament celebrated its 25th anniversary.

name: Torneio GS Loures Junho
shortDescription: International youth cup for boys and girls in the suburbs of Lisbon
description: Torneio GS Loures invites your club to join in June in the well-kept town of Loures, located just a few kilometres from Lisbon. Several strong opponents from Portugal and neighbouring countries, together with numerous cultural attractions and the beaches of Cascais, will make your journey truly memorable.

name: Torneio GS Loures Maio
shortDescription: International youth football cup near Lisbon with competitive action and awards
description: The international youth football cup Torneio GS Loures will take place in May on the pitches of the small town of Loures, in the suburbs of Lisbon. It is a beautiful, well-kept resort area in southern Portugal, where you will find numerous landmarks, attractive sandy beaches and the opportunity to experience the history of Portugal.

name: Torneo Città di Ivrea
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Ivrea, Italy with strong clubs and quality venues
description: International youth football competition held in Ivrea, Italy. The event brings together academies and clubs from various countries for high-level fixtures, strong organisation, and memorable sporting experience. Played at quality venues including historic Stadio Gino Pistoni, it offers young players opportunity to compete, develop, and enjoy Italian sporting culture in welcoming international atmosphere. Inaugural edition took place in 2024 in Turin.

name: Torneo Città di Rimini
shortDescription: Children's football tournament created in memory of Rimini Calcio FC president Vincenzo Bellavista
description: Kindly invite you to Italy for the children's football tournament Citta di Rimini, created in a memory of the legendary president of Rimini Calcio FC - Vincenzo Bellavista, who did a lot for the club and the city. He passed away in 2007, and after that the local football school was named after him. You will get great impressions from games, rivals, from Rimini - it is a very beautiful, medieval, tourist city, which was repeatedly destroyed by strong earthquakes and restored by different architects. The first time the Torneo Citta di Rimini was held in 2012.

name: Torneo Ciudad de Segovia
shortDescription: Youth football cup combining competitive games with cultural exploration of Segovia
description: Youth football tournament featuring group stage competition with advancement to gold, silver, or bronze rounds, then semifinals. Top three teams receive cups and all players receive medals.

name: Torneo Promises
shortDescription: Elite children's football tournament conducted annually during Christmas holidays
description: The elite children's football tournament Promises Cup is conducted every year during the Christmas holidays. It is a gathering of all the best clubs from Spain, France, Portugal, Israel, Japan and other countries. The first tournament was organised in 2014 for U12 teams only. Now, every year all the top clubs in Spain take part in the competition: Barcelona, Valencia, Atletico Madrid, Villarreal, Real Betis, Real Sociedad, Sevilla, Espanyol and others.

name: Toscana Spring Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Tuscany
description: International youth tournament in Chianciano Terme, Tuscany. Group stage followed by playoff phase. Top finishers receive cups and medals; all participants get commemorative souvenirs.

name: Easter Football Tournament
shortDescription: Easter football tournament hosted by Le Boulou-St-Jean-Pla-de-Corts FC
description: Easter football tournament bringing together numerous strong squads for competitive matchups. Opening group stage features five teams in round-robin format. Top 2 teams advance to Champions League, teams finishing 3rd-5th move to Europa League. All participants receive medals; trophies awarded to top 3 teams with additional fun challenges throughout event.

name: Tournoi National Élite
shortDescription: Experience top-level youth football at the Tournoi National Elite in Castelsarrasin, Occitanie!
description: Founded in 2013, the Tournoi National Elite has become one of the most prestigious youth football events in France. Designed to provide a competitive platform for the country's best young players, the tournament has grown in popularity and reputation over the years. The tournament kicks off with a group phase, where rivals are split into groups and engage in a round-robin format to secure a place among the top qualifiers. The event then advances to the knockout rounds, structured as single-elimination matches, encompassing the quarter-finals and semi-finals. Ultimately, the two most formidable squads will clash in the grand final, battling for the prestigious championship crown.

name: Tournoi National Feminin
shortDescription: One of the biggest women football tournaments in France with ~40 teams competing over two days
description: We invite you to take part in one of the biggest woman football tournaments in France, the Tournoi National Feminin in Biars-sur-Cère, in the south. We have very beautiful venues, delicious pitches and a great atmosphere in female company! In 2024, TNF Cup celebrated its 10th anniversary in a magnificent way. Each year we have around 40 teams that come to compete over two days. Among the participating clubs you can find: Paris Saint Germain, Toulouse FC, Paris FC, Rodez AF, Montauban TG, Albi ASPPT.

name: Trofeo Alto Adriatico
shortDescription: Football tournament in Italian coastal resort with leisure and cultural activities
description: High-level football competition featuring group and playoff stages. Accommodations in beachfront hotels, water park, discos, private beach access, and sports facilities available.

name: Trofeo Città di Jesolo
shortDescription: International youth football tournament near Venice featuring Italian clubs and foreign academies
description: International youth football tournament for boys held in Jesolo near Venice. Teams compete in group stages followed by knockout playoffs. Top three finishers in each age category receive trophies, all players receive medals, and all teams receive commemorative plaques. Includes opportunities for excursions to Venice and other local attractions.

name: City of Viareggio Trophy
shortDescription: Spring football competition on the Tuscan coast with international opponents
description: A youth football tournament held in Viareggio, Italy, featuring group stage matches followed by finals. Participants compete across multiple age categories with opportunities to visit nearby cities like Pisa, Lucca, and Florence. All players receive medals, teams receive commemorative plaques, and trophies awarded to top finishers.
venueName: Marco Polo sports complex and other coastal fields

name: Trofeo Costa Degli Etruschi
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Tuscany's coastal region with multiple age categories
description: San Vincenzo and the Tuscany's football tournament is one of those events not to be missed with access to protected coastal areas, endless beaches, pine forests and sea. Participants stay at Hu Park Albatros Village camping resort with pools, restaurants and entertainment. Teams progress through group stages with top 2 teams advancing to playoff finals.

name: Trofeo dei Colli Asolani
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Asolo with age groups from U9 to U14
description: The Colli Asolani football tournament is open to all interested clubs. Participants can enjoy landscapes and mountain views in Asolo, a city with ancient history, monuments, works of art and local wine and food delicacies.

name: Epiphany Trophy
shortDescription: Trofeo della Befana football tournament in Viareggio with warm Mediterranean climate and natural grass fields
description: Tournament featuring group stage and playoff format where all teams receive participation medals. First 4 places in older categories awarded trophies; all teams in younger categories receive trophies. Includes water, entertainment discounts, stadium access, opening ceremony/finals entry, and player injury insurance.

name: Trofeo della Mole
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Turin, Italy
description: International tournament hosted in Turin, Italy. In its first year, over 100 teams participated. Local professional clubs Juventus and Torino traditionally participate. Largest youth tournament in Piedmont. Teams play three games in first qualifying round, then enter second round in groups of three, with placement determining participation in main or consolation finals.

name: Trofeo della Riviera Ligure
shortDescription: A fantastic youth football tournament in Loano, Italy's western coast
description: Welcome to Liguria! This international event brings together rivals from all regions of Italy and several European nations. In 2024, the Trofeo della Riviera Ligure was held for the first time. All visitors will be accommodated in a cosy sports village featuring swimming pools, football pitches, fitness centres, and excellent dining options.

name: Trofeo Delle Terme
shortDescription: Children's football cup held on natural turf pitches at 1500m altitude in the Italian Alps
description: The Trofeo Delle Terme children's football cup is held on excellent natural turf pitches at an altitude of 1500 metres between Monte Piella summit and thermal waters. Started in 2023 as a local competition, it has expanded participation each year. Teams progress through group stages with top 2 advancing to finals. Winners and runners-up receive cups and medals; all teams get commemorative plaques.

name: Trofeo Malgratense
shortDescription: International youth soccer tournament held on the Mediterranean coast of Catalonia
description: Trofeo Malgratense is held at stadiums in Santa Susana, Calella, Malgrat and Pineda de Mar on Spain's Mediterranean coast. The tournament has been held for many years with teams from different continents participating. Competition features qualification stage with group play, followed by playoffs and consolation games. Winners receive free accommodation, cups, medals, and diplomas awarded by age category.

name: Trofeo Mar Menor
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in San Pedro del Pinatar with international participation
description: A youth football tournament featuring groups of 3-4 teams with winners advancing to finals. Tournament held in modern sports complex with awards for finalists and commemorative trophies for all participants.

name: Trofeo Mar Tirreno
shortDescription: Join the Trofeo Mar Tirreno in Tuscany! Play on top pitches by the Tyrrhenian Sea
description: This region is renowned for its artistic cities like Pisa, Lucca, and Florence, all within a mere 80 kilometers' reach. Our Trofeo Mar Tirreno unfolds on the illustrious Italian coastline of Viareggio and Versilia, where the sun and its pristine beaches reign supreme. The warm Tyrrhenian Sea and football players from all over Europe will make your leisure time unforgettable. The matches are set to grace exceptional sports facilities in Viareggio and Versilia. In 2024, the tournament celebrated its 20th edition.

name: Trofeo Mediterráneo
shortDescription: Join the Trofeo Mediterráneo in Catalonia! Compete with 200+ teams, enjoy Maresme's stunning coast & experience an unforgettable football festival!
