description: We invite you to take part in the football battles for the cup Trofeo Mediterráneo. This colorful tournament is held in April on the Spanish coast of Maresme. Enjoy the incredible atmosphere of our football holiday! Discover Catalonia, where any of the coastal cities hold many secrets and monuments of antiquity. The tournament has started in 1988. Last years, about 200 teams from 4 continents participated in the tournament: Spain, Argentina, Algeria, Germany, Ukraine, Israel, France, USA, Colombia, Denmark, Bulgaria, Italy, Romania, Sweden, Zambia and many other countries.

name: Mediterraneo Trophy
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in a historic Mediterranean resort town
description: Welcome to Lloret de Mar, a resort town with over 1000 years of history. The Trofeo Mediterraneo football tournament was held in 2021 for the 34th time. The tournament features teams from various countries competing across multiple age categories on artificial fields.

name: Trofeo Perla del Mare
shortDescription: Premier youth football tournament in Lignano Sabbiadoro with accommodation and beach activities
description: The most powerful football tournament for children in the tourist pearl of Italy Lignano Sabbiadoro. International competition featuring clubs from Italy, Switzerland, Austria, Germany and Slovakia. Participants receive excellent living conditions in the Olympic Village with swimming pools, gym, animation, water park access and disco. Features group stage followed by playoffs, with consolation matches for non-advancing teams.

name: Trofeo Perla Del Tirreno
shortDescription: Junior football tournament in Viareggio, Italy with multiple age categories
description: Youth football tournament held off the coast of Tuscany at Marco Polo Sports Centre featuring group stage followed by play-offs. Winners and runners-up receive cups and medals. Participation includes water, free coach accommodation, souvenir, stadium entrance, opening ceremony and finals access, plus player injury insurance.

name: Trofeo Piccoli Campioni
shortDescription: International football tournament for young players featuring top clubs from Italy and abroad
description: Youth football tournament in Turin featuring elite clubs including Juventus FC, Internazionale FC, AC Milan, and international teams. Participants compete in group rounds with top teams advancing to finals. All teams receive trophies regardless of placement.

name: Trofeo Riviera
shortDescription: International football tournament on the Adriatic coast in Lignano Sabbiadoro
description: Welcome to Lignano Sabbiadoro to take part in the international football tournament Trofeo Riviera on the Adriatic coast! Players and companions will be accommodated in a charming Olympic Village with indoor sports facilities, swimming pools, gym, playground and disco.

name: Trofeo San Jaime
shortDescription: International football tournament combining sports competition with beach entertainment in Lloret de Mar
description: International football tournament held in Lloret de Mar offering "quality rest, positive emotions and unforgettable sports struggles with clubs from different countries." Features sea views and beaches with opportunities to explore the old town and local cuisine. Organizers note this represents the 42nd edition as of 2022.

name: Trofeo Valle d'Aosta
shortDescription: Exceptional football tournament for youth players in inspiring alpine atmosphere with good awards and many international clubs
description: Trofeo Valle d'Aosta welcomes young football players to an inspiring alpine setting filled with passion, and discoveries. Many strong clubs will come to us this summer, creating memorable days of competition and shared experiences in northern Italy. First organised in 2023, the tournament has quickly become a recognised youth occasion, admired for its atmosphere, organisation, and scenic location.

name: Trofeo Vila de Lloret
shortDescription: Football tournament in the Spanish resort of Lloret de Mar with beaches and modern facilities
description: Discover the beauty of the Spanish resort of Lloret de Mar with endless beaches and gentle sea this summer. The competition is held in modern football complexes in Lloret de Mar, Blanes, Tordera, Palafolls and other cities.

name: TSC International Tournament
shortDescription: Strong youth football tournament in Oosterhout with top European academies and excellent field conditions
description: Welcome to a great football tournament TSC International in the small Dutch city of Oosterhout. Strong teams from many European countries will compete on several pitches with natural grass and artificial turf. TSC Football Club, a legendary local club with over 110 years of history, more than 1,100 members, 50 youth teams and 16 senior teams offers excellent tournament facilities. Top clubs such as AC Milan, FC Internazionale, AS Roma, Panathinaikos FC, Liverpool FC and others have participated. Almost half participants are well-known European clubs. Teams are divided into groups of four with first and second-placed teams continuing in Gold round, while third and fourth-placed teams move to Silver round.

name: Turneul Campionilor
shortDescription: Turneul Campionilor youth tournament in Cluj-Napoca: competitive matches, cool rewards and cultural discoveries in Romania.
description: An exciting youth event awaits your club in Cluj-Napoca. The Turneul Campionilor brings strong rivals, a good football atmosphere, and a city known for sport and student life. With Cluj Arena, Central Park, and the Someș River nearby, young players get more than competition alone. Launched in 2019 as a special centenary edition linked to 100 years of Universitatea Cluj, it has grown steadily and is now one of the leading youth football tournaments in the country.
organiserNames: Academia de Fotbal U Cluj Luceafarul

name: Tournoi International U11
shortDescription: Elite youth football tournament on the French-Swiss border welcoming top European academies
description: Held in spring on the picturesque French-Swiss border, this tournament welcomes professional academies from across Europe. The competition features a group stage followed by knockout rounds, with group winners advancing to quarter-finals. All participants receive medals and teams receive trophies. Outstanding players are recognized for field play, goalkeeping, and scoring.

name: U11 Motion Cup
shortDescription: A major international youth football event featuring top academies in historic Xàtiva, Spain
description: Motion Cup international football tournament attracting strong competitors from Portugal, Spain, the Netherlands, Germany, and other countries. First held in 2021, gathering renowned Spanish and French football academies. Popular among clubs such as Barcelona, Real Madrid, Borussia Dortmund, PSG, and Ajax Amsterdam.

name: U11 Number One Cup
shortDescription: One of Poland's strongest youth football tournaments featuring elite European academies
description: Premier youth football tournament held in spring in Gdańsk with modern facilities. Features preliminary rounds with Gold and Silver group stages, culminating in finals. Participants receive medals, top group winners receive trophies. Includes accommodation, meals, transfers, city tour, and souvenir. Applications accepted up to 30 days before tournament start.

name: U12 Arretium Cup Trofeo Italia
shortDescription: Prestigious summer football competition for 12-year-old boys in Italy
description: The Arretium Cup Trofeo Italia is a prestigious youth football tournament held in the province of Arezzo, Tuscany. It gathers top young players from leading Italian professional clubs, making it one of the region's most significant competitions. This incredible football event was first held in 2022.

name: U12 Jopa Sommer Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament featuring well-known clubs from multiple nations
description: The debut of Jopa Sommer Cup took place in 2026. Already in its first year, several well-known clubs from many nations took part. Come for a valuable experience of intense sporting rivalry.

name: U12 KHS Cup
shortDescription: Pro-level international youth football tournament in Mġarr, Malta with strong matches and sightseeing opportunities
description: KHS Cup welcomes young football clubs to Mġarr, Malta, for a Pro-level international youth event in a calm island setting. It gives players a strong sporting challenge, a chance to face new opponents and the opportunity to visit famous landmarks such as Popeye Village, Dingli Cliffs and the Blue Grotto during the trip. First held in 2021, KHS Cup has grown into a recognised international competition for young players. Previous editions have welcomed famous academies such as SL Benfica, Olympiacos FC and Deportivo La Coruña.

name: Portimão International Cup
shortDescription: Prestigious youth football tournament on Portugal's Algarve coast
description: An exceptional youth football tournament held on the Algarve coast, Portugal. Teams compete in group stage round-robin games, with top two sides progressing to quarter-finals. Established as a prestigious youth competition aimed at developing young talent, featuring strong international participants from Spain, Canada, Portugal, England, USA, the Netherlands, Sweden, and other countries.

name: Madrid Youth Cup
shortDescription: Annual summer international football tournament for youth teams from Europe, America and Asia
description: International tournament held in Moratalaz, south of Madrid. Teams play in groups of 4, with winners advancing to knockout rounds. Champions and runners-up receive cups and medals; individual awards given for best field player and goalkeeper per age category.

name: U15 Number One Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Wrocław featuring Europe's top clubs
description: Register for the international youth football tournament in Wrocław for a fantastic experience playing against some of Europe's top clubs at the Number One Cup! You'll face opponents like Juventus FC, PSG, PSV Eindhoven, Liverpool FC, FC Inter Milan, Sparta Praha, and more, with whom you'll compete and enjoy the thrill of the game! The Number One Cup has been held many times, bringing together some of the most renowned football academies in London, Gdańsk, Wrocław, and Portimão.

name: U16 KHS Girls Cup
shortDescription: Elite youth football tournament where rising talents compete with top international squads
description: The KHS Girls Cup is your chance to test your skills against international elite football teams and push your limits. This exclusive event is designed to help aspiring athletes grow by competing with the best. Since its launch in 2021, the KHS Cup has been a top-tier tournament for boys. In 2024, it proudly expanded to include girls' competitions, quickly earning a reputation as a must-attend event in the football world.

name: Madrid Youth Cup
shortDescription: Annual summer international football tournament for boys 18 and under
description: International youth football tournament held at Moratalaz complex featuring teams from Europe, Latin America, North America and Asia. Participants compete in group stages followed by final rounds. Winners and runners-up receive cups and medals; individual awards for best field player and goalkeeper.

name: U8 KHS Cup
shortDescription: Premier youth football tournament in Malta uniting top academies worldwide for elite competition
description: The KHS Cup is an exciting international event that brings together the best youth academies from across the globe. Since 2021, this tournament has become a must-attend, providing a stage where future stars can grow and experience high-level matches. The journey begins with group-stage clashes, allowing every squad to showcase its potential. The playoffs then determine rankings, leading to final rounds where knockout battles occur. Every participant receives a medal, while top performers win trophies.

name: U9 Motion Cup
shortDescription: Top youth football event with elite academies, cool trophies, and a stunning mountain destination in Alicante region.
description: International children's Motion Cup football tournament in Castalla, Spain. Offers intense matches against renowned academies including AC Milan, Borussia Dortmund, FC Barcelona, PSG, Ajax Amsterdam. Running since 2021, attracting strongest academies worldwide. Includes refined local cuisine and unforgettable memories.

name: U9 Pfingstcup
shortDescription: High-level U9 football tournament in Cologne featuring top European clubs
description: Experience the U9 Pfingstcup Youth Football Tournament in Cologne! This is the perfect opportunity to test your squad in a highly competitive environment. Join us and challenge top clubs like Ajax FC, Juventus FC, Sporting Charleroi, Bayer 04 Leverkusen, Olympique de Marseille, and many more! The Pfingstcup was first held in 2013 and has since continued its tradition of high-quality competition, featuring renowned teams from across Europe and beyond. Any squad is welcome to participate—we look forward to seeing you on the pitch!

name: Umag Trophy
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Croatia hosting clubs from Italy, Austria, Slovenia, Serbia and Croatia
description: A major football cup for Croatia and its neighbors where leading Italian, Austrian, Slovenian, Serbian and Croatian clubs compete in spring. The tournament features group stage competition over the first 2 days, followed by finals for placement positions. All participants receive medals, semi-finalists receive trophies, and category winners receive a Challenge Cup. Fair-Play prizes awarded in team and individual categories.

name: Umbria Cup
shortDescription: Children's football tournament in Umbria, Italy
description: Youth football tournament held at Magrelli Active Sport Center and Cascia sports centre. Two teams from each group advance to finals. All teams receive commemorative plaques; finalists receive cups and medals.
venueName: Magrelli Active Sport Center, Cascia sports centre

name: USJ Cup Unikalo
shortDescription: International football tournament held annually in Bordeaux, France
description: International football tournament held since 2014 by the football section of Union Saint-Jean Bordeaux. Competition starts with group stage in groups of 4 teams, followed by main and consolation final stages using elimination system. Held at Colette Besson sports area and Matmut Atlantique stadium.
venueName: Colette Besson sports area, Matmut Atlantique

name: Val di Fassa Kids Festival
shortDescription: Youth football cup in the picturesque Alpine town of Canazei in Trentino
description: An youth football cup in an unusual place welcoming teams to the picturesque Alpine town of Canazei in Trentino. With stunning mountain views, wildlife and hospitality, the festival offers one of Europe's most colorful football holidays. Supported by the municipality of Val di Fassa and Union Hotel Canazei group, the tournament has been held for the 13th time as of 2022, featuring Italian, Austrian, and Slovenian teams competing with opening ceremony held in the theater of Il Caminetto hotel.

name: Valdilecha Winter Cup
shortDescription: Kids' football tournament in Madrid outskirts with local and international squads
description: One-day competition in Valdilecha inviting local and international youth squads to compete against top Spanish academies. Tournament features group stage with Play-Offs, accommodation, meals, transport and Madrid sightseeing included. Four semi-finalists receive trophies and standout players earn additional prizes.

name: Valencia Beach Torneo
shortDescription: Summer football tournament in Valencia with teams from worldwide competing in modern beach facilities
description: Torneo Valencia Beach invites football teams to challenge themselves at the end of the season by comparing themselves with clubs from different regions of the country and the world. Competitions will be held in the most modern sports facilities near the beach and the city center. More than 1200 players from different countries will take part in tournament battles.

name: Valencia Cup Girls Football Tournament
shortDescription: Join the Valencia Cup Girls Football Tournament and experience competition, friendship, and showcase your skills in one of the most exciting competitions.
description: An international girls football tournament held in Valencia, Spain. Teams compete in a round-robin system split into groups of 4-5, with top finishers advancing to Play-Offs A and others to Play-Offs B. All participants receive medals, with trophies for champions, runners-up, MVPs, and the best club.

name: Valencia International Cup
shortDescription: Youth football competition in Spain's Mediterranean region with excellent organization and international teams
description: The Valencia International Cup is an exciting youth football competition held in Spain's Mediterranean region. Praised for its smooth organization and welcoming spirit, it brings together promising footballers from academies and clubs across Europe for several days of play, teamwork, and cultural discovery. Introduced in 2026, this annual meeting has quickly earned a reputation as one of the region's most attractive events for emerging talent.

name: Valpolicella Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament in the Valpolicella wine region near Verona, Italy
description: International football tournament held for many years in the famous Italian wine region near Verona with participation of amateur clubs and academies from Italy and other countries. Teams compete among vineyards near Lake Garda.

name: Venezia Futsal Cup
shortDescription: Mini-football tournament held in Mestre, Venice with age categories from B9 to B17
description: Tournament featuring futsal competition across multiple age groups in the municipality of Mestre on Venice's mainland. Participants compete in group stages with top teams advancing to finals. Winners receive trophies, all players receive medals, and individual awards given for best player, top scorer, and best goalkeeper in each age category.

name: Venezia Jesolo Cup
shortDescription: Young footballers at Venezia Jesolo Cup tournament, joy and sportsmanship on the pitch
description: Football tournament in Lido di Jesolo featuring clubs from Italy and other countries. Includes group stage and playoff competitions with trophies for top three teams. Participants enjoy beach activities, water sports, amusement parks, and nearby Venice.

name: Venezia Winter Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Venice bringing together children from around the world
description: The international tournament Venezia Winter Cup brings together children from all over the world to enjoy football and learn about Venice. The strongest Italian football schools participate, increasing competition intensity. Teams compete in group stages to qualify for elimination-style play-offs. Winners in each age group receive cups; all teams receive commemorative plaques and players receive medals. Three outstanding players receive special prizes.

name: Ventspils Autumn Cup
shortDescription: Strong opponents, great prizes, post-match penalty shoot-outs and various prize draws
description: Come to visit us in autumn in Latvia for the Ventspils Autumn Football Cup. We will do our best to make as many participants as possible feel like winners! For this purpose, we draw prizes, hold lotteries, kick post-match penalties, etc. The competition has been counting down since 2017 and bringing together strong football clubs from the Baltic States, Scandinavia and other European countries.

name: Ventspils Spring Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament held in Latvia with multiple nominations and competitive leagues
description: International football tournament held in Latvia since 2017. Features group round with Champions League and European League competitions, Super Cup finals, and individual awards for best goalkeeper, forward, team player and tournament MVP. Uses 5-kick penalties after each game.

name: Versilia Cup
shortDescription: Annual international senior football tournament for veterans and adult teams
description: Annual international senior football tournament held for veterans and adult teams in Marina di Pietrasanta, Tuscany. Teams are divided into groups of 4-5 teams with games held in one round. Winners advance to final stage. All participants receive souvenirs and first four teams receive cups. Fair Play prize awarded to most fair team.

name: Versilia Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Viareggio, Italy with exciting competition surrounded by mountains and clear sea
description: Children's football tournament in Viareggio at the foot of the Apuan Alps, world famous for its carnival, beaches and entertainment. The eleventh edition was organized in 2022. Nearby cities include Florence, Pisa, and Lucca.

name: Viareggio Summer Festival
shortDescription: Quality youth football on the Tuscan coast with fair game format, good trophies, beaches, and friendly atmosphere
description: A youth football celebration marking the close of the season in a warm, family-oriented setting. Fixtures take place across several stadiums along the Tuscan coast, giving visitors the chance to enjoy the beaches, sea, cuisine, and sights of the Versilia area. First held in 2023, the event quickly became known for its welcoming atmosphere and excellent organisation.

name: Vienna Super Cup
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in Vienna where European academies compete with international rivals
description: The Vienna Super Cup invites you into a charming world of breathtaking architecture, classical music, fragrant pastries, endless entertainment, and football! Dozens of football academies from across Europe will compete for the cup, delighting us with thrilling battles. We offer excellent accommodation, superb pitches, and international rivals – our tournament promises to be your most unforgettable spring event!

name: Volos Soccer Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament for children and youth on the Aegean Sea coast
description: International football tournament for children and youth held in Volos, Greece. The tournament features competition with amateur and famous clubs from across the Balkan Peninsula on high-quality sports fields. Winners in each age category receive trophies and medals, while all participants receive diplomas and souvenirs.

name: VSportCup Futbol Costa Daurada
shortDescription: International football tournament in Costa Daurada with modern facilities and Mediterranean beaches
description: International tournament featuring football competition in modern sports facilities where teams from different countries compete. Includes group stage, semi-finals, and finals with trophies and medals awarded. Participants can enjoy Costa Daurada's Mediterranean beaches and nearby cities like Barcelona and Tarragona.

name: VSportCup Futsal Costa Brava
shortDescription: International futsal tournament with around 100 teams and over 1000 players in Costa Brava
description: Around 100 teams with more than 1000 players participate in the international tournament VSportCup Futsal. There are a variety of levels but after the qualifying phase the level is quite competitive. Blanes and Lloret de Mar are two tourist towns with beaches and different types of leisure and tourism establishments such as the Port Aventura amusement park, the Caribe Aquatic water park. The first competition was held in 2000.

name: VSportCup Futsal Costa Daurada
shortDescription: International futsal tournament for youth age groups in Costa Daurada, Spain
description: Futsal competition held in Costa Daurada with "group stage, where your team can qualify for Phase A or Phase B and then have quarter-finals, semi-finals and finals." The tournament attracts "Spanish regional federations, European teams from Belgium, France and Ukraine and teams from other parts of the world such as the United States and Australia."

name: VSportCup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament held annually in Madrid, Spain
description: A youth football tournament held in Madrid with over 15 years of history, featuring group stages, quarter-finals, semi-finals and finals. Teams compete for Phase A or B qualification, playing between 4-6 matches. Trophies and medals awarded to champions and runners-up in each category.

name: Walibi Cup June
shortDescription: Youth football tournament in the Netherlands with amusement park access
description: The Walibi Cup youth football tournament in the Netherlands near Walibi Holland amusement park. Participants stay in bungalows with kitchens. One tournament day includes amusement park visit with tickets included. Competition features group rounds and play-offs with all teams receiving trophies and gifts.

name: Walibi Cup May
shortDescription: Football competition combined with a visit to Walibi Holland amusement park
description: All football lovers can participate in the Walibi Cup football competition combined with a visit to Walibi Holland amusement park in the Netherlands. Accommodation includes cottage rentals with barbecue facilities or kitchen access. The tournament takes place in one of the largest sports parks in the Dutch region.

name: Warsaw European Cup
shortDescription: International children's football tournament in Poland's capital
description: International children's football tournament featuring teams from across Europe. Participants enjoy group stage followed by Championship and Gold rounds. All players receive commemorative medals; champions awarded trophies; top three players per age category receive individual prizes.

name: West Balkan Football Children's Cup
shortDescription: Major youth football tournament in North Macedonia with European clubs, group & play-off stages
description: Join the fierce clash of rivals at the international youth football tournament West Balkan Football Children's Cup in the city of Ohrid, North Macedonia! This is one of the region's largest competitions, bringing together participants from several European countries. The tournament was first launched in 2024, when it brought together football academies from Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Slovenia and Romania.

name: Wisla Youth Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament held in Płock, Poland
description: An international youth tournament held in Płock, Poland, known for its rich program, high level of organization and comfortable friendly atmosphere. The tournament features two competition stages: group rounds where 16 clubs per category compete, with top two teams advancing to play-offs. Winners, runners-up and third place finishers receive cups and medals. Participants enjoy free access to Płock zoo and various museums.

name: Women Ravenna Cup
shortDescription: One of the strongest girls' football tournaments in Italy
description: A premier girls' football tournament featuring elite European clubs. Teams compete in two group stages. All players receive trophies. The tournament includes free accommodation for coaches, souvenirs, stadium entrance, and access to opening ceremony and finals.

name: Women's International Canarias Cup
shortDescription: International football tournament in the Canary Islands featuring Spanish teams and clubs worldwide
description: International football tournament held in the Canary Islands since 2008. Features group stage competition where 4-5 teams play round-robin, with top two advancing to playoffs and lower-ranked teams competing in consolation tournament. All participants receive medals, commemorative photos, and tournament magazines. Top three finalists in each age group receive trophies.

name: Women's International Spring Cup
shortDescription: Representative football tournament for girls in Barcelona with international participation
description: "one of the most representative football tournaments for girls in Spain" held in Barcelona, featuring age groups G14 (7vs7) and G19 (11vs11). Tournament includes group stage followed by playoff rounds, with medals for all participants and trophies for top three finishers. Established in 2021.

name: Women's International Summer Cup
shortDescription: Women's football tournament in Salou created as an opportunity for girls to experience competitive international play
description: The Women's International Summer Cup was established in 2021 as an opportunity for girls to experience the same competitive emotions as boys. The competition takes place in natural surroundings and modern stadiums with participation from international clubs. Teams from France, Portugal, Puerto Rico and other countries have participated.

name: Wrocław Summer Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Wrocław, Poland with European clubs
description: Break away from routine and consider taking part in the Wrocław Summer Cup, an international youth football tournament that brings together clubs from across Europe. With perfect sports facilities and a rich variety of sightseeing opportunities, Wrocław provides the perfect setting for an unforgettable competition. The Wrocław Summer Cup was held for the first time in 2018 and now, attracting competitors from many renowned academies, inspires young athletes to win, leaving the brightest impressions for players and fans alike.

name: Xixón Esei Cup
shortDescription: Football tournament in Asturias combining sports competition with beach and cultural experiences
description: Football tournament taking place in Asturias, Spain. Main battlefields are stadiums in El Berrón, Llanos and Asuncion. Participants compete with top Spanish clubs and have opportunities to explore cities like Gijón and Oviedo, enjoy beaches, and experience outdoor activities.

name: Tournoi Yellow Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament in Occitanie with top teams and first-class pitches
description: International youth football tournament taking place in the picturesque towns of Occitanie, in southern France. Witness exciting matches involving clubs from Spain, France, Luxembourg and other countries. First-class pitches and friendly atmosphere guaranteed. The tournament was first held in 1990 and has steadily grown its audience.

name: Young Talents Cup
shortDescription: World-famous tournament for 11-year-old boys held in Tallinn, Estonia
description: The legendary Young Talents Cup is back again! The world-famous tournament for 11-year-olds boys will be held in the capital of Estonia! This is a great opportunity to play alongside strong teams and compete for the trophy that has already been to several leading academies of the planet. The strongest team gets the cup for one year, after which it changes to a duplicate. A name of the winner will appear on the main trophy forever! The Young Talents Cup was owned by such teams as: FC Barcelona, Brommapoykarna IF Sweden, FC Spartak Moscow, FC Zenit St. Petersburg, Borussia Dortmund, Lokomotiv Moscow, Dynamo Kiev, CSKA Moscow, and other clubs.

name: Find Football Tournament
shortDescription: Annual football festival for children and youth teams from around the world held in Pécs, Hungary
description: Hungary and Pécs invite teams of children and youth to an annual football festival. Over 200 teams from more than 50 countries and 5 continents participate. The city's central square becomes a festival village for a week with entertainment, dining, and activities. Tournament features group stage play followed by direct elimination playoffs with penalty shootouts for draws. Winners and medalists receive cups and medals.

name: Tournoi International Sartilly
shortDescription: Football competition for boys and girls in Normandy near Mont Saint-Michel
description: A football competition for boys and girls close to the coast and the famous fortress-monastery of Mont Saint-Michel. More than a hundred teams from different countries meet on beautiful grass pitches. The tournament celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2023.

name: Youth Trophy
shortDescription: International youth football tournament near Milan featuring B9 and B11 age groups
description: A football tournament welcoming teams to compete against prominent clubs from Italy and beyond. Features group stage matches leading to Gold and Silver playoffs with knockout rounds. Top three teams per age category receive trophies; all players receive medals with special prizes for standout performers.

name: Jeugd WinterCup Holland December
shortDescription: Football tournament with team building and entertainment at Duinrell holiday park
description: The Wintercup Holland Duinrell tournament welcomes teams of all levels, featuring categories for both top-tier and lower-tier. Scheduled for Saturday and Sunday, the event will take place in the picturesque sports park of RKSV Blauw Zwart, conveniently located next to Duinrell. Participating teams will enjoy a weekend stay in one of the many cozy duingalows at the Duinrell holiday park. This event was first held in 2016 and has been a success in recent years. Apart from the tournament, the Wintercup Holland is primarily focused on team building.

name: Jeugd WinterCup Holland Januari
shortDescription: Youth winter football tournament in Wassenaar with teams from across Europe competing at RKSV Blauw Zwart near Duinrell
description: The Wintercup Holland Duinrell youth football tournament invites teams of all levels to compete, from top-tier to beginner. Happening at the scenic RKSV Blauw Zwart sports park, right near to Duinrell. Enjoy a friendly atmosphere with entertainment, rides and football games! We will bring together representatives from the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, France and other countries. Since its debut in 2016, this event has been a big hit. Beyond the competition, the Wintercup Holland is all about team building.

name: Yuri Bespalov's Cup
shortDescription: Annual international youth football tournament held in memory of Yuri Bespalov
description: The Yuri Bespalov's Cup is an annual international youth football tournament held in memory of Yuri Bespalov, who led FC Ventspils for many years and devoted himself to the development of football throughout Latvia. Since its establishment in 2016, the tournament has welcomed clubs from the Baltics, Scandinavia, Belarus, and the UK.

name: Zagreb Kid's Winter Trophy
shortDescription: Winter indoor football tournament for children in Zagreb
description: Welcome to Zagreb for the winter indoor football tournament for children in the Zagreb Kid's Winter Trophy. In winter, Zagreb is also attractive as in summer. There are lots of interesting places to visit in your free time from the tournament. The tournament is held in the halls that are provided by the organizer in the city and outside of Zagreb. In 2019, the tournament was held for the 4th time and gathered 256 teams in 11 age categories. Teams from Croatia, Slovenia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Austria, Hungary, Ukraine and Romania competed at the Zagreb Kid's Winter Trophy.

name: Zeeland Cup
shortDescription: International youth football tournament with prizes, seaside atmosphere, and a historic Dutch city to explore
description: A true team weekend in Middelburg this summer, where you can enjoy bright football, entertainment, and relaxation on the Zeeland coast. All participants pass through qualifying stage, after which every squad enters the final round with knock-out matches. All teams receive trophies and commemorative prizes.
